Build the growth engine. Own the function. Accelerate your career.

LOCATION Remote (Chicago Pref’d) REPORTS TO CEO
BASE SALARY $130,000 to $150,000 TARGET BONUS 20%

The Opportunity

Guidant Power is looking for a high-potential B2B marketer ready to take the next major step in their career. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to build and own the marketing function of a rapidly growing, private equity backed services company.

We are looking for a builder. You will own Guidant's lead generation engine, HubSpot, campaigns, marketing metrics, budget, agencies, and the process for creating qualified pipeline one and two quarters ahead of sales requirements. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with sales and operating leadership.

Why This Role Is Different

  • You will own the marketing function, not one channel or a narrow piece of the funnel.
  • You will work directly with the CEO and senior leadership on growth priorities, investment decisions, and performance.
  • You will participate in Shore Capital's marketing cohort, sharing best practices and learning alongside marketers across a top 1% private equity firm’s portfolio.
  • You will gain direct experience with organic growth, M&A integration, cross-sell programs, and the operating discipline of a rapidly scaling services platform.
  • You will be judged on measurable business results, and success can lead to broader responsibility as Guidant grows.

What You Will Own

  • Build the lead flow model required to support bookings goals, including how many leads and qualified opportunities Guidant needs and how far in advance they must be created.
  • Create and manage integrated campaigns across email, paid media, social, events, conferences and trade shows, webinars, outbound BDR programs, SEO, and targeted accounts.
  • Own the marketing calendar, campaign priorities, annual marketing plan, and budget.
  • Oversee HubSpot implementation and operate HubSpot as Guidant's top-of-funnel platform for campaigns, lead scoring, qualification, workflows, attribution, and reporting.
  • Build dashboards that show pipeline generated by source, funnel conversion, cost per qualified opportunity, campaign ROI, and pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward.
  • Use qualitative market research with customers, prospects, salespeople, and technical experts to improve positioning, content, offers, and campaigns.
  • Manage agencies, contractors, paid media partners, content resources, data vendors, and other outside resources for quality, cost, timing, and results.
  • Support Guidant's M&A strategy by helping integrate acquired companies into Guidant's marketing systems, processes, brand, and cross-sell programs.

About the job SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.

The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.

Responsibilities:

  • Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.
  • Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.
  • Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.
  • Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.
  • Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.
  • Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.
  • Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.
  • Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

  • 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.
  • Understanding of banking data environment.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.
  • Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.
  • Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.
  • In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.
  • Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

jobs.excerpt: Who is Forcepoint? Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments.
jobs.description:
Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff/Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer to modernize enterprise infrastructure operations across endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, network, cloud, and IT service management. This is not a traditional systems administration role. The successful candidate will establish an automation-first, API-driven, AI-assisted operating model that replaces manual administration with policy-as-code, automated remediation, and intelligent operational workflows, extending the governance and security foundation already built across the environment.

The engineer will act as a technical authority and architecture leader, unifying Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, CrowdStrike Falcon, CyberArk, Freshservice, AWS, Commvault, and Juniper NGFW infrastructure into a single automation and telemetry architecture. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between writing Python, PowerShell, and Bash, troubleshooting a production authentication issue, reviewing architecture, and defining an AI-driven remediation strategy.

The organization operates as customer zero for Forcepoint's Data Security Everywhere (DSE) / DLP platform, piloting AI-assisted data security and remediation workflows ahead of general availability. This engineer will help shape how that integration extends into the broader automation and AI Ops corporate architecture.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering & Automation

Own the architecture and standards for the Windows endpoint platform in Intune. Design lifecycle automation covering provisioning, configuration, compliance, patching, and retirement, and sustain current patch and compliance rates as the fleet scales. Engineer Windows Autopilot workflows that enforce standard-user deployment and close local-admin exposure. Build automated software inventory auditing by reconciling Intune with CrowdStrike Falcon Discover, and design self-healing remediation for common failures.

Identity, Zero Trust & Access Automation

Serve as a technical authority for Entra ID identity architecture. Automate Joiner, Mover, and Leaver workflows across Entra ID, M365, and Freshservice. Mature Conditional Access from audit mode into full enforcement. Develop AI-assisted entitlement and RBAC analysis that surfaces excessive privilege, stale access, and segregation-of-duties risk. Partner on Beyond Trust privileged-access automation, including onboarding, credential rotation, and session monitoring.

Microsoft 365 Platform Engineering

Architect and automate Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Conditional Access administration through Microsoft Graph and PowerShell. Establish configuration baselines and drift detection, and carry forward the SharePoint governance and versioning cleanup already underway.

Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation Engineering

Own the automation engineering practice enterprise-wide. Set standards for Terraform, Bicep, and scripting frameworks in place of one-off scripts. Build CI/CD pipelines and API-driven integrations across Intune, Entra ID, Freshservice, AWS, and Juniper, and deliver reusable automation modules other engineers can build on. Convert high-volume manual processes into automated Freshservice service catalog workflows.

AI Ops & Intelligent Automation

Deliver production AI-assisted capabilities, not pilots, across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and Service Desk. Implement anomaly detection and event correlation, intelligent ticket classification and routing in Freshservice, and predictive models for certificate expiration, patch compliance, and firewall licensing. Ensure every automated action carries authentication, authorization, logging, approval, and rollback controls, with human approval gates on high-risk changes.

Serve as a technical partner on the organization's customer-zero engagement with Forcepoint DSE/DLP, helping define how AI-assisted data security detection and remediation workflows integrate with the broader endpoint, identity, and ITSM automation architecture.

Observability & Security Guardrails

Build a unified telemetry view spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, M365, and ITSM. Implement secrets management through Key Vault, Secrets Manager, or Vault, eliminate hardcoded credentials and standing privileged access, and enforce least-privilege RBAC with full audit trails for every automated action.

Technical Leadership

Define the architecture standards adopted across Infrastructure & Operations. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and partner with Network, Cloud, Security, Identity, and Service Desk leaders, shaping standards across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience designing automation (not just executing predefined procedures) in large enterprise environments.
  • Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management, including Autopilot and local-admin/LAPS enforcement.
  • Strong hands-on Entra ID experience: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, Zero Trust, identity lifecycle, SCIM/API-based provisioning.
  • Advanced PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash; strong REST API/webhook integration and Git experience; experience with Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deep Microsoft 365 administration, including Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint governance.
  • Experience with EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon preferred) and vulnerability/patch management reporting.
  • Understanding of 802.1X, enterprise PKI/CA, certificate deployment via MDM, and NAC/authentication troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted or event-driven production automation, including anomaly detection and automated remediation with appropriate security guardrails.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS platform engineering and account hygiene.
  • Direct Freshservice (or ServiceNow/Jira Service Management) administration and API integration experience.
  • Experience with CyberArk or equivalent PAM platforms, and Commvault or equivalent backup platforms.
  • Network automation using Python/Ansible; experience with observability/telemetry pipelines.
  • Experience with LLM/AI agent frameworks and enterprise AI governance.
  • Familiarity with Forcepoint DSE/DLP or Claude-based AI security tooling, or interest in shaping an early customer-zero AI/data-security integration.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert; Terraform Associate; AWS/Azure professional certification.

Success Metrics (6–12 Months)

  • 60–80%+ of repeatable endpoint tasks automated; patch/compliance rates sustained or improved.
  • Automated Joiner/Mover/Leaver workflows live; Conditional Access moved from audit to full enforcement.
  • Infrastructure changes delivered through Git/CI/CD with reusable modules adopted across teams.
  • Proactive certificate, firewall, and endpoint compliance monitoring in place.
  • Multiple AI Ops use cases in production (ticket classification, automated low-risk remediation) with measurable reduction in mean time to detect/resolve.

Role Positioning

This role is measured by outcomes, not ticket volume: tickets eliminated, processes automated, incidents prevented, risk reduced, engineering capacity created.

The right candidate can architect a solution, build the automation, secure it, measure it, and roll it back if needed. This is an automation and platform architect who codes fluently, not an administrator who happens to know Intune and Freshservice.

Don’t meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don’t meet all requirements listed in a job posting. Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team.

Euclid Chemical is a fully owned subsidiary of RPM International (NYSE: RPM), one of the world's largest coatings companies. With over 110 years of experience, we provide innovative solutions to the construction and restoration markets through our extensive range of treatments, sealants, coatings, sealers, and decorative products. Recognized as a 2024 NE Ohio Top Workplace by Energage, Euclid Chemical prides itself on fostering a people-first culture that values collaboration, respect, and growth.

Summary: The Cement Additives Process Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving business growth and profitability through strategic technical support and contribution to the sales process. This position is tasked with providing technical support and expertise of the cement manufacturing process to our cement additive sales team and customers. Proficiency in this role requires exceptional cement manufacturing, analytical, and communication skills to collaborate seamlessly with internal teams at Euclid Chemical and build strong, lasting relationships with external cement customers – both active and potential customers. This is a remote position, with Euclid Chemical's main campus located in Ceveland, OH.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a technical ambassador for the Euclid Chemical cement additive sales team.
  • Subject matter expert to provide feedback and troubleshooting information for customers.
  • Act as a technical expert on the latest cement manufacturing technologies, equipment, and best practices to maintain Euclid Chemical's competitive edge.
  • Deliver customer support through industrial trials, mill audits, special projects, data analysis, and detailed reporting to retain existing customers and attract new ones
  • Compile and analyze industrial trial process data, and prepare detailed reports providing conclusions and action items from industrial trial runs.
  • Keep thorough and updated records of activity history with active and potential cement additive customers.
  • Design and execution of plant industrial trials and mill audits.
  • Maintenance and operation of portable pump equipment inventory to utilize during industrial trials.
  • Collaborate with the Cement Additives Technical Manager and Cement Lab Manager to develop new products and enhance existing lines based on market trends, competitive analysis, and industrial trial results.
  • Work collaboratively with Euclid Chemical Cement Additives Lab team in the development and improvement of laboratory ball mill methodologies for testing materials.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical or mechanical) or chemistry - master’s degree is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in cement manufacturing process control or quality management.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Advanced knowledge and understanding of cement manufacturing, cement chemistry, and raw and finish mill circuit operation.
  • Basic understanding of cement additives chemistries.
  • Ability to interpret lab outputs (e.g., XRD, clinker microscopy, isothermal calorimetry, and physical test results) to develop customer-specific strategies and product recommendations.
  • Proficiency with cement standards (ASTM, CSA, etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of milling equipment, particle classifiers, circuit configurations, and pyro processes for optimizing clinker performance.
  • Advanced knowledge of MS Office computer software: Excel, PowerPoint, Word. Basic knowledge of MS Outlook, Teams, Edge Internet Browser.
  • Knowledge of industry trends, including low clinker content cement production and co-grinding with alternative materials.
  • Data analysis and report writing skills.
  • Communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Leadership and team management capabilities.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • The ability to design and execute plant industrial trials and mill audits.

Travel:

  • Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and plant industrial trials (up to 50%).

Why join our team? Euclid Chemical offers an attractive package for personnel, company benefits include but are not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
  • Life Insurance
  • Short Term/Long Term Disability
  • Parental Leave
  • 401k with company match
  • Defined benefit pension plan
  • Vacation and holiday time
  • A company vehicle or car allowance

Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000 plus annual company bonus program

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Product Manager Data & Collectors
jobs.excerpt: Sobre Tendios👋 Somos Tendios, una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona.
jobs.description:
Sobre Tendios

👋 Somos Tendios, una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona. Nuestra misión es revolucionar el mundo de la contratación pública para empresas e instituciones.

Nuestra plataforma SaaS impulsada por inteligencia artificial ayuda a empresas a ganar más licitaciones y a entidades públicas a crear y gestionar licitaciones de forma más eficiente. Trabajamos con entidades como el Principado de Asturias, Renfe, Acciona o Telefónica, entre otras. Lo hacemos a través de dos productos:

  • Tendios Bid— para empresas que participan en licitaciones públicas: buscador, alertas, pipeline de oportunidades y workflows para ganar más concursos.

  • Tendios Create— para organizaciones públicas que crean y publican licitaciones: creación de expedientes y redacción de pliegos asistida por IA.

La IA no es un añadido en nuestros productos: es el núcleo. Redacción asistida, propuestas generadas, análisis automático de documentos y flujos conversacionales están en el centro de la experiencia. Buscamos a alguien que diseñeconesa mentalidad, noalrededorde ella.

Como un equipo joven y ambicioso, valoramos la energía, la creatividad y la colaboración. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres tener un impacto real, nos encantaría que te unas a nosotros para redefinir cómo las empresas optimizan sus procesos de licitación pública.

El rol

Buscamos a alguien que sea el dueño de producto de todo el ciclo del dato: desde que se captura en la fuente (collectors) hasta que llega al cliente como valor (listas, directorios, análisis de mercado y Tender Intelligence).

Es un rol híbrido: lidera un equipo técnico de scraping/collectors y, al mismo tiempo, define y entrega la capa de producto de analítica de mercado que usan los clientes de Bid. Es un puesto con mucho impacto directo: la calidad del dato condiciona la activación, la retención y la propuesta de valor de Tendios.

Responsabilidades

1. Gestión del equipo de Collectors

  • Liderar y priorizar el trabajo del equipo de collectors (licitaciones, legislación, resoluciones y otras fuentes de contratación pública).

  • Definir el roadmap de cobertura: nuevas fuentes, nuevos países/territorios, nuevos tipos de documento y mayor profundidad de campos.

  • Evaluar la viabilidad y el valor de cada fuente (campos disponibles, frecuencia de actualización, estabilidad, coste de mantenimiento) antes de comprometer trabajo.

  • Gestionar el backlog, el ritmo de entrega y la coordinación con Ingeniería y Data & AI.

  • Garantizar la operación: monitorización de collectors, respuesta ante roturas de fuentes, SLAs de frescura y cobertura.

  • Dar visibilidad al resto de la empresa sobre qué datos tenemos, con qué calidad y qué limitaciones.

2. ETL y Data Quality a nivel de producto

  • Definir qué significa "dato de calidad" para Tendios: completitud, exactitud, consistencia, frescura, deduplicación y normalización.

  • Establecer métricas y umbrales de calidad (por fuente, por país, por campo) y hacerles seguimiento con dashboards y alertas.

  • Priorizar las mejoras del ETL en función del impacto en el producto: enriquecimiento, normalización de entidades (organismos y empresas), clasificación (CPV, tipologías, estados) y resolución de duplicados.

  • Traducir problemas de calidad de dato en impacto de negocio (ruido en alertas, resultados irrelevantes, análisis incorrectos) y escalarlos con criterio.

  • Definir la política de ciclo de vida del dato: estados de licitación, cambios, modificaciones, adjudicaciones y formalizaciones.

  • Ser el punto de referencia para evaluar la readiness de nuevos mercados en términos de calidad y disponibilidad de datos.

3. Producto de analítica de mercado y oportunidades de cliente

  • Ser el dueño de producto de:

    • Analítica interna de las oportunidades de las empresas

    • Directoriosde empresas y de entidades públicas.

    • Tender Intelligence: análisis de mercado, competencia, comportamiento de compradores, históricos de adjudicación y detección de oportunidades para cada cliente.

  • Descubrir necesidades reales de los Bidders (comerciales, responsables de licitaciones, dirección) y convertirlas en propuestas de producto claras.

  • Escribir PRDs orientados a producto (qué y por qué, flujos, reglas, estados y resultados esperados), sin entrar en cómo se implementa.

  • Definir métricas de éxito, plan de medición y experimentos; analizar el uso con herramientas de analítica de producto.

  • Colaborar con Diseño e Ingeniería en todo el ciclo: discovery, definición, entrega, lanzamiento y mejora continua.

  • Conectar la analítica de mercado con el resto del producto (buscador, alertas, pipeline) para que el dato se convierta en decisiones y no en pantallas aisladas.

Objetivos del rol

  • Aumentar la cobertura y la frescura del dato de las fuentes críticas.

  • Reducir de forma sostenida las incidencias de calidad de dato que llegan a cliente.

  • Lanzar y hacer crecer el uso de la analítica de mercado de la aplicación.

Requisitos

Imprescindibles

  • 4+ años como Product Manager, idealmente en productos de datos, plataformas B2B SaaS o marketplaces de información.

  • Experiencia liderando o coordinando equipos técnicos (scraping, data engineering o similar), con capacidad de priorizar y desbloquear.

  • Comprensión sólida de pipelines de datos (captura, transformación, carga), modelado de entidades y calidad de dato. No hace falta programar, sí hablar con fluidez con quien lo hace.

  • Capacidad analítica: SQL a nivel de consulta y uso cómodo de herramientas de analítica de producto y BI.

  • Buena redacción de especificaciones de producto y comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.

  • Español nativo o equivalente; inglés profesional.

Muy valorables

  • Conocimiento de contratación pública (LCSP, PLACSP, TED, CPV, ciclo de vida de una licitación) o de sectores similares de datos regulados.

  • Experiencia con productos de inteligencia de mercado, directorios o bases de datos de empresas/entidades.

  • Experiencia con bases de datos analíticas (p. ej. ClickHouse) y con datos en múltiples idiomas o jurisdicciones.

  • Experiencia con IA aplicada a extracción, clasificación o enriquecimiento de documentos.

  • Experiencia en expansión de producto a nuevos países.

Competencias clave

  • Ownership:asume la responsabilidad de extremo a extremo, del dato en bruto al valor percibido por el cliente.

  • Criterio de priorización:sabe qué fuente, qué campo o qué mejora de calidad mueve realmente el producto.

  • Pensamiento sistémico:entiende cómo una decisión en el ETL se refleja en una pantalla y en una métrica de negocio.

  • Liderazgo sin jerarquía excesiva:influye y alinea a equipos técnicos, diseño y negocio.

  • Orientación a evidencia:decide con datos y sabe cuándo el dato aún no basta.

Qué ofrecemos

  • 📄 Contrato indefinido.

  • 💰 Salario competitivo con bonificaciones basadas en el rendimiento.

  • 📈 Entorno acelerado de startup con oportunidades de crecimiento profesional.

  • 🎉 Eventos de equipo y una cultura de trabajo colaborativa.

  • 🎓 Oportunidades de formación y desarrollo profesional.

Proceso

  1. Revisión de portfolio y CV.

  2. Entrevista inicial (encaje y motivación).

  3. Entrevista con equipo de Producto y/o Ingeniería.

  4. Oferta.

Role Profile: Scrum Master

Role Summary

The Scrum Master is responsible for enabling Agile practices within the team, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Acting as a servant leader, this role removes impediments, promotes collaboration, and drives successful delivery in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives).
  • Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
  • Identify and remove obstacles to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure backlog clarity and prioritization.
  • Track and report key metrics (velocity, burndown charts) to stakeholders.
  • Ensure transparency and effective communication across teams and departments.
  • Support scaling Agile practices across multiple teams when required.
  • Drive adoption of Agile best practices and ensure compliance with organizational standards.
  • Mentor new Scrum Masters and contribute to the Agile community within the organization.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination for dependencies and shared deliverables.
  • Assist in defining and refining team goals and objectives aligned with business priorities.
  • Work closely with leadership to identify opportunities for process optimization.
  • Support risk management and proactively address delivery challenges.
  • Champion team health by monitoring workload, morale, and engagement.
  • Ensure proper use of Agile tools and maintain accurate documentation in Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Participate in release planning and help align sprint goals with release objectives.
  • Advocate for continuous learning by organizing workshops, training sessions, and knowledge sharing activities.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Certifications:

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) required.
  • Additional Agile certifications (SAFe, PMI-ACP, ICAgile) are a plus.

Knowledge, Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle and project management principles.
  • 3–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects in fast-paced, high-pressure settings.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Exposure to scaling frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) is desirable.

jobs.title: Director, Clinician Engagement
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary Clinician Engagement is a new function at DataSpring, created to deepen the relationship between DataSpring and the clinicians and provider organizations who contribute to and rely on our data.
jobs.description:
Position Summary
Clinician Engagement is a new function at DataSpring, created to deepen the relationship between DataSpring and the clinicians and provider organizations who contribute to and rely on our data. The function exists to increase trust and positive perception within the clinician user community, improve the quality of the data clinicians provide, and grow the volume of clinicians in our database, including the number who are active and attested.

The Director, Clinician Engagement leads this function. The position builds and stewards the forums where clinicians and provider staff shape our direction, develops partnerships with the provider organizations clinicians already trust, and serves as DataSpring's internal subject matter expert on clinician perspective. The role accelerates the reach and credibility of work already underway across Marketing, Product, and Insights by bringing clinician voice and clinician relationships to it.

This is role spans strategy and execution. The Director sets direction and holds the senior relationships, and also does the hands-on work of running councils, managing partner relationships week to week, and synthesizing what clinicians say into direction the rest of the organization can act on. Success depends on convening the right clinicians, earning their sustained participation, and closing the loop so they see their input reflected in what DataSpring builds and says.

The Director, Clinician Engagement is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Chief Medical Officer. This position will require the ability to travel up to 20% of the time for council meetings, site visits, association events, and industry forums.

Specific Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Input

  • Partner with Marketing and Product Strategy on a shared approach to increasing clinician awareness of and engagement with their clinician profile; in partnership with the CMO, drive strategy and execution on how best to reach specific associations, specialty societies, and clinician segments.
  • Partner with Convening function to provide subject matter expertise and input to agendas and meetings for DataSpring’s advisory councils, including the Provider Advisory Council and new clinician staff workgroup. Support the recruitment of council members who bring specialty society and partner organization relationships alongside clinical credibility.
  • Partner with Marketing to amplify campaigns through clinician and association channels and to strengthen clinician-facing messaging.
  • Partner with Product and Data Quality teams to bring clinician and provider staff needs into design and roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and Research to understand what additional value DataSpring can provide to clinicians and their staff, in exchange for completing/updating their profiles.
  • Partner with Government & Public Affairs to amplify clinician voice and perspective in DataSpring’s public policy positions, provide clinical subject matter expertise in support of legislative and regulatory analysis, and enhance government and public affairs reach to targeted clinician communities.

Provider Organization Partnerships and Industry Relations

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive clinician engagement strategy to achieve organizational goals and objectives.
  • Build and manage relationships with professional associations, specialty societies, state and national medical associations, health systems, and large group practices.
  • Develop and deliver content that supports the clinician awareness work referenced above, including webinars, podcasts, conference presentations, and partner-facing materials. May include development of continuing education content for clinicians and provider staff, coordinating with partners to deploy.
  • In addition to the CMO, serve as the relationship owner for provider organization partners, representing DataSpring credibly with clinical leadership.
  • Develop and execute co-branded and partner-led approaches that extend the reach of DataSpring programs and campaigns through trusted third-party voices.
  • Coordinate partner campaigns with Marketing from planning through measurement and prepare briefing materials and follow-ups for senior partner conversations.
  • Build and maintain a partnership pipeline with clear prioritization logic, sequencing clinician segments by value to our health plan customers.
  • Negotiate and manage partnership agreements in coordination with Legal, Marketing, Business Development, Product, and other functions as appropriate.

Subject Matter Expertise for Research, Insights, and Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on clinician and practice staff perspective, workflow reality, and what motivates clinician and clinician staff action.
  • Advise DataSpring’s Insights department on research design and interpretation so studies ask the right questions and findings are read correctly in clinician-facing/provider organization context.
  • Support research execution by recruiting participants and reviewing findings for plausibility.
  • Maintain a running view of clinician and provider staff feedback themes across forums, campaigns, and support channels, and package into concise briefs for internal partners.
  • Shape messaging and positioning toward themes that resonate with clinicians, including patient access, directory presence, referral volume, and fewer claim denials.
  • Contribute to and review external thought leadership, including reports, issue briefs, and presentations, and represent DataSpring at clinical, association, and industry forums.

Reporting

  • Define what success looks like and track key performance metrics and clinician engagement metrics covering trust and perception, data quality, and active attested clinician volume. Collaborate with departments that may source data for the metrics (Marketing, Product, etc.).
  • Report on clinician engagement progress and outcomes to the executive leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None initially. This role is expected to help shape and scale the Clinician Engagement function and may assume responsibility for managing a small team as the function matures

Skills

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative initiatives.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with provider organizations, specialty societies, and medical associations.
  • Fluency in the clinician and provider staff experience, including credentialing, attestation, provider directory data, and administrative workflow.
  • Ability to translate qualitative stakeholder input into clear, prioritized recommendations for product, marketing, and research teams.
  • Executive presence and credibility with both clinical leadership and internal executive audiences.
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to synthesize complex discussion into briefs, PowerPoint presentations, and recommendations.
  • Ability to develop and deliver clinician-facing and clinician-staff facing content, including webinars, presentations, and continuing education materials.
  • Effective at influencing without authority and at building cross-functional support for new initiatives.
  • Strong project management discipline, with comfort operating without established process and building programs from the ground up.
  • Understanding of how clinician sentiment connects to organizational priorities, with the ability to anticipate how input will be used in decisions.
  • Ability to simultaneously manage multiple initiatives and follow work plans.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong experience in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; working knowledge of CRM and survey tools is desired.
  • Maintains an intellectual curiosity about how to accomplish goals through stakeholder and industry collaboration.

Experience & Education

  • 10+ years of experience in provider relations, clinician engagement, healthcare operations, medical affairs, professional association management, credentialing, or a related healthcare field, with progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience in provider-facing, clinician engagement, medical affairs, association relations, provider network, or healthcare stakeholder management roles.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain relationships with senior clinical stakeholders, provider organizations, and healthcare industry leaders.
  • Experience leading advisory boards, councils, committees, user groups, or similar stakeholder engagement programs.
  • Experience standing up a new function, program, committee, or stakeholder forum strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a health plan, health IT, healthcare data, healthcare services, credentialing, or healthcare association environment preferred.
  • Experience with provider credentialing processes and/or credentialing committees preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, a clinical discipline, or a related field required.
  • Physicians and other licensed clinicians are encouraged to apply; non-clinical candidates with significant experience in credentialing, provider relations, professional associations, or healthcare stakeholder engagement will also be considered.

Clinical Education & Qualifications (Strongly Preferred)

  • Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree preferred.
  • Clinical experience as a physician (MD/DO) or other licensed healthcare professional preferred.
  • Active or previously active, unrestricted clinical licensure preferred.
  • Experience participating in credentialing, peer review, provider governance, medical staff, or quality-related activities preferred.
  • For physician candidates, board certification in a relevant specialty is preferred.
  • Additional certification or education in healthcare management, leadership, or business administration is desirable.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

jobs.description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:
The Senior Regulatory Counsel is a legal and compliance partner across CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM), with a primary focus on mortgage origination. The role provides legal research and regulatory guidance, gives legal support to the regulatory change function, and supervises a junior attorney. This role turns legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance, policies, procedures, and business and system requirements. The Senior Regulatory Counsel plays a key role in CCM’s compliance program.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Research and analyze federal and state laws and regulations affecting CCM’s business activities.
  • Provide clear, practical legal advice and recommendations to leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Prepare legal memoranda and written analyses on complex regulatory and compliance matters.
  • Interpret new and amended regulatory requirements and determine how they apply to CCM.
  • Partner with the regulatory change implementation function on impact assessments and communication of regulatory change to business units.
  • Support implementation of regulatory changes, including updates to policies and procedures.
  • Review and resolve escalated legal and compliance matters from the compliance inbox.
  • Evaluate borrower rescission requests and advise on required actions and timing.
  • Advise on post-closing compliance matters, including corrective actions, cures, and remediation.
  • Support power-of-attorney and trust reviews for loan transactions.
  • Manage and prioritize legal and compliance origination issues, as identified.
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based guidance for business partners.
  • Turn regulatory requirements into business and system requirements, controls, and processes for Encompass, Mavent, and other platforms.
  • Supervise, train, and mentor a junior attorney, including assigning work and reviewing work product.
  • Partner with the EVP, Regulatory Counsel on complex regulatory matters and business challenges.
  • Keep the EVP, Regulatory Counsel informed of significant matters, emerging risks, and priorities, with recommended courses of action.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) and active bar license in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 5+ years of legal or regulatory compliance experience in mortgage lending or financial services.
  • Experience interpreting regulatory changes and advising on their implementation.
  • Experience supervising or mentoring attorneys or compliance professionals, preferred.
  • Extensive knowledge of mortgage origination laws and regulations, including TILA/Regulation Z, RESPA/Regulation X, ECOA/Regulation B, HMDA, FCRA, the SAFE Act, UDAAP, and state lending and licensing requirements.
  • Advanced legal research, analysis, and writing skills, to effectively explain complex legal concepts to business and executive audiences.
  • Skill in converting regulatory requirements into operational and technology requirements.
  • Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Sound judgment to effectively manage a high volume of matters and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent collaboration, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with loan origination systems, Encompass preferred.
  • Experience with compliance technology such as Mavent.

This opportunity is for Military personnel participating in the Department of Defense SkillBridge Program. Ideally, the SkillBridge will be a minimum of 90 days in length. For more information and to speak with our SkillBridge Specialist, please submit your application and we will be in touch with you within 24 hours to schedule time to connect on the opportunities we have available, the geographic area that you are looking for and your time frame.

The SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician is an entry-level role that builds upon foundational commissioning knowledge while introducing more independent troubleshooting, testing, and reporting responsibilities. This role provides technical support in the inspection, validation, and functional testing of electrical, mechanical, and control systems.

The SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician will develop a deeper understanding of commissioning procedures, engage with vendors and project teams, will rely on instructions and take ownership of specific testing tasks under immediate supervision. They are expected to demonstrate increasing autonomy, problem-solving skills, and initiative in executing commissioning tasks.

The SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. Works under immediate supervision.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Perform On-site Inspection, Validation, Testing and Verification of Electrical and Mechanical Equipment (50%)

  • Participate in factory witness testing
  • Observe startup activities
  • Use technical equipment to perform testing
  • Perform functional testing of equipment and electrical, mechanical and controls systems
  • Troubleshoot system components

Develop Testing Plans and Procedures (20%)

  • Assist in the development of commissioning plans
  • Prepare pre-functional checklists
  • Prepare functional performance test scripts

Review Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (15%)

  • Review shop drawings and submittals
  • Review sequence of operations
  • Assist in commissioning focused design reviews

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Assist in preparation and contributes to final commissioning report

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About the Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment

About This Role


As Biogen's AI Security Engineer, you are a hands-on technical specialist responsible for securing the organization's rapidly expanding use of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. This role operates at the intersection of cybersecurity engineering and AI/ML systems — ensuring that AI deployments across Biogen are resilient against adversarial threats, data poisoning, model manipulation, prompt injection, and unauthorized data exposure.


The AI Security Engineer will design, implement, and operate security controls purpose-built for AI workloads — spanning model development pipelines, inference endpoints, training data protection, and AI-assisted automation platforms. This role is responsible for translating emerging AI threat frameworks (MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, NIST AI RMF) into actionable engineering controls that protect Biogen's AI investments without impeding innovation velocity.


This position requires a rare combination of software engineering depth, AI/ML systems knowledge, and cybersecurity expertise. The scope demands:


Deep technical proficiency across AI/ML security, cloud security, and application security — with the ability to build production-grade security tooling, not just assess or advise


Autonomous execution — independently identifying AI security gaps, designing solutions, and implementing them end-to-end without requiring constant direction


Adversarial mindset — thinking like an attacker to identify how AI systems can be subverted, manipulated, or exploited before threat actors do


Cross-domain fluency — bridging the gap between data science teams building AI and security teams protecting the enterprise, translating between both worlds.


What You’ll Do


AI Threat Detection & Response Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate detection capabilities for AI-specific threats including prompt injection, model extraction, training data poisoning, and adversarial input attacks
  • Develop and maintain AI security monitoring pipelines that correlate signals across LLM interactions, API gateways, and model inference endpoints
  • Engineer automated response playbooks for AI security incidents — including model quarantine, token revocation, and session termination
  • Continuously research emerging AI attack vectors and translate findings into detection signatures and prevention controls
  • Operate and tune CrowdStrike AI Runtime Defense (AIRD) and Microsoft Purview AI governance controls across the environment

AI Platform Security Engineering

  • Implement security controls across AI development and deployment platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, internal ML pipelines)
  • Secure model training environments — including data access controls, compute isolation, artifact signing, and pipeline integrity verification
  • Engineer guardrails for generative AI usage — content filtering, DLP integration, output validation, and session-level access controls
  • Design and enforce AI model governance controls including model registry security, version control integrity, and deployment approval gates
  • Perform security architecture reviews of new AI services and integrations before production deployment

AI Risk Assessment & Framework Implementation

  • Conduct technical risk assessments of AI systems using MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, and NIST AI RMF frameworks
  • Perform adversarial testing (red teaming) of AI models and AI-integrated applications to identify vulnerabilities before production deployment
  • Develop and maintain AI security standards, reference architectures, and secure development guidelines for AI/ML teams
  • Evaluate third-party AI services and vendor AI integrations for security posture, data handling practices, and supply chain integrity

Security Automation & AI-Augmented Defense

  • Build and maintain AI-powered security tools that augment the cybersecurity team's detection and response capabilities
  • Develop integrations between security platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Zscaler) and AI/ML systems for intelligent threat correlation
  • Engineer automated security workflows using LLMs and agentic AI for threat hunting, alert triage, and incident investigation acceleration
  • Contribute to the security team's internal AI capabilities — including MCP server development, agent frameworks, and security data pipelines
  • Build and maintain security scoring engines and risk quantification models that drive prioritization decisions

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of combined experience in cybersecurity engineering, software engineering, and/or AI/ML systems
  • Demonstrated expertise in at least three of the following domains:
  • AI/ML Security: LLM security, prompt injection mitigation, model robustness testing, adversarial ML, AI supply chain integrity
  • Cloud Security Engineering: AWS, Azure, or GCP security architecture and controls implementation at scale
  • Application Security: Secure SDLC, API security, code review, penetration testing, threat modeling
  • Security Operations: Detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR development, incident response, threat hunting
  • Hands-on proficiency with Python and demonstrable experience building production security tooling and automation
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain) and AI cloud services (SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Databricks)
  • Working knowledge of AI security frameworks: MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, NIST AI RMF
  • Experience with enterprise security platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Zscaler, CyberArk, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of LLM architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning security implications, and agentic AI patterns
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related technical field required

A Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics requires the abilities and expertise of a Process Engineer, and the technical, leadership, and communication skills of an Engineering Project Manager. From a technical perspective, they have responsibility for the overall treatment solution including strategizing on the creation of that solution (safety factors, flow fluctuations, assumptions), identifying and managing the impacts that any given unit process will have on upstream/downstream unit processes as well as process risks, and owning the overall process flow
diagram, accompanying flow and quality balance, and overall process guarantees. From a leadership perspective, they proactively communicate across the team of Process Engineers, manage the process deliverables (schedules, assignments), and represent Process Engineering in review meetings at the
bidding and engineering stages. If process issues arise, they lead the troubleshooting effort and

resolution.

As the focal point of the Process Team for projects, the Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics functions as a dual-path expert. Their time allocation is strategically divided into approximately 60% Communication, Organization, and Coordination, where they manage process deliverables, schedules, and cross-functional representation. The remaining approximately 40% is dedicated to Technical Expertise, acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the overall treatment solution, including process guarantees and the troubleshooting of complex issues.

The Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics for the Microelectronics market will lead proposals and projects in execution for our Microelectronics customers’ ultrapure water (UPW), wastewater, and reclaim treatment needs.

  • Leadership
  • Customer focus and commercial mindset
  • Analytical mindset
  • Creativity
  • Responsibility
  • Collaboration
  • Accountability

Duties and Responsibilities:

Microelectronics Project Technical Leaders lead the process design of ultrapure, wastewater, and reclaim treatment solutions for the Microelectronics industry.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Align a team of Process Engineers working together on a flow sheet to a strategy (including influent design basis, safety factors, handling of flow variations, how to meet the customer’s needs, how to win against the competition), a list of deliverables, and a schedule, and ensure that all process deliverables meet quality and schedule for the project
  • Lead the design of complete water, wastewater, or waste treatment solutions (flow sheet, unit processes, process parameters) that will meet the customer’s requirements for a given influent and required effluent stream qualities using various in house and industry design tools, acting as the leader for a team of Process Engineers providing technical expertise on specific portions of the overall flowsheet.
  • Apply advanced treatment technologies including biological treatment, ammonia removal, solids separation, low- and high-pressure membrane treatment (ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis - conventional and high-pH), ion exchange, UV treatment, and gas-transfer membrane processes to meet the stringent requirements specific to the microelectronics industry
  • Own the overall Process Flow Diagram (PFD), associated flow tables or mass balance, and overall process guarantees, including management of the interconnections between unit processes and consideration of any impacts of one unit process on upstream or downstream unit processes, with input from the Process Engineers on the team.
  • Engage in piloting and benchmarking and treatability studies as part of design, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of UPW treatment solutions
  • Serve as a lead technical contact with our customers, building partnership relationships, and representing the team of Process Engineers working on the flow sheet together
  • Serve as the lead technical contact with other functions working together on the project
  • Identify and support management of technical risks related to the treatment process (flow sheet, unit processes, achievement of outputs), including compiling the risks throughout the flow sheet in collaboration with the Process Engineers on the project team
  • Troubleshoot technical issues using data and observations
  • Understand relevant regulations and liaise with regulatory agencies as needed
  • Own and be accountable for the success of assigned projects throughout project development as measured by achieving treatment requirements (successful operation) and customer satisfaction through proactive communication, collaboration, and leadership of corrective action management, in collaboration with the team of Process Engineers on the project
  • Demonstrate Veolia’s expertise in the external market through customer and conference presentations
  • Provide training and 1:1 coaching to members of the Process Engineering team

Industry Leadership and Expertise:
A Process Engineering Project Technical Leader builds long-term relationships with customers and key experts in the industry and presents at industry conferences and technical forums to position Veolia as experts within the microelectronics market. They serve as an expert within the business, participating in innovation of solutions, technologies, and markets, and training and mentoring others in process design.

Qualifications:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to design complete integrated water, wastewater, or waste treatment solutions, including preliminary design of associated tanks, rotating equipment, piping, instrumentation, and controls
  • Ability to integrate multiple main unit operations (e.g. clarifier, MBR, RO, thermal) into a single flow sheet with consideration of recycle streams, flow variations, and a range of influent qualities
  • Demonstrated leadership skills
  • Exceptionally strong oral and written communication skills in English for customer facing communication (including presentations) as well as internal collaboration and influence
  • Proactive organization and time management
  • Excellent computer skills (i.e., Excel, Word and PowerPoint and Google Suite analogues)
  • Ability to exercise good judgement under changing conditions
  • Critical and creative thinking, and ability to evaluate among numerous options
  • Data analysis
  • Effective troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Education and Experience:
Required:

  • Bachelor or advanced degree in an Engineering field – Environmental, Chemical, or Mechanical preferred, or other technical discipline with a combination of process design and hands-on microelectronics water and wastewater treatment system experience
  • 10+ years of related experience, preferably process engineering specific, with an emphasis in process design and/or operation of water, wastewater or waste treatment
  • Demonstrated experience with UPW, wastewater, and reclaim treatment processes and system design/operation for the microelectronics industry
  • Leadership experience or demonstrated leadership competency to connect people, set and communicate a vision, align and inspire a team towards an objective, train/coach/mentor others, and confidently make effective decisions with limited information under evolving conditions

We run sales and support teams across several health and wellness brands. Everything they do runs on Salesforce, a cloud phone system and a business texting platform. When something breaks, you're the one who fixes it.

You'll be the first point of contact for 150+ users: their accounts, their phone setup and their support tickets. You'll escalate only what truly needs a system change.

This role is built for someone who doesn't need to be managed. There's no daily task list handed to you. Your work lives on a dashboard that shows every open ticket, pending request and system alert, and your goal is to keep it empty.

Job Title:SOC Engineer

Pay Type: SALARIED EXEMPT

Location:Remote (Must Work East Coast Hours)

Citizenship:U.S. Citizenship (Required)

Summary of Position Role/Responsibilities

Quzara is seeking a hands-on SOC Engineer to onboard customers into our managed security services and keep their security tooling and telemetry running reliably. The SOC Engineer works with customers and internal teams to integrate data sources, configure Microsoft security services, automate workflows, and resolve technical issues in federal and regulated environments.

Essential Functions of the Job

  • Lead technical onboarding of new customers, from discovery and requirements through configuration, validation, and handoff.
  • Configure and integrate Microsoft security services, including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Entra ID, with customer environments.
  • Onboard and validate security telemetry from identity, endpoint, network, SaaS, and multi-cloud sources, including Azure, AWS, and Google Workspace.
  • Integrate and troubleshoot log sources across multiple SIEM platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, SentinelOne, and IBM QRadar.
  • Troubleshoot ingestion and integration issues across cloud, identity, network, Windows, and Linux layers.
  • Build automation and scripts that make onboarding and operations repeatable.
  • Support customers operating under federal and regulated requirements, including FedRAMP, CMMC, and NIST frameworks.
  • Produce clear technical documentation and work directly with customer stakeholders to resolve onboarding blockers.

Marginal Functions of the Job

  • Other duties as assigned

Normal Work Schedule:

This full-time role runs Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM and requires flexibility to work remotely or on-site (if applicable per client RTO policies). On occasion additional hours may be necessary.

Education, Training, and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years in IT infrastructure, cloud, or security engineering, including 3+ years hands-on with Microsoft Azure.
  • 2+ years with Microsoft Sentinel or a comparable enterprise SIEM, including data-source onboarding.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft security stack (Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics) and multi-tenant delegated access (Azure Lighthouse, GDAP).
  • Hands-on experience onboarding a wide range of data sources (identity providers, endpoints, firewalls and network devices, SaaS applications, Syslog/CEF, API, and agent-based integrations) from Azure, AWS, and Google Workspace / Google Cloud.
  • Experience working across multiple SIEM platforms, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, SentinelOne, IBM QRadar, or similar.
  • Proficiency in KQL and scripting (PowerShell or Python), with solid troubleshooting skills across Windows, Linux, networking, and identity.
  • Strong written and customer-facing communication skills.
  • At least one current certification required: AZ-500 or SC-200.
  • Preferred: prior MSSP, MDR, or security consulting experience; experience supporting federal or defense-industrial-base customers, including GCC and GCC High environments; and experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike or SentinelOne.

Preferred Certifications

  • Ideal: SC-100 (Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert).
  • Microsoft: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), SC-401 (Information Security Administrator), MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator).
  • Cloud security: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
  • SIEM / EDR: Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, IBM QRadar SIEM, SentinelOne, or CrowdStrike Falcon (CCFA) certifications, or equivalent.
  • General security: CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, GIAC (GCDA, GCIH, or GCED).

EEO Statement

The Company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, disability, veteran's status, or any other basis protected by applicable discrimination laws.
