jobs.excerpt: AECOM is seeking a Senior BIM (Digital Design) Manager to lead digital delivery across our hyperscale data center portfolio.
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior BIM (Digital Design) Manager to lead digital delivery across our hyperscale data center portfolio. Reporting to and working alongside the Senior BIM Manager Lead, this role implements and enforces, at the project level, the firmwide BIM standards, execution plans, and coordination workflows that the Senior BIM Manager Lead owns. A central focus of the role is overseeing our U.S. BIM staff and global enterprise-capabilities (EC) partners and holding them accountable: monitoring their work against project standards, scope, and schedule, driving timely correction of deficiencies, and stepping in on the occasion project deliverables are in jeopardy of missing a deadline. This is a remote position open to candidates across the United States, with a hybrid option available for those near an AECOM office.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

1. BIM Standards & Execution

  • Implement and tailor project-level BIM standards within the firmwide framework owned by the Senior BIM Manager Lead, including BIM Execution Plans (BEP) templates, naming conventions, QA/QC checklists, and CDE folder structures suited to project type and client requirements.
  • Develop and maintain project BEP and related documentation, aligned to industry standards, NBIMs, NCIS, AIA, BIMForum and ISO 19650, and client Exchange Information Requirements.
  • Lead administration of the project Common Data Environment (CDE), such as Autodesk Forma or ProjectWise: folder structures, permissions, metadata, workflows, archival/retention, and integration with project-management systems.
  • Run BIM kickoff meetings internally, EC partners, consultants and clients for all phases.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual requirements and information-delivery milestones, flagging risks in digital deliverables to the Senior BIM Manager Lead.

2. Oversight & Accountability

  • Oversee day-to-day BIM production performed by U.S. BIM staff and EC teams, ensuring work aligns with the project BEP, standards, scope, and agreed Level of Development/Information.
  • Hold teams accountable to agreed quality, scope, and schedule: tracking progress, identifying gaps early, and driving timely correction.
  • Conduct regular QA reviews, visually inspect models, review clash and coordination efforts, advise on BIM solutions, provide model health scoring, and audits deliverables; triage issues, document deficiencies and non-compliance clearly, and escalate persistent or systemic issues to the Senior BIM Manager Lead.
  • Clarify scope and modeling expectations to teams and serve as a primary day-to-day point of contact for coordination.
  • Maintain accountability records (issue logs, audit results, deliverable status) that give the Senior BIM Manager Lead and project leadership clear visibility into performance.

3. Hands-On Production & Quality Backfill

  • Step in to produce, correct, or complete model content directly if output is late, incomplete, or below standard, to keep project deliverables on schedule.
  • Perform hands-on Revit production across disciplines as needed: modeling, sheet setup, parameter population, and corrections.
  • Resolve BIM design and modeling issues directly throughout all project phases.
  • Create smart-object content and templates to support production and reduce rework.

4. Project Delivery, Coordination & Reporting

  • Setup and/or verify project models, ensuring correct shared coordinates, base point, survey point, and model-coordination standards.
  • Establish and/or run multidisciplinary model coordination across projects: scheduled clash detection, issue triage, model health scoring, and remediation tracking, with particular attention to the high-density MEP and structural interfaces typical of data center builds (Navisworks, Revizto, Forma Model Coordination and Issues).
  • Oversee model lifecycle integration for 3D/4D/5D and incoming contractor and consultant model submittals, supporting progress reporting and cost integration.
  • Conduct regular model reviews and compliance checks across all delivery locations.
  • Report monthly on BIM KPIs, compliance metrics, and deliverable status to the Senior BIM Manager Lead and project leadership and maintain supporting dashboards.

5. Automation & Technical Enablement

  • Build and execute an automation roadmap focused on delivery needs, prioritizing Dynamo and Revit API scripts that reduce repetitive modeling, QC, and quantification tasks, especially to QA and remediate work efficiently.
  • Provide technical production support on 3D and 2D deliverables, smart-object content creation, and template development.
  • Deploy and support AECOM’s content management systems (Autodesk Content Catalogue / UNIFI).
  • Support asset information management (AIM) and digital handover for facilities management and digital-twin environments.

6. Resourcing, Training & Knowledge Sharing

  • Provide input to project estimates for BIM scope and resource schedules; help monitor utilization and recovery across assigned projects.
  • Contribute to role-based training and certification to build baseline BIM competency across U.S. and EC teams, and mentor EC coordinators and junior staff on project-standard and client-specific workflows.
  • Capture lessons learned and recurring EC deficiency patterns to refine workflows and inform the Senior BIM Manager Lead.
  • Share best practices, standards, tools, and techniques with the broader BIM team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree + 6 years of relevant experience or an Associate's Degree + 8 years of relevant experience or HS Diploma + 10 years of relevant experience in BIM/digital delivery, including 2 years of experience directly leading or coordinating multidisciplinary BIM work, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in BIM environments, including experience establishing and enforcing standards and overseeing multidisciplinary teams, preferably within the U.S. market or on U.S. projects; data center or mission-critical experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating, overseeing, and performing QA on work produced by offshore / enterprise-capabilities teams, with a proven ability to hold remote teams accountable to standards and schedule.
  • Strong hands-on Revit skills, with the ability to step in and produce or correct model content directly across disciplines.
  • Deep experience with Forma, Revit, Navisworks, and Civil 3D;
  • Working knowledge of SharePoint, ProjectWise, and project planning tools desirable.
  • Demonstrated capability in automation (Dynamo, Revit API, scripting) and delivering quantifiable process improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards, NBIMs, NCIS, AIA, BIMForum and ISO 19650 Experience with BEP authoring, QA/QC frameworks, and model lifecycle management.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and training capability.
  • Detail-oriented, thorough, and well-organized, with excellent time management and the ability to drive accountability across distributed teams.
  • Interest or experience in integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into BIM and digital-delivery workflows.
  • Relocation is not available for this role
  • Sponsorship is not available for this role
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 9, 2026.

The Associate Director translates pivotal evidence and the competitive landscape into a differentiated global access and pricing tactics as well as country-ready toolkits that enable local affiliates to secure timely reimbursement and optimal patient access at launch and across the lifecycle. jobs.description:
Job Title: Information Security Analyst

Job Type: Full-Time/Contract - 2 years (renewable)

Location: Jamaica (Remote)

RoleSummary:

Working collaboratively with the Information Security team and third-party service providers, the Information Security Analyst will contribute to the protection of the Banks information assets. The incumbent will assist in identifying and analysing security anomalies and applying mitigating actions as instructed by management. The Analyst will also assist in the management of information security risks related to the use, processing, storage, and transmission of information and the systems and processes used for those purposes.

The incumbent will assist with the embedding of policies, standards and procedures related to the effective management of the Banks security posture and will assist in the execution of security tests, risk assessments, exercises, simulations, initial investigation of security breaches, user training and other security activities as deemed necessary. The Analyst will be part of a team of information security professionals working closely with server and network operations to ensure stability of the Banks information security posture and may also be required to liaise with internal and external auditors and assist in audit reviews throughout the year.

KeyResponsibilities:

Governance and risk management:

  • Supports the manager with the completion of IT risk assessments, including information security assessments (ISAs), threat risk assessments (TRAs), vulnerability scans, penetration testing, etc., follows up on open issues, validates completion of agreed mitigating tasks and other related tasks as requested by the manager
  • Assists with the validation of identified vulnerabilities as directed by manager
  • Monitors compliance of information security policies and standards as requested by the manager. Raises incidents of non-compliance / adherence with the manager and / or relevant parties to ensure resolution and learning

Incident and problem management:

  • Assists with the collection and evaluation of information required to investigate and remediate, as necessary, alerts received from the onsite security tools and third party providers of information security services, e.g. IBM ISS.
  • Immediately informs manager of all critical events identified
  • Compiles all required information for further investigation of identified incidents
  • Provides incident response support, including assisting manager with mitigating actions to contain activity

Secrets management, as directed by the manager:

  • Assists with requests for new / modified security profiles; reviews requests to ensure completeness and prepares draft profiles for review and approval by manager
  • Assists the manager with the maintenance of the security matrices; researching changes to users authentication with the application owners and confirming the results of the security matrices tests.
  • Assists with processing requests for certificates, tokens and keys; reviews requests to ensure completeness and prepares responses for review and approval by manager

General:

  • Collects and collates data for the generation of key performance indicators and key risk indicators, as requested by manager
  • Assists with the testing of new computers, software, switch hardware and routers before implementation to ensure security posture is maintained. This includes running vulnerability scans and running configuration compliance (hardware / databases / operating systems, etc.), scans and escalating significant issues to be addressed to responsible managers.
  • Reviews and actions security compliance alerts within service level agreement (SLA) to ensure that anomalies / vulnerabilities are escalated / mitigated.
  • Other tasks that may be assigned by manager

Application and Cloud Security:

  • To ensure application code implemented meets the established secure code standards and the cloud deployments are secured, thus mitigating the risk of unauthorised access to the bank and customers data:
  • Assists, as instructed, with application security testing, coordinates tests with third party providers, and ensures that results are logged within applicable systems.
  • Undertakes cloud security tasks as assigned by the manager, coordinates tests with third party providers, and ensures that results are logged within applicable systems

Who we are

Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform. Capacity provides everything you need to automate support and business processes in one powerful omni-channel platform.

We believe that each individual voice, perspective and background brings inherent value to enhance our product, serve our customers and generate more ideas to solve complex problems. By continuing to hire talented, driven and humble teammates, we have the opportunity to see Capacity become a premier brand enterprise SaaS platform.

Capacity has raised over $100 million dollars from over 150 investors, giving us the opportunity to make ambitious investments in our team and big bets on our future. Our total addressable market is enormous. Any company that wants to grow revenue, reduce costs, and improve customer and employee satisfaction is an opportunity for Capacity to shine.

Why this job is exciting

The role:

We are seeking a highly experienced and motivated Customer Success Engineer to join our company. As the Customer Success Engineer II, you will support a growing base of enterprise customers across Brazil and LATAM. As a Customer Success Engineer II, you will be the hands-on technical owner for building and tuning Agentic Intelligent Virtual Agents (IVAs) and for implementing and supporting Agent Guidance, the structured, real-time workflow product, that walks live contact center agents through complex interactions. You will also help keep these products healthy in production, with accountability for uptime and first-line response on Sev 1 issues.

This is a remote, full-time role in Capacity Customer Success Engineering, based in Brazil and reporting to the Director of Customer Success Engineering, working closely with Project Managers, Builders, QA, Support, Solution Consultants, and Sales. Candidates outside of Brazil may be considered; however, depending on location, position would be structured as a contracting role.

In your first 30 days you will learn the platform and shadow launches, Agent Guidance deployments, and customer calls; by 60 days you will co-lead customer meetings, own IVA builds, and join the on-call rotation; by 90 days you will own a portfolio of accounts, including production uptime and Sev 1 response. Tools: Jira, Slack, Google Workspace, Smartsheet, Power BI and SQL, and the Capacity platform (training provided).

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and tune Agentic IVAs (voice and chat) on the Capacity platform, including behavioral, procedural, and RAG-based prompts, tool and API calling, and guardrails, and validate behavior against structured test scripts.
  • Implement, configure, and support Agent Guidance: build guided workflows with conditional branching and compliance and disclosure prompting, and connect them to customer systems for inbound data retrieval and outbound data capture, working alongside Capacity’s real-time Agent Assist experience.
  • Own hands-on technical integration for customer deployments: Cisco CTI integration (event mapping for screen-pop and other triggers), SIP/telephony configuration and testing, and integration with customer CRMs, service and REST APIs, and SharePoint or other knowledge sources.
  • Own the uptime and production health of customer IVA and Agent Guidance deployments: monitor proactively, resolve issues before customers notice them, and maintain runbooks and alerting.
  • Serve as the technical responder for Sev 1 issues as part of the on-call rotation: triage and reproduce, coordinate with Engineering, Support, and the Delivery team, communicate status to customers, and drive root cause analysis and post-incident follow-up.
  • Serve as the primary Portuguese-speaking technical liaison between customer technical teams (including their contact center, telephony, and systems integrator partners) and Capacity’s teams, translating client technical requirements into concrete implementation plans.
  • Localize and validate solutions in Brazilian Portuguese across dashboards, reports, and agent/admin interfaces, so customers receive a fully localized experience, not a translated afterthought.
  • Lead discovery and requirements gathering (process mapping, field-mapping matrices, integration specs) and produce the technical and functional documentation needed to scope and size delivery effort.
  • Write and execute test cases for integrations, workflows, and conversation flows prior to UAT.
  • Support production dashboards and reporting (AHT, concurrent user counts, AI question volume and response time) in partnership with Capacity’s Conversation Intelligence and BI teams.
  • Provide day-to-day technical support during POC, pilot, and UAT windows across active engagements, including assisting with UAT sessions, test-call triage, defect reproduction and logging, go-live validation, and coordination with Capacity’s Support and CSE teams on tickets.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and epic hygiene within Jira throughout each engagement.
  • Build repeatable delivery playbooks and documentation so Brazil/LATAM technical delivery and support capability scales across accounts.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, and 4+ years in a client-facing technical role
  • Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and professional working English (daily collaboration with US- and EMEA-based delivery, product, and engineering teams)
  • 5+ years building API integrations using REST, SOAP, or GraphQL, with technical fluency in JSON, logs, authentication flows, and structured data and field mapping, and strong troubleshooting instincts
  • Proficient in Python and JavaScript, with a deep understanding of relational database design for integration use cases
  • Hands-on experience integrating contact-center and telephony platforms; Cisco CTI/Contact Center experience strongly preferred, and broader SIP/PSTN integration experience also considered
  • Experience building or migrating agentic voice or conversational AI solutions, including call flow design, escalation logic, and platform-to-platform migrations, with hands-on prompt engineering, RAG configuration, guardrails, and validation of model behavior against structured test scripts
  • Experience supporting production systems, including incident response and Sev 1 escalations, and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and occasionally extend coverage during critical windows
  • Data literacy: Excel required, SQL and BI tools (such as Power BI) preferred, and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations
  • Excellent communication and consultative delivery skills: explains technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership, and leads process mapping, requirements documentation, presentations, executive updates, and escalations. This is a trusted-advisor role, not a pure execution role
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical delivery for a client, including planning, work distribution, and delivery accountability, while managing multiple accounts at once; Jira or similar agile tools
  • Preferably, based in Brazil and eligible to work in Brazil

Nice to have:

  • Experience with contact center, conversation analytics, and agentic AI
  • Working knowledge of how LLMs behave: prompts, knowledge grounding, and evaluating response quality
  • Experience in utilities, energy, or another regulated enterprise contact-center environment
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM integration patterns
  • Enterprise experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion, including standing up a new regional delivery function or playbook from scratch.
  • Watching an AI agent or guided workflow measurably improve week over week because of your insight
  • Being the trusted voice customers call first, and keeping their AI agents up and running when it matters most
  • Turning complex data into a clear story and a confident recommendation
  • Solving problems that cross technology, data, and people, and seeing them through to resolution
  • Variety: different industries, channels, and use cases, and helping organizations scale AI in production

You are motivated by:

  • Hustle: You inspire others to work as hard as you. You will find a way, no matter how hard the task is.
  • Ownership: You have an owner/builder mentality. You care about what you deliver and own your mistakes.
  • Proactivity: You don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do or what problems to solve. You are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Excellence: You set a high bar and surpass expectations. You hit your goals and ask for more.
  • Humility: You are not above any task in the organization and are willing to drop what you’re doing to help a teammate.

What you can expect from us

The team:

Capacity team members enjoy the opportunity and benefits of working at an artificial intelligence startup, but with leaders who’ve worked at places like Apple, Ebay, Visa, Answers.com, Oracle, Boeing, and many more world-class companies. The culture at Capacity encourages innovation, independent problem solving, and collaboration as we continue to mature our product in the ever-changing world of AI.

We provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (for you and your eligible dependents)
  • Profit Interest Units/incentive compensation
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • 401(k) with a company match
  • Short term disability insurance
  • Group life AD&D insurance
  • A supportive, diverse workplace where we prioritize respect for each other and our clients
  • A fun and collaborative team culture

Salary range:

  • The expected base salary for this role is between $65,000 and $75,000 USD; actual salary will be commensurate with a candidate's experience, skill and location.

Still unsure?

At Capacity we value more than just hard skills. Our goal is to build a holistic and diverse team. If you aren’t sure if you qualify, just apply! We will carefully consider your application and are always grateful for any time and effort invested in Capacity.

But wait, there’s more!

At Capacity we believe in more than just building amazing products and helping our customers. Although we are a remote workforce, we remember the neighborhood where we started. We still strive to elevate our community by furthering access to education and careers in the tech space. Our affiliated nonprofit, Create A Loop, brings rigorous computer science courses to underserved communities with little to no access to formal computer science education. There are many opportunities for our Capacity team members to serve and educate our Create A Loop students throughout the year.

ABOUT COLOR OF CHANGE

Color Of Change is the nation's largest online racial justice organization. We help people respond effectively to injustice in the world around us. As a national online force driven by millions of members, we campaign on issues of criminal justice, economic justice, voter freedom, technology and AI, and culture change and work to move decision-makers in corporations and governments to create a more human and less hostile world for Black people in America. Visit www.colorofchange.org to learn more.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Reporting directly to and working under the direction of the General Counsel, the Part-Time Executive Legal Assistant to the General Counsel will provide confidential administrative and paralegal support to the General Counsel and be a critical part of the organization’s Legal Team. This position supports the General Counsel and internal legal activities by processing litigation holds, coordinating communications, maintaining files and records, monitoring compliance with labor agreements and statutory and regulatory filings, preparing and processing documents, and scheduling meetings, travel, and related logistics in accordance with Color Of Change policies and procedures. The ideal candidate will possess superb organizational and communication skills; creative problem-solving skills; knowledge of legal procedures, process, concepts, and terminology; the ability to handle a multitude of tasks simultaneously; and the ability to adapt quickly to meet changing deadlines and priorities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Organize and maintain legal matter files, board governance documents and correspondence, contract and other legal templates, internal policy documents and written protocols, and assist with the maintenance of personnel and labor relations files;
  • Ensure efficient processing of litigation holds, discovery materials, legal correspondence and filings;
  • Format and help prepare correspondence, memos, reports, and presentations;
  • Assist in the preparation of materials and presentations to governing boards and staff, to include PPT presentations, training materials, resolutions, board minutes, charters, and other related materials;
  • Monitor and track filings, registrations, and submissions necessary for nonprofit organizational compliance, governance, and corporate good standing;
  • Identify and analyze relevant multistate and federal administrative, regulatory, and tax agency requirements and regulations;
  • Provide confidential administrative support to the General Counsel and coordinate with the People & Culture Team on labor and employee relations matters, to include monitoring compliance with the collective bargaining agreement, assisting with handling grievances and developing grievance procedures, workplace investigations, and other matters related to the implementation of the organization’s labor-relations and employment policies and strategy;
  • Independently use sound judgment and initiative to develop project timelines, anticipate organizational needs, prioritize assignments, meet deadlines, and perform complex administrative tasks;
  • Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, meetings, and events, and prepare and submit related expense reimbursement requests in accordance with Color Of Change policies;
  • Work collaboratively and cooperatively with staff and leadership in a fast-paced environment, sometimes under pressure, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient; and,
  • Other relevant duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in a legal administrative support role to an attorney, preferably in a nonprofit or internal corporate setting.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of legal terminology, concepts, forms, documents, practices, and procedures.
  • Experience working with corporate governance boards, or the ability to demonstrate a working knowledge of corporate governance and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working in a unionized environment, including familiarity with labor relations processes, union representation, and collective bargaining agreements is preferred.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and other applications, and demonstrated ability to configure templates and workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Demonstrated commitment to racial justice and equity.

MORE INFORMATION

  • Location: Remote
  • FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
  • Employees Report to this Position: No
  • Job Classification: Non-Bargaining Unit

COMPENSATION

This is a part-time, benefits-eligible position scheduled to work 25 hours per workweek. The selected candidate will have the flexibility to schedule their hours throughout the workweek in coordination with the General Counsel’s core work hours and time zone (Mountain Time). This position is non-exempt and compensated on an hourly basis at a rate of $28.00–$40.00 per hour depending on experience and qualifications. Color Of Change offers a competitive benefits package for eligible part-time employees.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

Color Of Change (COC) operates under a remote office environment. You will collaborate with colleagues around the United States. This position requires working core hours on a laptop for most of the workday, and may require additional time as necessary to perform job duties and responsibilities. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together and What We're Looking for You To Do:


The Contract Specialist serves as the primary contracts resource for Western US and Canada Division (Business Units (BUs) and Division Priorities (DPs)). Working with Contract Managers, Program Managers, Project Managers, Finance, Operations, Grants, and Legal staff, the role supports contract development, review, administration, compliance, and implementation of organizational contracting requirements across assigned areas.

Essential Functions:

Contract Management & Risk Stewardship


  • Serve as the primary contracts resource for assigned Pods, Business Units, and Division Priorities.
  • Manage intake, project consultation, due diligence review, agreement development, legal coordination, approval routing, signature management, amendments, and contract closeout activities.
  • Monitor agreement status, deliverables, contractual obligations, and compliance requirements.
  • Support contract execution and implementation activities.
  • Ensure contract compliance with organizational policies, procedures, Delegation of Authority requirements, and risk management practices.

Business Partnership & Contract Consultation


  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Grants, and Operations to support effective contract management.
  • Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Award Managers, and other staff throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Provide guidance regarding contract procedures, templates, documentation requirements, approval pathways, and organizational requirements.

Division Collaboration & Organizational Effectiveness


  • Collaborate across the Division contracts structure to ensure coordinated service delivery.
  • Participate in and support the Contracts Community of Practice (CCoP).
  • Promote consistent contracting practices, tools, and procedures across the Division.
  • Contribute to process improvements, system enhancements, organizational initiatives, and change management efforts.
  • Build productive working relationships that promote collaboration, accountability, and effective stewardship of organizational resources.

Responsibilities & Scope


  • Assigned primary responsibility for one or more Pods within the Division and may provide support across additional Pods based on workload, agreement complexity, staff expertise, cross-training needs, and organizational priorities.
  • Accountable for contract service delivery, compliance, stakeholder support, and operational effectiveness within assigned areas.
  • Exercises judgment within established policies and procedures while identifying and escalating compliance concerns, risks, and operational issues.
  • Provides contract guidance and support throughout the contracting process (influence when needed).
  • Maintains ongoing professional development and related contracting training activities.

What You’ll Bring:


  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Finance, Legal Studies, Environmental Policy, Public Administration or related field and 3 years' related experience or equivalent combination.
  • TNC Certified Contract Specialist (CCS) certification or ability to obtain certification within established timeframes.
  • Experience developing or administering contracts, agreements, amendments, or related business documents.
  • Non-profit experience in a similar role/capacity, preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply established policies, procedures, and business requirements.
  • Experience developing and maintaining productive working relationships with various internal and external stakeholders including state directors, project managers, legal and HR (influence without authority).
  • Experience using contract management systems, document management systems, financial systems, or related technology platforms.

Desired Qualifications:


  • Multi-lingual skills and/or multi-cultural experience appreciated.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, mission-driven environment.
  • Experience working in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary, or geographically dispersed organization.

Salary Information:


The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $51,600 - 63,410. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.




Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. The Finance Director – Workday ERP Transformation will serve as the lead subject matter expert for the Workday Financial Management ERP tool in the Finance department. This highly visible role will drive the design and use of the Workday ERP tool within the organization, ensuring that business and control requirements translate into scalable Workday design decisions, and leverage the tool’s capabilities effectively. This leader will guide the organization, and the finance department through the implementation, deployment, stabilization, and optimization of the Workday ERP tool and ensure alignment with associated business processes.

The Director will partner across Finance, Accounting, Technology, Data, Procurement, Human Capital, Operations, Internal Audit, and implementation teams to align Workday capabilities with enterprise processes and reporting needs. The successful candidate will bring deep Workday Financials expertise, including, ideally, knowledge of the PSA module. Guidehouse is seeking a high-energy, hardworking leader who is deeply committed to and passionate about our mission, approaches colleagues and clients with humility and integrity, and thrives in a collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead finance architect for the transition to Workday Financial Management, defining target-state, transition-state, and post-deployment architecture.
  • Lead end-to-end solution design across the Workday Financials platform, including the Foundation Data Model, general ledger, accounting, revenue, customer accounts, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, projects, assets, banking, settlements, budgeting, reporting, and analytics.

  • Guide system integration testing, user acceptance testing, finance reconciliation, conversion validation, cutover planning, deployment readiness, hypercare, and stabilization.

  • Develop the post-implementation operating model, enhancement roadmap, release governance, support processes, and continuous improvement agenda for Workday Financials.

  • Operate as a hands-on architect who can move effectively between enterprise strategy, detailed finance process design, system configuration, data, integrations, controls, testing, and issue resolution.

  • Challenge unnecessary customization and promote standardized, sustainable processes while accounting for critical business and compliance requirements.
  • Communicate complex architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Anticipate cross-functional ERP impacts and drive timely resolution of issues that could affect close, reporting, controls, business continuity, or implementation milestones.
  • Maintain strong documentation, decision discipline, quality standards, and accountability throughout the transformation.
  • Bring high energy and a strong work ethic to the transformation, demonstrating sustained commitment to and passion for Guidehouse’s mission while maintaining humility, integrity, and accountability.
  • Foster a highly collaborative environment by actively listening, sharing credit, welcoming diverse perspectives, and partnering across functions to achieve collective outcomes.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive finance, ERP, finance transformation, or enterprise systems experience, including leadership of complex implementations.
  • Deep expertise in Workday architecture, configuration, business processes, security, reporting, integrations, and deployment methodology.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a Workday Financials architect or lead solution designer for a large-scale implementation or transformation.
  • Required Workday ERP background with strong understanding of Workday finance processes, data structures, configuration, integrations, reporting, controls, and legacy-system dependencies.
  • Workday Financial Management certifications or equivalent advanced implementation credentials.
  • Proven experience transitioning from Peoplesoft or another complex legacy ERP to Workday, including architecture, data conversion, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization activities.
  • Broad understanding of ERP issues across accounting, financial reporting, planning, revenue, billing, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, projects, expenses, assets, banking, tax, payroll, master data, security, and controls.
  • Strong knowledge of finance operating models, U.S. GAAP, internal controls, segregation of duties, audit requirements, and data governance.
  • Experience leading cross-functional design workshops, architecture reviews, issue resolution, and executive decision-making.
  • Exceptional analytical, program leadership, stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.

What Would Be Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Workday Accounting Center, Adaptive Planning, Prism Analytics, Extend, Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder, web services, or related integration capabilities.
  • Finance or accounting credential such as CPA, CMA, or MBA.
  • Experience in a large, global, publicly traded, professional services, or other complex multi-entity organization.
  • Experience leading ERP operating-model redesign, finance process transformation, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.

Job details

Infrastructure Engineers implement, manage and retire the infrastructure (including physical, virtual, networking and cloud infrastructure) that supports digital services.

The agency is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior OpenShift Administrator who can navigate the monitoring, installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting and maintenance of on-premises Red Hat OpenShift clusters, particularly within the context of government services.

The ideal candidate will provide technical support, troubleshoot problems and automate solutions to ensure stable and efficient operation of OpenShift environments, with a proven ability to lead cloud projects, mentor junior staff and integrate seamlessly into a complex, dynamic team environment.

﻿

﻿﻿

﻿Key duties and responsibilities

Design, deploy, manage, and troubleshoot OpenShift or other Kubernetes clusters in enterprise environments, ensuring high availability, reliability and scalability.

Assist developers in automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerised applications using OpenShift, utilising our GitOps platform and CI/CD pipelines for efficient service delivery.

Oversee cluster management (inc. in-place cluster upgrades), resource allocation, configuration management, and capacity planning within Red Hat OpenShift environments, ensuring optimal performance and responsible resource utilisation.

Develop and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Helm to support scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.

Ensure the security of OpenShift environments by implementing best practices, including vulnerability scanning, network segmentation, and role-based access control.

Lead technical teams in the execution of OpenShift projects, mentoring junior engineers and managing project timelines and deliverables.

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, and business stakeholders, to ensure smooth operations and alignment with business goals.

Maintain comprehensive documentation of systems, processes, and best practices, and actively share knowledge with the team.

On-call duties may be required in extenuating circumstances however this is not the default expectation.

Occasional/infrequent out of hours support may be required for maintenance or supporting activities.

﻿

﻿ESSENTIAL CRITERIA
﻿
﻿1) ﻿Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related field highly desirable, or demonstrated continuous professional experience of at least 5+ years in a large scale ICT environment, and additionally 3+ years in a large scale kubernetes environment is a suitable alternative.
﻿
﻿2) ﻿Experience At least 5+ years of experience in system administering - Including experience in OpenShift/Kubernetes cluster administration. Extensive experience in Kubernetes administration - Including networking, security, storage, and troubleshooting within containerised environments. Experience in a government or highly regulated environment, with demonstrated compliance to standards such as the Information Security Manual (ISM) and Essential 8

  • Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.

Job Title: Director of Design Reports To: VP, Design & Construction Location: Dallas, TX or Remote, USA Salary Range: $117k - $190k (Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)

Summary:

Mendocino Farms is seeking a Director of Design to lead the evolution and delivery of our restaurant experience across new restaurants, remodels, refreshes, and strategic initiatives. This leader will own Mendo’s design function: the restaurant prototype, design standards, internal and external design resources, and the systems that turn brand strategy into distinctive, functional, and scalable restaurants. You will partner closely with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, and Marketing to create environments that strengthen the guest experience while supporting efficient operations, disciplined investment, and growth. This is an opportunity for a creative and operationally minded leader who can set a compelling design point of view, build a high-performing team and consultant network, and make practical decisions that balance quality, durability, speed, cost, and long-term unit performance as Mendocino Farms expands its restaurant footprint.

Responsibilities:

Lead the design function

  • Lead, coach, and develop internal designers and external design resources; set clear expectations, effective working rhythms, and a high bar for quality and accountability.
  • Align internal and external design resources to the development pipeline, identifying when specialized expertise is needed.
  • Serve as the senior design leader for complex, high-visibility, or high-risk projects and decisions.

Own the brand environment and design standards

  • Own and evolve Mendo’s restaurant prototype, design standards, material palettes, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, equipment integration, and reusable design details.
  • Ensure every restaurant delivers a recognizable Mendo experience while adapting appropriately to site conditions, market needs, and business priorities.
  • Use operating feedback, field learning, and market insight to keep the brand environment relevant, differentiated, and scalable.
  • Set and elevate Mendo’s creative design point of view, translating brand strategy into memorable, functional restaurant environments that feel distinctive across markets and formats.

Improve restaurant operations through design

  • Maintain and evolve design standards that prioritize guest flow, ordering and pickup, digital and delivery activity, seating, accessibility, storage, serviceability, and day-to-day operations.
  • Partner with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, and equipment vendors to improve kitchen planning, back-of-house flow, equipment integration, team ergonomics, throughput, food safety, and maintainability.
  • Incorporate post-opening learning into future layouts, prototypes, and specifications.

Drive quality, clarity, and design delivery

  • Oversee design delivery for new restaurants, remodels, and refresh programs from feasibility test fits and concepts through permit-ready documentation and design-related construction support.
  • Establish practical design QA/QC and phase-gate practices that produce complete, coordinated, code-aware, and timely deliverables.
  • Lead cross-functional reviews using clear agendas, advance pre-reads, recommendations, concise decision requests, and thoroughly documented follow-through.
  • Translate stakeholder input into clear direction for internal teams and consultants, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.
  • Partner with Construction to protect design intent, improve constructability, and reduce design-related rework, RFIs, and change orders.

Manage partners and investment decisions

  • Select, brief, manage, and evaluate architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors; set clear expectations for scope, quality, timing, communication, and accountability.
  • Partner with Construction and Real Estate to understand design cost drivers and make value-engineering recommendations.
  • Balance brand expression, operating performance, durability, cost, schedule, and long-term unit economics in design and specification decisions.
  • Track design-function performance, capacity, risks, and priorities; use post-project reviews to improve standards, tools, and partner performance.
  • Develop the annual design operating plan in partnership with Real Estate, including internal and consultant capacity, priorities, budget needs, and key risks; provide regular updates on design delivery.

How you’ll lead at Mendo You lead with ownership, preparation, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement mindset. You develop people and partners, create alignment through clear communication and decision-making, navigate tradeoffs constructively, and build confidence through reliable follow-through.

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant hands-on experience with restaurant or similarly operationally intensive commercial design, including prototype development, new-unit growth, remodels, and site-specific adaptation.
  • Strong command of restaurant operations and design, including FOH/BOH flow, kitchen equipment, labor and ergonomics, guest circulation and accessibility, pickup/delivery, food safety, storage, and maintainability.
  • Experience managing architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors against quality, schedule, scope, and budget expectations.
  • Working knowledge of construction documentation, design QA/QC, permitting, building and health codes, design detailing, accessibility, shop-drawing review, and constructability.
  • Financial fluency with design budgets, cost drivers, value engineering, specification tradeoffs, lifecycle durability, and unit economics.

  • Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management platforms; working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or Revit and SketchUp is preferred.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to develop concise recommendations and executive-ready presentations.

Physical Requirements

Position Title: Cardiac Device Specialist, Overnight

Location: 100% Remote (U.S. – candidates must reside in the contiguous United States)

About The Role

As a Cardiac Device Specialist at PaceMate, you'll join a team of experienced professionals dedicated to improving outcomes for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs). Working remotely, you'll use your expertise in cardiac electrophysiology and device management to analyze remote transmission data and diagnostics, interpret complex arrhythmias, and provide the accurate clinical documentation that providers rely on to guide patient care.

This role requires deep technical knowledge—you'll assess device function across multiple manufacturers, recognize abnormalities and arrhythmias, and recommend strategies to address issues. This is an overnight role with regularly scheduled shifts, that start after 11:00 pm EST. If you're passionate about applying your CIED expertise in a patient-centered environment that values compassion, integrity, and excellence, we'd like to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor patients with CIEDs using PaceMate's proprietary software

  • Analyze and interpret ECG/EGM data and device diagnostics, identifying abnormal device function and complex arrhythmias

  • Document findings accurately and professionally, communicating with providers as needed according to PaceMate's best practice standards

  • Work independently to manage your daily workflow while collaborating closely with teammates and clinical leadership to ensure efficient, accurate, and timely interpretations

  • Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and PHI protocols

  • Contribute to our patient-centered care philosophy—at PaceMate, every teammate is a caregiver whose role is to meet the needs of the patient

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum two years of recent cardiac device management experience, OR successful completion of a formal cardiac rhythm management program

  • Hands-on experience interrogating and interpreting device diagnostics for at least three of the four major manufacturers: Medtronic, Abbott, Boston Scientific, and Biotronik

  • Proficiency in ECG/EGM interpretation, including complex arrhythmia recognition

  • Moderate to advanced technical skills

  • Dedicated home workspace free from distractions, with reliable internet connectivity and the ability to work independently while engaging actively with your team throughout the day

  • Ability to pass PaceMate's candidate technical assessment during the interview process

Nice-to-Haves

  • Bachelor's or associate degree in a related field (nursing, cardiovascular technology, biomedical engineering, or similar) not required but strongly preferred
  • IBHRE Certification (CCDS, CEPS, CDRMS) not required but strongly preferred; CCT or CRAT a plus
  • Industry experience with cardiac rhythm management
  • Proficiency with collaboration tools including Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and Slack

Physical Requirements

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is consistently required to remain in a stationary position, constantly operate a computer or other office equipment, and frequently communicate with customers and employees.

  • Must be able to exchange accurate information, with the ability to effectively utilize voice over internet protocol; and repetitive motions using fingers and forearms in data entry.

  • You must only work from within the contiguous Unites States.

  • If working from, residing at a location other than your legal address that PaceMate has on file, employee must inform IT and get approval to do so.

  • PaceMate's workers shall not take Secret Pace Mate information into another country unless the permission has been obtained from Physical Security management.

Why Join PaceMate®

Benefits: Full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance; HSA and FSA options; short- and long-term disability; AD&D coverage; 401(k) retirement savings; paid time off; and additional voluntary benefits including legal insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident coverage. We also offer an employee assistance program, financial wellness resources, and discount programs.

Compensation: On top of a Robust Benefit Package, we are targeting a compensation range of $34.61 - 44.23 per hour, depending on education, experience, and certifications. This overnight shift will also be eligible for an additional $4.00 per hour for certain hours worked, our generous shift differential.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified, to perform the essential functions.

About PaceMate®

PaceMate® is a patient-centered, tech-enabled cardiac device monitoring platform serving integrated delivery networks and academic health systems nationwide. Vendor-neutral and EMR-agnostic, PaceMate connects every major device manufacturer into a single platform that sits on top of any EHR.

More than 2.3 million patients are managed on the industry’s only research-grade cardiac dataset, validated by 33 peer-reviewed publications, powering AI-driven clinical and operational analytics. A managed patient services model extends clinic capacity and ensures every cardiac device patient is monitored, every time.

Learn more at PaceMate.com

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. About the role

We are seeking a skilled BI-LIT Claims Examiner to manage litigated files and attend trials, conferences, mediations, and arbitrations. The successful candidate will:

  • Investigate and gather all necessary information and documentation related to claims
  • Evaluate liability and damages
  • Negotiate and settle claims
  • Manage litigation cases related to auto claims disputes

The BI-LIT Claims Examiner will also be responsible for maintaining electronic files, analyzing defense counsel's performance, and regularly reporting to the Claims Manager. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.

  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.
  • Curious. You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.

What we need

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  • Managing legal aspects of litigated cases, including evaluation of legal process and expenses
  • Analyzing and reviewing auto insurance claims to identify areas of dispute, investigating and gathering all necessary information and documentation related to the claim, evaluating liability and damages related to the claim, and negotiating and settling claims with opposing parties or their insurance providers

  • Reviewing legal documents and ensuring compliance with initial suit-handling plan of action
  • Serving as corporate representative for discovery review and depositions, and appearing as Corporate Representative at depositions and trials when needed
  • Analyzing policy language and reaching appropriate coverage decisions, drafting frequent and complex coverage correspondence, and proactively managing primarily litigated claim files from inception to closure
  • Directing and controlling the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters
  • Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • 10+ years of claim handling experience, with 5+ of those years handling a pending of >60% in litigation
  • Transportation litigation (rideshare, auto, trucking, etc) is preferred but those with personal lines experience should still apply if they meet all other requirements.
  • You are not intimidated by an attorney, even if you are not one! You are the driver of the litigation strategy for any particular claim. You manage the discovery in the order and timing of events and hold attorney accountable
  • Understand transportation coverages. Understand contractual risk transfer and additional insured forms
  • You have strong medical knowledge
  • You have a sense of urgency and understanding of how to manage time-sensitive demands
  • Ability and willingness to communicate both on the phone and in written form in a prompt, courteous, and professional manner
  • Strong analytical and negotiation skills. You will conduct your own negotiations directly with opposing counsel
  • Knowledge of multiple state statutes, including good faith claim handling practices, regulations, and guidelines
  • Ability to professionally collaborate with all stakeholders in a claim
  • Attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs

Benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!

  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Medefer is a pioneer in virtual-first specialist healthcare. We sit at the intersection of clinical provider and technology company. This approach has won multiple national awards for elective recovery, innovation and impact, and we now serve both NHS partners and private patients across the UK.

Medefer is built on three principles: innovate to solve real system problems, collaborate with clinicians and partners, and put patients first in every decision. As we scale across Integrated Care Systems and grow our private services, joining now means helping to define what modern specialist care looks like - and owning the financial strategy behind it.

JOB TITLE: ADHD Practitioner

REPORTING TO: Clinical Lead

LOCATION: Remote

PAY RATE: £60.00 per hour, flexible hours available

Join us in our mission to transform patient care and be part of a dynamic and innovative team. We pride ourselves on a supportive, collaborative and inclusive culture and you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of intelligent, driven and compassionate people who care deeply about transforming the way healthcare is delivered.

We are looking for a General Practitioner with an interest in ADHD to join our multidisciplinary team and help develop a service that prioritises clinical excellence, continuity and patient experience.

Our approach goes beyond a tick-box assessment. We take time to understand developmental history, gather collateral information and consider differential diagnoses and co-occurring mental health conditions, supporting comprehensive and clinically robust care.

Reporting to the Clinical Lead, you will support adult ADHD assessments, provide psychoeducation and contribute to treatment and follow-up within your competence and agreed clinical protocols.

You will join a supportive, collaborative team and have the opportunity to help shape an innovative ADHD service from the ground up, with remote working and flexible hours.

  • Providing psychoeducation, practical symptom-management strategies and non-pharmacological advice.

  • Helping patients understand treatment options and supporting them throughout their care pathway.

  • Where appropriate to your competence, initiating and managing medication titration under agreed protocols, monitoring effectiveness and side effects, and liaising with GPs about prescribing and shared care.

  • Helping develop and refine clinical pathways, improve patient experience and build a sustainable ADHD service.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:

You will be a compassionate, organised GP who values thorough assessment and continuity of care. You will be comfortable working autonomously, collaborating with colleagues and contributing to a developing service.

B2B Demand Generation Manager

Build the B2B marketing voice and demand engine for a growing fleet safety business. Urrly is hiring a B2B Demand Generation Manager for a long-established driver and fleet safety training company that has served customers since the 1980s and supports more than 5,000 active customers. The company is expanding from a historically order-driven business into recurring, technology-enabled fleet training programs for larger organizations.

This is a hands-on role for a marketer who wants to build demand in practical, relationship-driven markets: ambulance fleets, fire departments, driving schools, local governments, logistics and warehouse operators, and other organizations that manage vehicles and driver safety. You’ll turn warm customer relationships into credible stories, build industry presence through conferences and webinars, and create qualified sales conversations with the right accounts.

What You’ll Own

  • Build and execute B2B demand generation campaigns that create qualified leads, meetings, and sales pipeline.
  • Partner closely with SDR and sales teammates so marketing leads are actionable, well-defined, and followed up effectively.
  • Develop buyer-specific content such as newsletters, webinars, white papers, guides, blog posts, thought leadership, customer interviews, case studies, and sales enablement assets.
  • Help activate existing customers who are already warm to sharing their stories through testimonials, case studies, interviews, and conference-friendly content.
  • Own conference and event strategy: identify the right shows, plan pre-event outreach, support event materials, attend key events, capture leads, and run post-event follow-up.
  • Build and maintain target account and prospect lists using research, enrichment, CRM, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Segment audiences by industry, buyer persona, and funnel stage so campaigns speak to the right problems.
  • Track what is working across campaigns, lead quality, conversion, meetings, opportunities, and sales feedback.
  • Use AI and modern tools to move faster while keeping the work specific, credible, and grounded in real customer insight.

What Makes This Role Different

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll write, build, interview customers, test ideas, prepare for shows, and improve the way the company shows up in the market.

The highest-return work here is relationship-based: conferences, industry partnerships, customer proof, webinars, and practical content that earns trust with fleet, safety, training, and operations buyers. Paid media, SEO, and e-commerce are not the center of this role.

What We’re Looking For

  • Hands-on B2B marketing experience in demand generation, growth marketing, content marketing, field/event marketing, or a closely related role.
  • Evidence that you have personally built or meaningfully contributed to campaigns for business buyers.
  • Strong writing ability and comfort creating original B2B content grounded in customer insight, clear positioning, and thoughtful editing.
  • Experience with content formats such as case studies, newsletters, webinars, thought leadership, educational guides, customer stories, or sales assets.
  • Comfort learning an unfamiliar market through customer conversations, subject-matter experts, industry research, and sales feedback.
  • Experience partnering with sales or SDR teams to connect marketing activity to qualified conversations and pipeline.
  • Ability to work with CRM, enrichment, email, automation, reporting, and AI tools to improve list quality and campaign execution.
  • Good visual judgment and the ability to create or coordinate polished, professional marketing materials.
  • Comfort working with significant overlap with U.S. business hours and traveling within the U.S. for industry conferences.

Backgrounds That Could Fit

Direct fleet safety, driver training, EMS, telematics, public safety, or transportation experience is a plus, but it is not required. Adjacent experience can transfer well, especially if you’ve marketed to practical B2B buyers such as industrial operators, automotive dealerships, facilities teams, property managers, logistics teams, or similar audiences.

Agency, in-house, freelance, and startup-style backgrounds can all fit if you can show strong personal ownership, real output, and an ability to get excited about a hands-on market.

Compensation & Work Model

  • Base salary: $90,000–$110,000
  • Bonus: 10–15%
  • Work model: U.S. remote, with significant overlap with U.S. business hours
  • Travel: U.S. industry conferences and events

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

Job Title: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

Location: Regionwide/Fully Remote

Employment Type: Contract - 1 year (renewable).

Job Overview

The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client within the banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

PCI DSS Compliance Management:

  • Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.
  • Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.
  • Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCIDSS certification audits.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation:

  • Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.
  • Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.
  • Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
  • Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Training and Awareness:

  • Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with projects, Enterprise Security, Technology, and other relevant departments to align PCI DSS compliance with overall security policies and practices.
  • Proactively identify and/or promptly escalate risks and issues affecting PCI compliance status.
  • Stay updated on changes in PCI DSS requirements and industry best practices to ensure that the organization remains compliant.
  • Present PCI DSS compliance status reports to senior management and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison where necessary between the organization and external vendors or service providers involved in processing or storing cardholder data.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

Experience:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.
  • Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.

Certifications:

  • Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.
  • Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross functionally.
  • Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).


Other Requirements:

  • Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.

Good guardianship of member confidentiality and identity is required. Candidate must demonstrate professional telephone etiquette with the ability to build rapport with customers in a heavy blended (inbound and outbound) call environment.

jobs.excerpt: 🤙🏼 About gaiiaAt gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers.
jobs.description:
🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, flexible vacations, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

We're looking to hire a Data Migration Engineer to own the technical execution of data migrations that move customers from legacy systems into gaiia. You'll join the Migration Solutions team, which owns the end-to-end delivery of customer migrations. Within that team, you own the data — exploring source systems, exporting it, transforming it into gaiia's standard format, and driving its execution to a validated, production-ready state.

You'll partner closely with the Data Migration Specialist — who owns the customer relationship and migration design — working from the business context and mapping rules they hand off. You'll also work alongside the Migration Platform team, who build and maintain the internal tooling that runs migrations: you'll live in it daily, improve it where you can, and specify the larger needs for them to build. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who likes turning messy, real-world data into something clean, repeatable, and trusted.

💻 What You're Going to Do

  • Explore legacy source systems (databases, flat files, reports, APIs) to understand their structure, quality, and relationships in the context of gaiia's data model.
  • Export source data across a range of access methods — SQL, APIs, manual extracts, and database backups.
  • Transform exported data into gaiia's standard format by authoring declarative, version-controlled mapping files that encode the business rules defined with the Data Migration Specialist.
  • Execute migrations end-to-end on the internal migration platform: load, validate against target schemas, reconcile, and import to production.
  • Build and reuse mappings, templates, and validation rules so each migration is faster and more repeatable than the last.
  • Contribute small engineering improvements to the migration tooling — new validation rules, transforms, mapping updates — and raise larger needs to the Migration Platform team.
  • Diagnose and resolve data discrepancies during dry runs, UAT, and post-cutover.
  • Document mapping specs, transformation logic, and data anomalies so migrations are auditable and repeatable.

🧠 What Success Looks Like

  • Source data lands in gaiia accurately, completely, and on schedule, with discrepancies caught before go-live.
  • Transformation and validation work is reusable — later migrations build on your templates and rules rather than starting from scratch.
  • Data issues are diagnosed and resolved quickly, keeping migrations on schedule.
  • Tooling gaps are either fixed directly or clearly specified for the Migration Platform team.
  • The data you deliver is trusted — accurate and well-documented enough to present to customers with confidence.

🎖️ Qualifications

  • Experience (3-5+ years) in data engineering, data migration, ETL, or a similar hands-on data role.
  • Strong command of ETL fundamentals — you treat extract → transform → load as a deliberate methodology: staging, repeatable/idempotent loads, full vs. incremental loads, and validation and reconciliation at each stage.
  • Hands-on data-manipulation fluency — comfortable querying, profiling, and reshaping data across languages (SQL, Python, JSON, or similar) and debugging issues in unfamiliar source schemas.
  • Experience extracting data from a variety of sources: relational databases, APIs, flat files, and backups.
  • Proven ability to transform messy, poorly documented data into clean, structured output.
  • Solid grasp of data quality, validation, reconciliation, and cleansing techniques.
  • Familiarity with OSS/BSS, telecom, or billing/CRM data models (e.g. subscribers, services, billing accounts) — or the ability to ramp on unfamiliar domain models quickly.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript (Node) for data and tooling work, and comfort with version-controlled, repeatable transformations.
  • A bias toward reusability and automation over one-off scripts.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with shifting source systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

✅ Nice-to-have

  • Comfort using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate data exploration, mapping, and validation.
  • Familiarity with building or extending an internal data platform or migration tooling.
  • Exposure to cutover/go-live operations: delta loads, reconciliation, and rollback.
  • Experience collaborating with a separate platform or product engineering team.

💰Salary

At gaiia, we have a transparent salary philosophy and a robust evaluation and compensation framework. It translates to a fair and impartial model where salaries are published internally, healthy discussions about compensation and performance can exist, and taboos are removed.

🔆 Benefits

  • Flexible 25-days of vacation.
  • Stock Options Plan.
  • Group Insurance.
  • Telemedicine.
  • Life Spending Account.
  • GRSP.
  • Flexible working hours & all-remote work.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Our workplace is fully remote and boasts accessible technologies, ensuring all team members can thrive. Should you require accommodations due to a disability during the application process, please contact us at 581-996-9639 or as per the Accessible Canada Act and human rights legislation. We're here to support you every step of the way.
