  • Demonstrated experience within the medical device industry or another highly regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, diagnostics, aerospace, or healthcare technology.
  • Proven experience managing global supply chains, international logistics, and inventory planning functions.
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing third-party logistics providers, distribution partners, and transportation networks.

Success in this role includes:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Digital Product Strategy and Innovation Manager (AI)

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We are seeking a Senior Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Lab Product Management Team. This role will lead the identification, evaluation, and validation of high-potential AI and data-driven opportunities across Amgen, shaping strategic opportunities and providing evidence-based recommendations that inform enterprise investment and scaling decisions.

The Senior Digital Product Manager will establish product discovery and validation approaches that enable Amgen to determine where AI can create meaningful business and patient value, where opportunities warrant further investment, and where initiatives should be redirected, paused, or stopped.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.

  • Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.

Navigate competing perspectives and drive clarity and decisions in ambiguous or high-impact situations.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Senior Digital Product Manager professional we seek has these qualifications.

This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a UX Researcher to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust. The Chesapeake Bay Program Office (CBPO) is a unique regional partnership that is responsible for the restoration of the Chesapeake Bay. CBPO partners include the states of Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Delaware, New York, West Virginia and District of Columbia as well as other Federal Agencies and Universities. The US Environmental Protection Agency represents the Federal Government in an effort to protect the Chesapeake Bay and better coordinate water quality and restoration efforts throughout the Chesapeake Bay watershed. The Chesapeake Bay Program Office (CBPO) Data Center is the focal point for supporting the development of critical decision support tools, the data sharing enterprise and supporting scientific computing across the partnership. Background Koniag Government Services (KGS), an Alaskan Native Corporation, that staffs EPA-CBPO Data Center at the Chesapeake Bay Program Office has an immediate need for a skilled UX Researcher who can provide systematic investigation of an important and widely used modeling platform known as the Chesapeake Assessment and Scenario Tool (CAST). The UX Researcher will interact with CAST users and better-understand their needs with the goal of adding context and insight into the UX design process of a prototype of a spatially explicit CAST interface. The UX Researcher will be asked to deliver creative UX solutions as well as associate data communication products for the “next generation” of the CAST application. This web-based modeling tool is a nitrogen, phosphorus and sediment load (pollutant) estimator tool that streamlines environmental planning and can be used to answer questions about the effect of different BMPs (Best Management Practices) on water quality. Users specify a geographical area, and then select best management practices (BMPs) to apply for that area. CAST builds the scenario and provides estimates of nitrogen, phosphorus, and sediment load reductions. The cost of a scenario is also provided so that users may select the most cost-effective practices to reduce pollutant loads. It is planned that the CAST Application will undergo further development with added tools to include a spatially enabled visualization feature. These enhancements will provide spatially explicit estimates and data that will help CAST be understood, used and supported by partners and stakeholders with a wide range of technical knowledge. The UX Researcher will work closely with Water Quality Scientists, Software Developers, Stakeholders and also work along-side modelers to utilize various methodologies and techniques about usability testing and analytics to gather valuable data about CAST users and their behavior. A role for this UX Researcher will be to act as a bridge between the user and the Koniag/CBPO product team, serving to decipher user needs and preferences to inform UX Design decisions while maintaining functionality and improving accessibility.

UX Researcher Duties at the CBPO:

  • Collaborate with KGS software designers and CBPO stakeholders early in the CAST Next Generation process for research needs.
  • Work closely with KGS software developers and CBPO stakeholders to identify research goals and priorities.
  • Define research questions about CAST and choose optimal data collection methods for a spatially explicit CAST application.
  • Craft research questions about CAST new functionality and select the appropriate methodologies to answer them.
  • Work with the KGS Team to develop, plan and manage resources thoughtfully in order to develop the spatially explicit CAST application prototype by Spring 2027.
  • Identify suitable CAST participants to ensure user feedback by collaboration with the KGS product team and stakeholders.
  • Transform findings into actionable insights for the spatially explicit CAST application that will help guide new functionality decisions.
  • Present and effectively communicate findings about spatially explicit CAST needs to designers, software developers, and CBPO stakeholders.
  • Work with CBPO Web and Development Teams to inform and provide guidance for the development of wireframes and design mock-ups.
  • Work with CBPO Web Team to develop improved information architecture and design options for CAST, as well as associated data communication products.

Other Desirable UX Research skills for the CBPO:

  • The ability to effectively convey ideas and research findings in an articulate manner.
  • Understanding the perspectives of current CAST users and understanding their needs for a spatially explicit CAST design.
  • Applying Design thinking principles for problem-solving and innovation that will apply to a spatially explicit CAST application.
  • Asking the right questions in meaningful ways to uncover deeper insights and opportunities for innovation for Spatial CAST.
  • Critical Thinking for problem solving by analyzing complex problems and developing creative solutions for the next generation of CAST.
  • Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams such as the KGS development team, the CBPO web team, and other CBPO stakeholders.

Education and Experience:

  • Candidate must have a BA/BS degree.
  • Must also have a minimum of 3 years of experience in UX Research or UI/UX Design for digital products or services.
  • Successful candidate is subject to a background investigation by the government and must be able to meet the requirements to hold a position of public trust.
  • Must speak fluent English

The ideal candidate will bring a diverse IT and/or Management Consulting background and knowledge of Health & Life Sciences industry trends, leveraging this credibility as a strategic advisor to our customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce. The candidate will be able to craft innovative, forward-looking strategies while clearly defining the path forward, leading the changes to IT strategy, policies, processes, people, governance and partnerships, and translate program delivery into measurable business outcomes.

Health & Life Science Program Advisory Directors advise and support cross-functional teams deploying cutting-edge digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex biomedical data and actionable healthcare insights, driving the next frontier of life sciences innovation, while leveraging AI tools and agentic workflows themselves to accelerate governance reviews, risk monitoring, and program health tracking across the portfolio of accounts they oversee.

Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

The full engagement is yours to guide: you are accountable for overseeing and improving the quality of end-to-end service delivery and ensure program risk is identified and managed effectively. You help protect bid-versus-delivered margin on the accounts you advise by surfacing risk and governance gaps early.

Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure system satisfaction, adoption, and consumption directly deliver profound customer impact.

Senior Analyst People Change Management - Caribbean (Remote)

The Senior Analyst, People Change Management leads and supports people change management efforts for assigned major transformation projects and programmes within the Bank. The incumbent provides guidance and advice on change management methodology, assisting stakeholders / impacted constituents from the current state through a transition state and finally implementation to drive the desire, usage, and adoption of the solution.

MAIN ACCOUNTABILTIES

Main responsibilities, broken down by action, objective and end result / outcome:

1. Action (verb)

Develops

Object / what it involves

people change management strategies and plans for assigned major projects and programmes, in collaboration with the Associate Director, analysing stakeholders, defining change

objectives, and assessing impacts on constituent groups

End result / outcome

to address the needs and concerns of impacted groups to ensure effective and efficient implementation within budget and timeframes, enabling benefits realization and successful adoption.

2. Action (verb)

Partners

Object / what it involves

With project stakeholders and sponsors / business SMEs to identify and assess the people-related impacts of the change initiative, including new technologies, processes, structures, and

regulations

End result / outcome

to better understand the needs, expectations, and concerns of each stakeholder group and how these can be mitigated for those affected by the change to enable optimum adoption and business

realisation of benefits.

3. Action (verb)

Identifies & assesses

Object / what it involves

Resistance to change by providing / undertaking individual and group support sessions, identifying possible resolutions to potential blockers

End result / outcome

To reduce resistance / adverse effects on the change outcome and deliver on the strategic objective of the change initiative.

4. Action (verb)

Coordinates

Object / what it involves

change activities with change partners, project managers, and business sponsors, establishing clear roles and responsibilities and maintaining regular

communication

End result / outcome

to ensure alignment, optimum adoption and mitigate change saturation.

5. Action (verb)

Designs & implements

Object / what it involves

tailored training and coaching programmes and materials, in collaboration with the Talent Acquisition & Development team as required and maybe required to facilitate on occasion.

End result / outcome

to enable employees to acquire the necessary knowledge and skills for successful change adoption.

6. Action (verb)

Facilitates

Object / what it involves

the consistent presentation of new process and technology design elements in all media (internally & external), e.g., presentations to be delivered at meetings, web sites, memos, speeches, print, etc. in collaboration with Marketing & Communications

End result / outcome

to ensure all users understand and accept impacts on roles, policies and business impacts to minimize any potential organizational obstacles and educate audiences (including customers) of the change.

7. Action (verb)

Contributes & supports

Object / what it involves

to the people change management practice development initiatives, including the development of new methodologies, tools, and emerging

change techniques

End result / outcome

To enhance the quality and effectiveness of change management within the Bank.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Experience / Knowledge

  • A minimum of 5 years of banking experience, with experience in some aspects of the people change management.
  • Previous experience facilitating collaborative design sessions (remote and in- person) utilising innovative techniques and tools, e.g., design thinking, people change management, MURAL, SharePoint, Teams, etc.
  • Previous experience leading organizational change management activities, e.g., communications, stakeholder impact, training, workshops, design- thinking sessions, etc.
  • Experience interacting and negotiating buy-in with staff at all levels of the organisation, including executive stakeholders.
  • Good Knowledge of the Bank’s people change management strategy, principles, and underpinning methodologies.
  • Knowledge of the functional complexity, business objectives and overall operations of the Bank.
  • Good understanding of most of the Bank’s major systems, e.g., Fiserv Signature, TSYS, FSM, etc.

Required Qualifications

  • Certificate in People Change Management from PROSCI or another recognized change management body.
  • College diploma or undergraduate degree in human resource management or other suitable discipline would be an asset.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Core Competency & Level of Proficiency

i. Client Orientation (Stage. 2Masterful)

ii. Change Adaption (Stage. 2Masterful)

iii. Solution Orientation (Stage. 2 Masterful)

iv. Cultivates Connections (Stage. 2 Masterful)

v. Effective Communication (Stage. 2 Masterful)

  • Optimizing CPU, GPU and NIC sub-systems for predictable low-latency and maximum throughput

  • Understanding of the PHY/MAC layer procedures and typical performance tradeoffs, as well as overall system performance.

  • Background with LTE/5G MAC and PHY from both systems and low-level 3GPP spec point of view. Ability to switch between high-level systems view and low-level detail view of complex wireless systems.

  • Comfortable using wireless lab equipment such as signal generators, network analyzers, power meters, etc. Exposure to CUDA/GPU programming is a plus.

  • Ability to work as an individual contributor or take a technical leadership role. Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with management and engineering.

jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Workplace Intern

Remote within the US

World Vision Internships offer a three-month opportunity for talented students and recent graduates eager to dive into the international relief and development field. We are dedicated to giving you a meaningful learning experience, where you will grow, gain valuable skills, and connect with other passionate professionals who share our mission.

Internship Opportunity

At World Vision International, Global Marketing, Communications & Sponsorship (GMCS) helps connect supporters, partners, communities, and teams around the world with the organization's mission to serve vulnerable children and communities. Within GMCS, the Strategy, Planning and Performance Team helps teams work together effectively by improving planning, collaboration, and delivery across global initiatives.

The Knowledge Management and Community Engagement function supports this work by helping teams find, organize, share, and reuse trusted knowledge. Using tools such as SharePoint and Microsoft 365, the team creates practical digital workplace solutions that make information easier to access, reduce duplication, and strengthen collaboration across a global organization.

As the Digital Workplace Intern, you will play an active role in building and improving digital experiences used by teams around the world. You will help create SharePoint sites, manage content, support reporting tools, and contribute to projects that improve how colleagues collaborate and share knowledge. Through your work, you will support World Vision's commitment to stewardship, collaboration, and service, helping teams work more effectively in support of children and communities worldwide.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and Enhance SharePoint Sites and Pages: Create and update SharePoint pages using approved templates, content, and branding standards. You'll configure layouts, navigation, web parts, and page components while ensuring a consistent and user-friendly experience.
  • Manage Document Libraries and SharePoint Lists: Support the creation and maintenance of document libraries and SharePoint Lists that help teams organize information and track work. You'll help configure metadata, columns, views, permissions, and other features that improve information management.
  • Organize and Migrate Digital Content: Review, categorize, and migrate files into clear and consistent structures. You'll help improve file organization, naming standards, content placement, and link management so global teams can find information more easily.
  • Conduct Quality Assurance and Testing: Test pages, permissions, links, layouts, and configurations before publication. You'll identify issues, document findings, recommend improvements, and help ensure solutions are accurate and ready for use.
  • Support Project Tracking and Coordination: Maintain project trackers, action logs, and status updates across multiple initiatives. You'll help keep projects organized, follow up on assigned tasks, and provide concise progress updates to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to Reporting and Insights: Assist with maintaining Power BI dashboards and reporting tools. Depending on project needs, you may help verify data, update information, and improve how insights are presented to decision-makers.
  • Explore Digital Workplace Improvements: Support ongoing enhancements across Microsoft 365 platforms. This may include exposure to Power Automate, Power Apps, accessibility practices, content design, user experience improvements, and knowledge management initiatives.
  • Collaborate Across Global Teams: Work alongside colleagues from marketing, communications, sponsorship, and support functions around the world. You'll contribute to real business solutions that are actively used by teams across World Vision.

Why Join Us:

  • Gain Hands-On Experience with Real Projects: This is a highly practical internship where you'll contribute to solutions actively used across a global organization. Rather than observing from the sidelines, you'll take ownership of meaningful work and see the impact of your contributions.
  • Develop In-Demand Digital Workplace Skills: You'll build practical experience with SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, information architecture, content management, reporting tools, and digital collaboration solutions that are valuable across many industries.
  • Learn from Experienced Professionals: Receive regular coaching, feedback, and guidance from professionals working in digital workplace, knowledge management, communications, and technology. You'll gain insight into best practices and professional project delivery.
  • Strengthen Professional and Project Management Skills: Through managing priorities, gathering requirements, solving problems, and communicating with stakeholders, you'll build confidence and develop skills that support long-term career success.
  • Explore Emerging Technology and Innovation: Depending on your interests and project assignments, you may gain exposure to Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, accessibility practices, user experience design, content strategy, and digital workplace innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

    • Co-leads the clinical trial team with the CSL with per needed-basis oversight from the Study Director-community Lead (SD-CL) and support from the Clinical Operations Program Head (COPH), delivery of multiple medium to complex global studies and promotes learning, sharing, consistent performance, and operational excellence through an agile mindset, agile principles, and a team of teams’ model

    • Guides planning and decision making at the study level and delivers assigned clinical study/studies per the Operational Execution Plan (OEP) and clinical study protocol

    • Proactive risk management and inspection readiness
    • Responsible for developing clinical study timelines with per needed-basis oversight from the Study Director-community Lead (SD-CL) and support from the Clinical Operations Program Head (COPH), and overseeing assigned study budgets

    • Fosters a close working relationship with SSO Clinical Project Managers (CPMs) to strengthen the relationship between the global and local teams

    • Fosters a close working relationship with the Vendor Partnerships & Governance (VPG) Trial Vendor Managers (TVMs) to strengthen the relationship between the vendors and CTT to deliver on clinical study objectives

    • Experience in managing people globally in a complex matrix environment preferred
    • Management of virtual teams. Proven ability and strong experience leading teams and building capabilities
    • Experience in developing effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
    • Excellent communicator and presenter (oral and written); ability to communicate at all levels
    • Excellent organization and prioritization
    • Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills and enterprise mindset
    • Strong project management skills and demonstrated ability to meet timelines
    • Proven track record in trial operations process improvement(s) in some aspects of clinical trials
    • Superior strategic thinking with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Desirable Requirements:

    • Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area strongly preferred
    • Advanced degree is strongly preferred

  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • CaseWare license and AI training provided
  • Own a simulated client portfolio and work alongside an AI partner from day one
  • Long-term, permanent role at the cutting edge of AI development in accounting where your judgment directly shapes the AI that accountants will use

What You'll Work On

The AFS Cycle, End to End

  • Check each client's year-end pack including trial balance, account detail, bank certificates and statements, fixed asset register, and loan agreements, and request anything missing before starting
  • Agree last year's signed AFS to this year's opening balances and document any differences and the reason for them
  • Match client account names to CaseWare account numbers and lead sheet codes, build the import file, and load the trial balance
  • Tie bank balances and interest to the bank's IT3(b), foreign balances to a documented exchange rate, and creditors and income in advance to the client's detail
  • Post year-end journals for depreciation from the fixed asset register, deferred tax, prior-year tax adjustments, and client reclassifications, each with its supporting document
  • Roll forward the CaseWare file, update notes and comparatives, and prepare the tax computation
  • Clear AI partner review notes in writing and update the file
  • Prepare the final signing pack including final AFS, final trial balance, adjusting journals, tax computation, engagement letter, and loan agreements for director approval

Building AI for Accounting

  • Prepare each simulated AFS to a professional standard so it serves as high-quality training data
  • Record the steps, decisions, and judgments behind your work in a way that can be taught to an AI model
  • Design and refine the AFS workflows the AI follows, step by step
  • Test the AI against your own work, identify where it goes wrong, and help fix it
  • Use AI models day to day to map accounts, draft notes, and check your own work, and apply sound judgment about when their output is correct

Ongoing File and Portfolio Management

  • Flag turnover above the R2.3m VAT registration threshold when a client is not registered
  • Save the final trial balance and journals with the signed AFS and move superseded versions out of the way
  • Handle requests to simulated client management and bookkeepers to obtain missing or unclear records
  • Rework the AFS when a simulated client raises changes after the signing pack goes out

What You Bring

  • BCom in Accounting, National Diploma in Accounting, or equivalent
  • 0 to 2 years of experience in an accounting practice including AFS preparation during articles or a learnership
  • Hands-on CaseWare experience including file setup, trial balance import and mapping, roll-forward, adjusting journals, and updating notes and comparatives — this is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IFRS for SMEs and the Companies Act
  • Comfortable with deferred tax, depreciation, and a company income tax computation
  • Strong Excel skills including lookups, lead schedules, and reconciliations
  • Clear, polite written English for client requests and review responses
  • Genuine interest in AI and in breaking accounting work into clear, teachable steps
  • Comfortable working with AI models and able to check and challenge what they produce

Nice to Have

  • Experience drafting AFS in Draftworx
  • Exposure to Xero, Sage, or Pastel client systems
  • Experience with independent review engagements
  • Registered as a trainee with SAIPA or SAICA, or working towards it

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your CaseWare AFS preparation experience, and walking through your process from trial balance import through to a completed and reviewable CaseWare file

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a detail-oriented AFS accountant with hands-on CaseWare experience, a solid grasp of IFRS for SMEs, and a genuine interest in shaping how AI learns to do accounting work, this role gives you the ownership, the AI partner, and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Mission Alignment

  • AI/LLM Proficiency:

  • Growth Mindset & Learning Agility:

  • Business Acumen:

Our Seed round was massively oversubscribed and saw many of our enterprise customers and prospects investing directly.

jobs.description:
University Admissions Counselor – Traditional Ground Campus –Grand Canyon University


Come Grow With Us


Grand Canyon Education (GCE) is a rapidly growing educational service company that has long been an industry leader in providing educational, operational, and technological support services to the post-secondary education sector. Formerly part of Grand Canyon University (GCU), GCE still works closely with GCU to benefit thousands of students, families, and the local inner-city community. We put people first, drive innovation, and do good in the community that we live and work in.


Join us at Grand Canyon Education and begin your career helping Grand Canyon University- Traditional Ground Campus students succeed!


We are looking for a motivated University Admissions Counselor to oversee the California territory in this unique remote opportunity (work from home in Phoenix, AZ with frequent travel to CA). Starting salary is $58,656 per year with a tenure-based compensation plan that allows you to increase your earning potential upon the completion of each year-long recruitment cycle.


Who you are:


* Must live in or near Phoenix, AZ*


You find fulfillment in serving others and are passionate about the power of education. You’ve demonstrated success as a team player who hustles, is adaptable to change, and does everything intentionally.


You know it’s not all about achieving your goals. While that does get you excited, what you really thrive on is making a positive impact on the world by helping high school students make one of the most important decisions in their lives through a quality education and community at Grand Canyon University’s campus in Phoenix, AZ.


Now is the time to bring your talents to Grand Canyon Education, where you’ll have the opportunity to be involved in your local community and play an integral role in helping Grand Canyon University students find their purpose from application through their first few weeks on campus. Here’s a taste of how you’ll make your mark as a University Admissions Counselor with us.


As a University Admissions Counselor, every counselor:

  • Has a servant’s heart. You’ll be involved in the community through hosting and implementing event/activity plans for your territory that build awareness of our academic programs and campus community and drive inquiry generation. Through a variety of mediums, you will use your passion for serving others to provide exceptional counseling to prospective students and their families. Whether in-person, over the phone, via email, text or Zoom, you will champion the GCE mission, promoting Grand Canyon University student success and institutional growth.
  • Hustles. You’ll be busy using your unique ability to connect with community college students, faculty and staff in local community colleges and engage all major stakeholders in your territory, while maintaining a full schedule that includes fairs, school visits, presentations, community/campus events and hosting campus visits.
  • Bleeds purple. You’ll take pride in being the face of Grand Canyon University in your territory and will not only promote our transformation, but you will get to be a part of it.
  • Is purposeful. This is a work from home role with ambitious targets! Working independently, you’ll be using your out-of-the-box critical thinking skills to support prospective Grand Canyon University campus students and families through the admissions process, guiding them on the right path towards a successful campus experience.

The role might be right for you if you have:

  • A bachelor’s degree. No delinquent or in default on a federal student loan as verified in your credit report. If in a rehabilitation program, your credit report must reflect that you are current, not delinquent, on your payments.
  • Outstanding time management and organization skills. In this role, you’ll be wearing many hats, so you’ll need to show that not only have you honed your time management skills, you also know how to organize and prioritize competing priorities even while travelling.
  • Clear communication and engaging presentation skills. You can explain just about anything to anyone and you’re comfortable communicating in person, in writing and on the phone. You are confident and can engage any room while presenting no matter what audience is in front of you. You’ll also need to have well developed listening skills.
  • Self-motivation and drive to succeed. You volunteer for new challenges without waiting to be asked and love to go above and beyond what’s expected. You’re going to take ownership of the time you spend with Grand Canyon University students and truly make a difference.
  • High emotional intelligence. In this role, you’ll be coaching a diverse range of Grand Canyon University students and families, each with unique circumstances. You’ll also have relationships with community colleges and their staff to develop and nurture. Ability to demonstrate empathy is key to success in this role.
  • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, a flexible schedule and is willing to travel. Since this role requires extensive travel in your territory, you’ll need a clean driving record and ability to use your personal vehicle. Some events require evening and/or weekend availability. For those who reside outside of Phoenix, you can expect to travel here 1-3 times per month.
  • Computer literacy. As part of a remote workforce, we rely on a number of digital tools to help you execute your work and keep you accountable. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is required.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Attended Grand Canyon University on campus and as an Alumni, can share your experience with prospective students.
  • Relevant industry related professional experience.
  • Experience working with CRM tools.

What we’ll offer in return:

  • A career where your work makes a difference.
  • A stable income with a good salary.
  • Opportunity to own your part of the business without the risks of owning your own business.
  • Ongoing professional development and growth.
  • Outstanding benefits and work perks.
  • Collaborative and supportive work environment. ...and more!

Job Description Summary

This role provides quality oversight for AI and machine learning-enabled medical devices, including SaMD. The position supports the full product lifecycle, from design and development through software release, design transfer and post-market activities. Working across engineering, clinical, regulatory and program teams, the role applies design controls, risk management and quality-system requirements to ensure patient safety, product quality and compliance. It also supports investigations, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous improvement while using sound technical judgement to resolve complex quality issues.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Creates and promotes a strong quality culture by driving quality and compliance activities for AI-enabled medical devices, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Responsible for ensuring compliance with the applicable Quality Management System, driving quality objectives and metrics, and supporting effective quality operating mechanisms across the business.
  • Provides quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle, including new product introduction, design and development, design changes, software releases, design transfer and post-market activities. Ensures quality and regulatory compliance while supporting process effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Develops in-depth knowledge of AI-enabled medical devices and their integration with compatible medical-device platforms. Uses prior experience and technical expertise to support quality strategy, risk-based decision-making, verification and validation, and the effective application of design controls.
  • Partners with software engineering, machine learning, clinical, regulatory, product and program teams to provide quality guidance for AI-enabled medical-device development. Communicates complex quality and technical information clearly and provides guidance to less-experienced team members.
  • Impacts projects, processes and procedures within the quality function and operates with appropriate autonomy. Uses professional judgement to identify and address quality and compliance risks, while seeking senior guidance for complex or high-impact matters when needed.
  • Utilizes technical expertise and analytical thinking to resolve quality issues and support investigations, nonconformances, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous-improvement activities. Leverages multiple internal sources and cross-functional input to make informed decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (OR a high school diploma / GED with at least 10 years of experience.)
  • 6+ years of experience

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
  • Experience supporting AI or machine learning-enabled medical devices, including considerations related to data quality, model performance, traceability, validation, change control and integration with medical-device platforms.
  • Experience in quality assurance or design quality for medical devices, including SaMD, with working knowledge of design controls, software lifecycle processes, risk management, verification, validation and post-market quality activities.

  • Encourage participation in health assessments and care coordination programs

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionYou ship a benchmark every two to three weeks (example benchmark).
jobs.description:
Description

You ship a benchmark every two to three weeks (example benchmark). Each one measures a frontier risk that nobody has measured yet. Some go public. Some go only to the labs.

Some of the benchmarks and papers are done in collaboration with the leading AI Labs and universities.

You will not write every eval yourself. Each benchmark pairs you with an in-house researcher who owns that harm area, and you get a budget for freelancers you direct. You own the taxonomy, the harness, the quality bar and the release.

The seat sits in the CTO office alongside the research lead who sets our public research agenda. Around 150 researchers here work on harms directly, and you can pull any of them onto a subject.

Key Responsibilities

1. Ship the benchmark cadence

A benchmark every two to three weeks. Size follows the subject. A chat-based taxonomy can carry 100 evals. An agentic or GRPO benchmark is closer to 20, because each one is expensive to read. Sensitivity decides what ships publicly and what goes to the labs alone.

2. Own the quality bar

The test is simple. A frontier lab reruns our set and gets our numbers. The verifiers hold, the rubrics are clear, the distribution is sane, and their subject matter experts read the taxonomy and call it novel.

That means you read the evals yourself. You can screen with a model, and you still open the file, spot the item that does not match the taxonomy, and push the researcher back on it.

3. Run the process

Hold the plan and the calendar. You are the person who keeps other researchers on timeline. You can direct two or three freelancers (SMEs) yourself ad-hoc when needed.

4. Set the roadmap with the forum

Roughly monthly you sit with the CTO and the pod and research leads. Inputs are what our research teams see, what clients are asking for, and what is moving in the news. Output is a revised release plan for the quarter, tied to the accounts we want to open.

5. Stay ahead of the curve

Around 20% of your time goes to the ecosystem. Read the research, keep contacts inside the labs, ask them what is bothering them, and travel to a couple of conferences a year. You should be talking to folks from the labs weekly.

Requirements

Requirements

  • PhD or Masters in computer science, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent depth from industry research.
  • 3+ years building and running safety or security evaluations for language models in production, at an AI lab, a model provider, or a safety and security research organisation.
  • 5+ relevant research publications in the field of AI safety and security including lead author on at least 2 of them
  • Strong engineer. Evaluation harnesses, distributed inference, vLLM, reading a codebase and fixing it.
  • You can build a taxonomy, not only score against one.
  • You can direct a researcher and two freelancers without managing them formally.
  • Strong English, written and spoken. This role runs on internal communication across time zones.
  • Curiosity about the harms themselves. You will be learning a new subject every three weeks.

Ideally:

  • Post-training experience: SFT, DPO, GRPO. Reward design for subjective and safety-relevant targets is a live problem for us.
  • Agentic evaluation experience: tool use, orchestration, permissions, prompt injection.
  • Publications at top conferences.
  • Willingness to present your own work on a client call. Strong communication - both verbal and written, ability to present to large and/or senior audiences
  • Travel to conferences at least 3 times a year

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

Alice clients are the top 8 AI Labs in the world.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to shape the future of authentication?
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation.

1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.

We are looking for a Sr Database Engineer to own the day-to-day operation of our database estate. Our production services run on MongoDB and Amazon DocumentDB, with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB alongside them, and our reporting data lands in Apache Iceberg tables on S3 that we query through Amazon Redshift. You will be the owner of everything that keeps that estate healthy and moving: pre-deployment migrations, upgrades, query performance, customer data requests, backup and recovery, and incident response.

This is an operations-first role. You will work alongside our senior database architect, who leads our data platform projects, and take full ownership of the run work so the whole team can move faster. We want someone who thinks before they change something: you read the release notes before a MongoDB upgrade and know which application queries it could break, and you find the slow query and fix the index before a customer notices. This is an on-call role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day operations across MongoDB, Amazon DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Amazon Redshift, including health checks, capacity, connections, and storage growth.
  • Plan and execute database version upgrades, assessing driver compatibility, deprecated features, and query behavior changes against application code before anything reaches production.
  • Find and fix slow queries by profiling workloads and reading explain plans, then design, add, or retire indexes based on real query patterns.
  • Run pre-deployment schema and data migrations for each release, with pre-checks, verification of the result, and a tested rollback.
  • Manage versioned database migrations in Git (Liquibase, Flyway, or equivalent), reviewed through pull requests and applied through CI with GitHub Actions.
  • Handle customer data requests, including extracts, reports, corrections, and deletion requests, with the right approvals and an audit trail.
  • Maintain reporting access in Redshift over Iceberg tables in S3 (external schemas, Spectrum, Glue Data Catalog), including views, grants, and query performance.
  • Own backup, point-in-time restore, and failover. Rehearse restores on a schedule and document them so anyone on the team can run them.
  • Manage database access, including users, roles, grants, secrets rotation, and access reviews that hold up to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.
  • Build and tune monitoring and alerting for query latency, replication lag, disk, connections, and cost.
  • Respond to database incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and follow through on the fixes.
  • Automate repetitive DBA work with Python or Bash so the operational load shrinks over time.
  • Work closely with Development, Customer Success, the ML team, and DevSecOps on releases, installations, and customer escalations.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience administering production databases.
  • Hands-on production experience with MongoDB or Amazon DocumentDB, including replica sets, indexing, TTL, and upgrades.
  • Hands-on production experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Strong SQL and experience with Amazon Redshift or a comparable analytical query engine (Athena, Trino, Snowflake, or BigQuery).
  • A track record of production database upgrades, including assessing application impact before the upgrade.
  • Index design and query tuning driven by profiler and explain plan output.
  • Experience running schema and data migrations as part of a release process.
  • Backup, restore, and replication in production, with recovery that has actually been tested.
  • Strong experience with AWS database and supporting services (RDS or Aurora, DocumentDB, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch).
  • Proficiency in Python or Bash for automation.
  • Experience with Git and CI-based change workflows.
  • Experience handling PII and customer data under SOC 2, GDPR, or similar requirements.
  • A habit of verifying: you confirm the result of a change rather than assuming it, and you write the runbook before it is needed.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.

• Remote, based in India.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue, Athena, or other open table formats on S3.
  • Experience with Liquibase or Flyway specifically.

• Experience with MongoDB Atlas.

  • Exposure to Kafka or change data capture pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and Terraform (enough to read a plan and run database tooling in a cluster).
  • Experience in identity, fraud prevention, or another regulated SaaS product.
  • MongoDB or AWS database certifications.

Benefits

  • Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Build with decentralized identity protocols, FedRamp High, FIDO2-certified cryptography, and NIST-compliant biometric systems.
  • Accelerated Growth: Receive annual stipends for certifications and attend key conferences.
  • Ownership & Impact: We move fast and will enable you to make a big impact with large customers in US & Canada.

Establish the validation gates, documentation standards, configuration control, and engineering rigor required to deploy automated workflows in regulated, high-reliability production environments.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is building a new role at the intersection of security engineering and applied AI. You'll be the most AI-forward technologist on our Application Security team. You'll use frontier AI models to find vulnerabilities across our cloud, software, and firmware before attackers do. You'll also evaluate each new model for security use and help build the guardrails for adopting AI safely. This role reports into our AppSec team and has a clear path to shape Samsara's AI security strategy.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver accurate, consistent security assessments of Samsara's software, code, and firmware, evaluating their resilience against AI-driven/adversarial attacks, and implementing fixes.
  • Create and translate general AI security findings into Samsara-specific fixes for our application security layer— including adapting techniques built for software to apply to hardware and embedded firmware.
  • Find both AI-specific and traditional vulnerabilities (e.g., injection, IDOR) using AI-driven offensive validation.
  • Build and pressure-test novel AI-enabled security tooling and workflows, then drive adoption of what proves valuable across the broader security org.
  • Benchmark each new frontier model against the previous one for security tasks, and build the release criteria and guardrails for adopting it.
  • Support AppSec vulnerability triage through an office-hours rotation, and help run our bug bounty program, with potential expansion to hardware.
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, hardware, and leadership. Present findings to security and executive leadership as Samsara's go-to expert on AI-related security risk.
  • Help define & drive Samsara's medium- and long-term strategy for adopting AI safely and effectively within security operations.
  • Use frontier AI/LLM tools (e.g., Anthropic's and OpenAI's cybersecurity-specific programs) hands-on for both offensive validation (red-teaming our own systems) and defensive tooling — required experience integrating, securing, or red-teaming AI-enabled systems (e.g., LLMs, agentic workflows, prompt injection/adversarial testing) is essential to this role.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in application security, vulnerability management, threat modeling, offensive security, or a closely related discipline, with demonstrated application fix impact and influence across a large part of an organization.
  • Hands-on experience building AI or agentic workflows for security use cases.
  • Experience conducting technical security assessments (e.g. offensive security or validation exercises) across both software and hardware/firmware environments.
  • Experience in creating solutions for secure code with engineers using languages such as GoLang.
  • Experience developing AI and agentic solutions using Github, and developing within AWS cloud.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with AI-specific attack techniques (prompt injection, jailbreaks, model/agent abuse) for vulnerability management and application security.
  • Experience building or validating security controls for agentic AI, RAG systems, or LLM-integrated platforms.
  • Experience red-teaming LLM-enabled systems (prompt injection, agent abuse).
  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs.
  • Bug bounty platform experience (e.g., Bugcrowd).
  • Experience in federal or FedRAMP-style environments.
  • A track record of driving org-wide security strategy or presenting technical findings to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., OSCP, GIAC, CISSP) or AWS certifications.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

$157,675—$238,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.title: Director, Growth Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary The Director, Growth Marketing leads DataSpring’s growth marketing function and is accountable for translating company objectives into segment-based strategies, integrated campaigns, events, performance marketing, and measurable business outcomes.
jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Director, Growth Marketing leads DataSpring’s growth marketing function and is accountable for translating company objectives into segment-based strategies, integrated campaigns, events, performance marketing, and measurable business outcomes. This role sets the function’s priorities, operating model, annual planning inputs, budget recommendations, performance expectations, and team accountability across payer and provider markets.

As part of DataSpring’s segment-based growth marketing model, this role directly owns the provider segment strategy, including provider buyers and clinician/profile manager audiences, and oversees growth marketing execution across both payer and provider segments. The Director is responsible for demand creation, pipeline contribution, customer expansion, event performance, marketing ROI, and continuous optimization of growth marketing programs.

The role operates at both strategic and executional altitudes: setting direction and standards across the full growth marketing portfolio, while personally architecting provider segment campaigns, content direction, and event strategy where needed.

This role collaborates closely with Product Marketing, Marketing Communications, Brand Marketing, Marketing Operations & Analytics, Sales, Account Management, Business Development, and Product Management to ensure growth programs are aligned with positioning, narrative, brand standards, commercial priorities, and measurable business goals.

The Director, Growth Marketing is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the SVP, Brand, Marketing & Communications

Specific Responsibilities

Growth Strategy, Segmentation & Planning

  • Own the overall growth marketing strategy for DataSpring, setting direction across integrated campaigns, content, and performance marketing in service of company revenue and market share goals.
  • Translate company objectives into annual growth marketing plans, campaign strategies, event strategies, budget recommendations, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead the team's transition from a product-organized model to a segment-organized model, with growth marketing structured around the payer and provider markets.
  • Directly own provider segment growth strategy, including provider-specific goals, buyer personas, journeys, campaign priorities, and integrated marketing plans.
  • Ensure growth strategies appropriately address distinct provider audiences, including decision-makers, clinicians, and profile managers, where applicable.
  • Oversee channel strategy, audience targeting, campaign activation, and optimization across payer and provider segments.
  • Retain overall accountability for the payer market segment's strategy and results, with day-to-day payer campaign strategy and execution led by the Payer Growth Marketing function.
  • Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Business Development on pipeline targets, account-based marketing, cross-sell, customer expansion, and net-new provider opportunities.

Team Leadership & Operating Model

  • Directly manage, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary growth marketing team across campaign strategy, content and communications, performance marketing, event strategy, and lead generation.
  • Personally own the provider market segment end-to-end strategy, campaign design, and event strategy and design, directing the appropriate growth marketing resources in execution.
  • Delegate ownership of the payer market segment's campaign strategy and execution, including payer event strategy and design, to the appropriate growth marketing leader while providing oversight to ensure payer campaigns stay aligned with overall growth strategy and brand standards.
  • Set team priorities, operating rhythms, resourcing plans, accountability measures, and integrated planning practices across content, campaigns, performance channels, events, and customer marketing.
  • Apply ongoing performance management practices — feedback, coaching, counseling, and development planning — across direct reports, including hiring for open roles on the team.
  • Establish event strategy and governance across payer and provider segments, including prioritization, experience design, lead goals, and performance measures.
  • Own the customer marketing strategy and growth framework across both segments, with execution delegated through the growth marketing team.
  • Review payer segment campaign plans, budget, and performance with the Payer Growth Marketing function on a regular cadence to maintain accountability for that segment's results.

Provider Segment Go-to-Market Design & Execution

  • Translate provider market and customer needs into goals, objectives, strategies, tactics, integrated campaign plans, and timelines.
  • Provide strategic direction for audience-specific campaigns and engagement strategies targeting provider decision-makers, clinicians, and profile managers.
  • Direct provider-focused content and campaign assets that reflect provider pain points, use cases, and commercial priorities.
  • Activate provider-focused digital, paid, organic, and account-based channels to drive awareness, engagement, qualified demand, and pipeline contribution.
  • Own provider-focused event strategy and design, partnering with the Event and Field Marketing functions on logistics, execution, lead capture, routing, and follow-up.
  • Provide oversight and regular review of provider segment campaign plans, budget, and performance with the Event and Field Marketing functions to ensure go-to-market activities remain aligned with provider segment goals and measurable business outcomes.
  • Own the provider segment marketing budget; allocate spend across channels, events, and vendors to hit lead and pipeline targets, and manage associated ROI.

Growth Marketing Event Strategy

  • Own the overarching growth marketing event strategy, including how events support segment priorities, audience engagement, demand generation, customer expansion, and business growth objectives.
  • Establish the annual events strategy, prioritization framework, calendar, budget, experience design, lead goals, follow-up model, and success metrics across both payer and provider segments.
  • Direct the overall workload and priorities of the Event and Field Marketing functions across both segments, ensuring logistics, execution, and lead management are resourced appropriately for provider and payer events alike.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Role Clarity

  • Product Marketing: Partner on portfolio positioning, messaging frameworks, competitive intelligence, and commercial enablement; activate that positioning into segment-specific campaigns and demand-generation programs.
  • Marketing Communications: Partner on corporate narrative, thought leadership, executive communications, and earned media alignment; ensure growth campaigns reflect approved narrative and brand voice.
  • Marketing Operations & Analytics: Partner with the Marketing Operations & Analytics function on lead flow, attribution, and reporting infrastructure to track provider segment performance (MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV).
  • Brand Marketing: Partner on brand identity, creative production, digital marketing infrastructure, and website needs; brief creative and web requirements for payer and provider campaigns.
  • Sales, Account Management & Business Development: Partner on lead follow-up, handoffs, campaign briefs, account-based marketing, cross-sell, customer expansion, and net-new opportunities across both payer and provider segments.

Performance Leadership, Reporting & Optimization

  • Lead the performance of the growth marketing function, setting clear goals, priorities, operating rhythms, and accountability measures across campaigns, content, performance marketing, events, and customer marketing.
  • Define and manage growth marketing KPIs across payer and provider segments, including awareness, engagement, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, event performance, conversion rates, and customer expansion outcomes.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to establish dashboards, attribution models, and reporting infrastructure that show growth marketing's contribution to business objectives.
  • Use performance data to continuously optimize audience strategy, campaign design, channel mix, content performance, event investments, and budget allocation.
  • Hold direct reports accountable for measurable outcomes, ensuring each function within growth marketing has clear goals, metrics, timelines, and performance expectations.

Other

  • Represent growth marketing and the provider segment in cross-departmental planning for conferences and industry events, partnering with Business Development and Product Management as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned to support marketing and communications.

Supervisory Responsibilities

The Director, Growth Marketing will lead and develop a multidisciplinary growth marketing team responsible for integrated campaigns, content and communications, performance marketing, event strategy, and lead generation activities across payer and provider segments.

Skills

  • Ability to operate at two altitudes at once: setting strategic direction across the full growth marketing portfolio (both payer and provider segments) while personally rolling up sleeves to architect and execute provider segment campaigns, content direction, and events.
  • Proven ability to build and lead a market-segment-based growth marketing strategy, including translating a segment's needs into an integrated, multi-channel go-to-market plan.
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience managing and developing a team spanning content, campaigns, and performance marketing disciplines.
  • Ability to partner effectively across product marketing, marketing communications, sales, and business development, with a clear understanding of where growth marketing's ownership starts and stops relative to those functions.
  • Strong analytical capabilities to analyze market research, competitive intelligence, and end-to-end conversion metrics to develop sound segment strategies and measure results.
  • Expertise in marketing automation, CRM, and demand-generation tooling (e.g., Pardot, Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce, DemandBase), and in rolling a go-to-market strategy into an integrated marketing plan.
  • Experience with account-based marketing and strategic account planning in partnership with business development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to apply established brand narrative and product positioning rather than originate it.
  • Ability to set priorities, manage multiple workstreams, and keep a team on track against deadlines and budget.
  • Demonstrated budget and ROI management experience, with accountability for a clear ROI target.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce (preferred), Pardot/Marketo/HubSpot, DemandBase, and MS Office/PowerPoint.
  • Deep expertise in performance marketing, reporting and optimization, including setting the performance KPIs for growth marketing that support business objectives, and cross collaborating with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations and finance.
  • Proven ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, particularly Sales and Account Management leaders, to align growth priorities, resolve competing needs, and drive execution against shared revenue and customer expansion goals.

Experience & Education

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, product marketing, segment marketing, or related disciplines.
  • Experience developing and leading integrated growth marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, qualified demand, pipeline growth, customer expansion, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional marketing initiatives across campaign strategy, content, events, digital marketing, performance marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), and customer marketing.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing marketing teams, including responsibility for performance management, coaching, resource planning, and team development.
  • Experience establishing marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, measurement frameworks, and operating processes that align marketing investments with business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with executive leadership, sales, product marketing, account management, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute growth strategies.
  • Healthcare, healthcare technology, payer, provider, or other regulated industry marketing experience preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration (MBA), Communications, or a related field preferred.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

About Bamboo Works

Bamboo Works is a fast-growing international staffing firm connecting companies around the world with exceptional remote professionals. We help businesses build high-performing offshore teams across a wide range of functions, including operations, marketing, finance, technology, customer support, and executive assistance.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional Client Success Manager to become the trusted advisor for our clients, ensuring every partnership delivers long-term value and success.

If you're passionate about building lasting relationships, solving problems proactively, and helping businesses grow through great people, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Client Success Manager, you'll own the client journey from onboarding through long-term account management. You'll become a strategic partner to a portfolio of clients, helping them build successful remote teams, coordinating recruitment efforts, supporting contractors, and identifying opportunities to grow their teams over time.

This is a highly collaborative role where you'll work closely with clients, recruiters, contractors, and internal leadership to deliver an exceptional experience at every stage of the partnership.

Your success will be measured not only by client satisfaction and retention, but also by your ability to build trust, anticipate challenges, and create opportunities for long-term growth.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Flexible with overlap across international clients

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,600 - $2,000 (depending on level of experience) + revenue-based incentives

What You'll Do

Client Success & Relationship Management

  • Own the client relationship from onboarding through long-term partnership.

  • Lead onboarding, hiring kick-offs, and calibration sessions to ensure alignment and success.

  • Ensure every placement reflects Bamboo Works' commitment to quality and service.

Contractor Success

  • Conduct onboarding and regular performance check-ins.

  • Help contractors integrate successfully into their clients' teams.

  • Identify and address potential performance concerns early.

  • Facilitate constructive conversations between clients and contractors when needed.

Project & Operations Management

  • Keep projects moving efficiently while ensuring alignment across all stakeholders.

  • Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously with exceptional organization and attention to detail.

  • Continuously improve internal processes to enhance the client experience.

Growth & Account Development

  • Identify opportunities to help clients expand their remote teams.

  • Recommend additional roles and staffing solutions that genuinely support business growth.

  • Recognize account expansion opportunities through regular client conversations.

  • Contribute to the long-term growth of both Bamboo Works and its clients.

  • 3+ years of experience in Client Success, Customer Success, Account Management, Recruitment, Staffing, Outsourcing, or another client-facing role.

  • Naturally builds trust and long-term relationships.

  • Takes ownership rather than waiting for direction.

  • Anticipates challenges before they become problems.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Is calm under pressure and confident navigating complex conversations.

  • Balances empathy with commercial thinking.

  • Enjoys helping businesses grow through exceptional people.

  • Is highly organized without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • Genuinely cares about delivering outstanding service and creating successful long-term partnerships.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
