Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$160,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an AI Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform layer that powers large-scale AI training and inference workloads. The role focuses on GPU clusters, distributed training frameworks, scheduling, storage performance, and developer experience for ML engineers and researchers, with strong emphasis on reliability, efficiency, and cost control. The ideal candidate has built or operated production AI infrastructure at scale, understands the interaction between hardware, kernel, scheduler, and ML framework, and brings strong software engineering discipline to platform work.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate GPU and accelerator infrastructure for training and inference, spanning on-prem clusters, cloud-managed services, and hybrid configurations.
  • Build scheduling, queueing, and resource-sharing systems that maximize accelerator utilization across many teams.
  • Integrate frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, and Ray Train into a unified platform offering.
  • Operate high-performance storage systems and data pipelines that keep accelerators fed with training data at near-line-rate.
  • Design networking architectures supporting RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, and high-bandwidth collective communication.
  • Build observability for AI workloads including utilization, throughput, training stability, and failure-mode analytics.
  • Implement checkpointing, restart, and fault-tolerance patterns for long-running training jobs at scale.
  • Drive cost optimization across compute, storage, and networking through scheduling, spot capacity, and right-sizing.
  • Develop developer tooling and paved-road workflows that let researchers launch experiments safely and efficiently.
  • Partner with research and applied ML teams to plan capacity for upcoming training runs.
  • Implement security controls, isolation, and access management for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.
  • Drive automation across cluster provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration enforcement.
  • Maintain runbooks, capacity dashboards, and operational documentation for the AI platform.
  • Stay current with AI infrastructure research, accelerator hardware, and emerging open-source AI tooling.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Ten or more years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or HPC engineering.
  • Hands-on experience operating GPU clusters or large-scale ML training infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and at least one systems language such as Go or C++.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training, accelerator architectures, and collective communication.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, or similar scheduling systems for ML workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, and high-performance storage.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider’s ML infrastructure offerings.
  • Strong software engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and code review.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating InfiniBand or RDMA networking at scale.
  • Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with custom orchestrators or research-grade training stacks.
  • Exposure to frontier model training operations.
  • Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

This position requires the ability to have a compelling conversation and to provide high quality customer service for donors on the NMDP registry who are being asked to save a patient’s life. The role involves using investigative skills in partnership with information from within NMDP systems to locate and contact donors. Candidates must effectively engage donors who could have misconceptions about the donation process. Responsibilities of this role include the ability to access information from within NMDP systems, confirm interest, and assess health conditions, update donor demographics, and complete/manage all other related record updates and documentation accordingly.
The following activities would also be performed as necessary: scheduling laboratory testing, ordering/sending donor kits, obtaining consent, and monitoring donor follow through. Good guardianship of member confidentiality and identity is required. Role supports the achievement of department goals through job accountabilities, excellent customer service, and exceptional time management. Candidate must demonstrate professional telephone etiquette with the ability to build rapport with customers in a heavy blended (inbound and outbound) call environment.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Contact Members/Donors for Donor Search-Related Activities:
• Locates donors using data provided at recruitment, including alternate contacts; uses internet search tools, paid Search Engines, and social media to locate updated contact information.
• Educates donors (advanced) - Reinforces commitment and retention messages to donors. Asks open-ended questions to assist in overcoming donor barriers to donation. Utilizes reflective listening skills, summarizes conversations, and assesses the next steps in the donation process.
• Practices behavioral coaching techniques- ask open-ended questions, utilizes reflective listening skills, summarizes conversations, and assesses commitment to next steps in the donation process.
• Conducts donor health screening (advanced) - Collects donors’ medical health history information and assesses medical conditions and non-medical factors to determine further donor participation. Appropriately engages Medical Services, Provider Services, and Donor Advocacy for consultation on unusual donor circumstances. Documents and communicates resolutions or anticipated next steps.
• Coordinates blood draws (appointment time, location, kit ordering, donor/kit tracking) and completing follow-up forms as needed.
• Completes operational activities within established timelines and standards and maintains compliance with identified department performance standards.
• Practices good guardianship of member confidentiality and identity through appropriate use of available people finder tools.
• Completes first contact activities within established timelines. Provides required updates to Provider Services, as applicable. Documents all donor activity in STAR Link/Salesforce donor file. Completes all appropriate NMDP documentation.
• Maintains standards and compliance with identified department performance standards to increase the number of donors moving forward to donation.

Establishes and Maintains Good Relationships with Donor Operations, Donor Center Staff, Collaborating Departments, and External Vendors:
• Maintains understanding of donor operations processes and unique customer requirements.
• Upholds, develops, and supports relationships with Provider Services, NMDP KitMaker and external laboratory partners or other draw sites to maintain phlebotomy sites throughout service areas.
• Collaborates with other teams and departments to achieve goals and support the work of Donor Operations (e.g., Marketing and Communications, Donor Experience, Provider Services, Donor Advocacy).
• Collaborate closely with Workup teams to manage details and ensure smooth and timely hand-offs of donor cases.

Other Duties as Required for Team/Department Operations:
• Maintains on-going knowledge of HLA, and blood stem cell transplantation.
• Assists in maintaining STAR Link donor database.
• Participate in shared team responsibilities and staff back-up including coverage of calls in the general team call queues, while servicing those member/donor files as needed with excellent customer service/resolution.
• Performs all duties in compliance with standard operating procedures, National Marrow Donor Program (NMDP) standards, regulations outlined in the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), Federal Drug Administration (FDA) guidance and other applicable Federal, state, and local laws. Adheres to OSHA guidelines as applicable.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Knowledge of:

  • MS Office, including basic word processing, spreadsheet, and database software application skills.
    • Proficiently applying computer skills and engaging with customers simultaneously
    • Advanced internet research skills including familiarity with social media.

    Ability to:
    • Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to ask probing questions while working in a mission-driven call center environment.
    • Manage a high volume of challenging file types.
    • Apply appropriate use of available people finder tools, as deemed necessary.
    • Deliver solid customer service while utilizing proven critical thinking and problem-solving skills, while employing a high degree of emotional intelligence.
    • Integrate new and evolving knowledge into daily work and utilize multiple resources and tools to complete work.
    • Demonstrate proficiency by multitasking in a fast paced and multi-media (phone, email, text, mail) environment with observable proficiency.
    • Convey medical information to donors, manage confidential information appropriately, and employ strong documentation practices.
    • Contribute to a team environment and take initiative and responsibility for independent work as needed.
    • Complete work with a high level of accuracy, attention to detail and follow-through.
    • Maintain flexibility in work hours to accommodate staffing needs; evening/weekend hours may be required.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human services or a Health Care related field is required. However, upon evaluation, equivalent related Health Care experience and/or education may be substituted for the degree requirement. Additional educational experience in public health, psychology, or health promotion is preferred.
    • Three plus years of professional experience in demonstrating ability to communicate effectively with individuals or coaching individuals on behavior change. Three years customer relations, direct patient interaction or care in a clinical/healthcare setting may be substituted for behavioral coaching experience.
    • Experience with basic word processing and data entry required.

    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: (Additional qualifications that may make a person even more effective in the role, but are not required for consideration)
    • Familiarity with medical terminology and advanced health screening experience preferred.
    • Familiarity obtaining informed consent.
    • Experience in target-driven sales environment.
    • Familiarity with digital social platforms and social media applications.

jobs.description:
About the job SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.

The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.

Responsibilities:

  • Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.
  • Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.
  • Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.
  • Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.
  • Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.
  • Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.
  • Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.
  • Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

  • 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.
  • Understanding of banking data environment.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.
  • Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.
  • Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.
  • In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.
  • Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

This position is for one active vacancy.

About Generate Canada

Generate Canada is a not-for-profit organization that for 30 years has been bringing together leaders from government, business, academia and civil society to drive change aimed at strengthening Canada’s economy, and the natural and social systems on which it depends.

We have built a national platform of pre-competitive innovation labs that we call ‘Solution Spaces’. They help develop and scale solutions—be it partnerships, investments, policies, standards, and/or new technologies— that are deemed most critical for a clean economy and a resilient future.

Our portfolio of Solution Spaces is ever-evolving to respond to complex and persistent challenges, and to fill gaps not already being addressed by other organizations. We are currently focused on advancing regenerative agriculture, the circular economy across construction and plastics supply-chains, and blended sustainable finance for nature-based solutions.

Join the work to advance a more resilient food system
Founded in 2023 as a Solution Space of Generate Canada, the Canadian Alliance for Net-Zero Agri-food (CANZA) grew out of a small group of passionate industry leaders willing to test ideas and work together in a pre-collaborative space to find real solutions. We collaborate with farmers, organizations, food and beverage processors and retailers, and researchers to develop and scale practical solutions that reduce emissions, improve environmental outcomes, and create new value across the agri-food system.

What You’ll Do

As the Marketplace Implementation Coordinator, you will play a central role in driving day-to-day operations and execution across the CANZA Marketplace and associated work related to CANZA’s Measurement, Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MMRV) initiatives. This role combines dedicated leadership over specific streams of work with active collaborative support across the broader Marketplace team to ensure seamless delivery of our organizational goals.

This position will bring knowledge of sustainable and regenerative agriculture practices to champion key workstreams. As part of this role, you will have ownership of enhancements to the Marketplace searchable directory to improve user experience and deepen partner relationships across Canada, while consulting with the Director on strategic direction. At the same time, you will work closely with the full Marketplace team to support, coordinate, and execute activities led by other team members - helping maintain detailed workplans, conducting research, and supporting testing of new functionality in the Marketplace and other associated technology platforms.

Working under the guidance of the Director, Data & Marketplace Strategy, you will bridge structured project management with hands-on coordination. You will ensure milestones are met, practical and high-quality research is conducted, progress reports and documentation are delivered accurately, and our collective efforts effectively advance CANZA’s mission across Canada's agrifood sector.

As Marketplace Implementation Coordinator, your key responsibilities will include:

jobs.excerpt: Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises.
jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves extends credit to thousands of businesses across Latin America and beyond, and the quality of those decisions depends on the quality of our data. Our Credit & Analytics team has a clear roadmap: reliable portfolio monitoring, better risk models, and more automated credit decisioning. All of it depends on first getting our data foundation right — connecting and maintaining external data sources and cleaning up customer data consents — and today that work competes with day-to-day execution for the same few people.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Business Analyst to own that foundation and build on it. In your first months you'll lead the work to connect and validate external data (bureau, banking, open finance and tax data), clean up consent records so we can use that data reliably, and turn manual processes into repeatable ones. From there you'll use that data to shape credit policy: underwriting criteria, credit limit strategies, portfolio monitoring and early-warning signals that help us catch losses before they happen.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who likes to get into the data themselves. You'll partner closely with data science, engineering, product, collections and sales, and your work will directly shape how Jeeves makes credit decisions as we scale. It is not a people-management role today.

Location: This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

    Data Foundation

  • Lead the integration and validation of external data sources — credit bureaus, bank and open finance data, tax and financial data — partnering with engineering on pipelines and data quality

  • Own the cleanup of customer data consents and connections so external data can be pulled and refreshed reliably and in line with local requirements

  • Replace manual credit and portfolio processes with repeatable, documented SQL/Python workflows

  • Define data quality checks and documentation so the team can trust what it's looking at

    • Credit Policy & Strategy

  • Use internal performance and external data to develop and refine underwriting criteria and credit limit strategies

  • Design customer management strategies, including credit line increases, decreases and reinstatements

  • Identify high-risk customers early and build processes to mitigate losses

  • Partner with Sales and Business Development so growth strategies stay consistent with Jeeves's credit policy

    • Portfolio Monitoring & Collections Support

  • Define portfolio KPIs and build dashboards to track portfolio health and strategy performance

  • Build early-warning signals and monitoring routines that flag deteriorating accounts

  • Give Collections the segmentation and prioritization insights they need to improve recovery

  • Contribute to loss forecasting and risk-adjusted return analysis with Finance

    • Models & Automation

  • Apply statistical methods (logistic regression, segmentation, clustering) to uncover risk drivers and inform strategy

  • Develop, validate and monitor credit risk models

  • Help define the rules and data requirements for automated credit decisioning with Product and Engineering

  • Translate model results into clear recommendations for credit leadership and business partners

    • Working With AI

  • Use AI tools to support your analysis, and verify their outputs against source data

  • Suggest and help build improvements to our AI workflows as you see what works and what doesn't

Minimum Requirements:

  • 3–7 years of analytics experience in credit risk, with hands-on work on commercial or SMB credit in cards, payments, lending or a related industry

  • Advanced SQL — you write your own queries against large, messy datasets and are comfortable validating data quality

  • Working proficiency in Python for analysis and statistical modeling (regression, segmentation, clustering)

  • Experience with version control (e.g., GitHub) for sharing and maintaining code is a plus

  • Able to work independently and take ownership

  • Direct experience working with external or alternative data sources (bureau, banking, open finance, tax or similar), ideally including integrating or cleaning them

  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini in your analytical work, and curiosity about using them more

  • A track record of turning analysis into a credit policy or strategy change that was implemented, with measurable results

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a model result or data issue to a non-technical stakeholder

  • Professional fluency in English — Jeeves is a global company and English is the language we use internally to communicate between regions

  • Able to work with meaningful overlap with Latin American business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Latin American credit data and open finance ecosystems (e.g., Mexico, Brazil, Colombia)

  • Experience implementing, validating or monitoring risk and scoring models alongside data science teams

  • Experience supporting collections strategy or early-warning programs

  • Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, Metabase, Claude Visualization Tools.

  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or fintech

The Senior Property Manager reports to the Senior Regional Property Manager and is responsible for managing an assigned industrial real estate portfolio. jobs.description:
About Us:

PUNCH Cyber Analytics Group (PUNCH) is a Virginia-based, small business founded in 2012 operating as a cohesive team that incorporates the sum of our group’s diverse skills, talents, and resources toward our collective passion: advancing data analytics to impact cyber operations. PUNCH is a two-time Inc. Magazine ‘Best Workplaces’ awardee offering unique benefits and personal touches to provide a positive work-life experience for our team. PUNCH brings unique qualifications, resources, and past-performance that make us suitable to address the goals of our diverse customer-base. Further, we have past and current experience supporting cyber operations and cyber ML-based research, with well over 100 years of collective experience from our collaborative, multi-disciplinary team.

Responsibilities
  • Develop and evaluate machine-learning analytics for cyber defense use cases using network, sensor, alert, asset, and other operational telemetry.
  • Build unsupervised and statistical models for clustering, anomaly/outlier detection, behavioral baselining, novelty detection, and pattern discovery.
  • Apply techniques such as graph analytics/embeddings, nearest-neighbor methods, time-series or periodicity analysis, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and anomaly scoring to large cyber datasets.
  • Design models and features that account for concept drift, noisy data, incomplete ground truth, and high false-positive rates common in operational cyber environments.
  • Support asset discovery and entity resolution, including development of probabilistic asset graphs that associate IPs, hostnames, MAC addresses, services, certificates, device attributes, and other observations across data sources.
  • Develop contextual features from security alerts and network telemetry, including temporal patterns, rarity/frequency, communication behavior, entity context, and related activity, and use those features to identify meaningful alert clusters and outliers.
  • Work with cyber analysts and detection engineers to turn operational questions and adversary behaviors into measurable features, experiments, and analytics.
  • Evaluate model effectiveness using appropriate quantitative metrics and operational validation; benchmark accuracy, false-positive behavior, computational performance, and usefulness to analysts.
  • Develop production-quality Python code and work with engineers to integrate models into sensor-side CPU environments as well as larger GPU-enabled enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Understand the practical strengths and limitations of LLMs: know when to use an LLM, when to use conventional ML/statistics, and when a deterministic rule or query is the better answer.
  • Ability to build evaluation harnesses rather than judge AI output by vibes—test datasets, expected behaviors, regression tests, failure cases, and quantitative measures.
Qualifications
  • BS or MS in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with common scientific/ML tooling such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, SciPy, and related libraries.
  • Strong understanding of unsupervised machine learning, including clustering, anomaly/outlier detection, similarity/distance methods, feature engineering, and statistical baselining.
  • Experience with at least some of the following: graph analytics or graph ML, entity resolution/record linkage, probabilistic modeling, time-series analysis, change-point/concept-drift detection, nearest-neighbor methods, or dimensionality reduction.
  • Experience working with large, noisy, heterogeneous datasets where labels or authoritative ground truth are limited.
  • Familiarity with scalable data processing and efficient model implementation; comfortable thinking about CPU/memory constraints as well as GPU acceleration for larger workloads.
  • Working knowledge of networking and cybersecurity concepts such as IP addressing, DNS, TLS, network flows, ports/services, routing, network devices, and security alerts.
  • Experience with cyber/network telemetry such as Zeek, PCAP-derived data, SIEM data, IDS/IPS alerts, device configuration data, or vulnerability/asset data is highly desirable.
  • Experience with graph/network-analysis libraries, SQL/data stores, Elasticsearch/Splunk, or similar analytic platforms is a plus.
  • Experience developing analytics for cybersecurity, threat hunting, detection engineering, or defensive cyber operations is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Associate - Corporate Development

Location: India (Remote)

About Mati Carbon

Mati Carbon is an XPRIZE-winning mission-driven global enterprise on an ambitious goal to boost smallholder farmer income and resilience, regenerate soil ecology, and durably remove carbon – all at no cost to the farmers. We deploy Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) and related technologies with a locally-led decentralized model across SE Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, and are rapidly scaling with the backing by a global coalition of leading research institutions, funders, and buyers – including the Yale University, JP Morgan, Shopify, Stripe, H&M Group, The Schmidt Family Foundation, Livelihood Impact Fund among others.

Role Overview

The planned hire will work directly with Mati's leadership across three critical priorities: corporate strategy, capital formation, and transaction execution. Functioning as the analytical and executional backbone for the senior leadership, you will prepare strategic business cases and investment materials, model capital structures, support fundraising processes, and manage complex transactions and partnerships. This is a high-visibility role for someone who combines rigorous financial skills with a genuine passion for purpose-driven work.

Key Responsibilities

Capital Formation

  1. Support the management in building and executing Mati's capital formation roadmap across the capital stack, e.g. multilateral debt, blended finance, and grant opportunities — including preparation of information memoranda, financial models, funding applications, and due diligence data rooms.
  2. Conduct financial modelling and scenario analysis to support capital structure decisions;
  3. Support funder engagement with the DFIs, Foundations, Multilaterals, Impact Investors, Commercial Lenders, Climate funds, Corporate Partners etc.
  4. Track and manage the fundraising pipeline, investor correspondence, and follow-up actions across active processes.

Transaction Execution & Partnerships

  1. Support execution of strategic transactions including partnership agreements, off-take contracts, MoUs, joint ventures, and M&A opportunities.
  2. Coordinate due diligence across legal, financial, technical, and operational workstreams; liaise with external advisors including legal counsel, auditors, and financial advisors.

Strategy Development

  1. Support the development and articulation of Mati's corporate strategy, including market entry, competitive positioning, and multi-year growth planning across geographies.
  2. Conduct in-depth research on carbon markets, climate policy, agri-input value chains, and the competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions. Prepare Board-ready strategy materials, briefing documents, and decision frameworks; monitor sector trends, regulatory developments, and peer activity.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 3–6 years of professional experience in structured finance, commercial lending, management consulting (financial advisory), investment banking, or private equity.
  • Demonstrable experience with financial modelling, transaction delivery, due diligence, or capital raising — ideally across multiple deal types or sectors.
  • Top-Tier MBA, Chartered Accountant (CA), CFA, or equivalent world-class postgraduate qualification strongly preferred.
  • Prior exposure to impact investing, climate finance, carbon markets, agricultural value chains, or ESG-aligned deal making is a significant advantage.
  • Experience working with or for DFIs, Multilaterals, or development-stage ventures is a plus.

Skills & Attributes

  • Outstanding analytical and financial modelling skills — comfortable with complex capital structures, sensitivity analysis, scenario planning and commercial lender relationships.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to distil complex ideas into compelling narratives for investors, partners, and leadership.
  • High ownership mindset — able to manage workstreams independently and deliver quality outputs under tight timelines.
  • Collaborative, low-ego team player; comfortable with ambiguity and the pace of a fast-growing startup.

Mission Alignment

  • A genuine passion for climate action, sustainable agriculture, or development impact — motivated by purpose as much as performance, and eager to contribute to institution-building at a critical stage of growth.
  • Alignment with Mati's values: farmer-first thinking, scientific integrity, operational excellence, and grounded ambition.

What We Offer

  • A rare opportunity to work at the strategic core of a high-growth, globally impactful climate venture — with direct exposure to the CXOs from day one.
  • A mission-first culture combining urgency, scientific rigour, and deep respect for the communities we serve.
  • An entrepreneurial opportunity to be part of the journey to scale an SME-level enterprise to a world-class global organisation.
  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to top operator peers, with performance-linked incentives and long-term upside participation.
  • Remote-first flexibility with meaningful opportunities for in-person engagement across Mati's field operations in India and beyond.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

jobs.description:
Account Manager – Hospitality & Corporate Accounts

Location: Asia – Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, or Dubai (Remote)

Company: Corporate Stays

Employment Type: Freelance – Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET
Work Arrangement: Remote / Work From Home

About Corporate Stays

Corporate Stays is a leading provider of premium furnished apartments and corporate housing solutions across Canada and Latin America. We are passionate about delivering exceptional guest experiences while building long-term relationships with both individual travelers and corporate clients.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a motivated and commercially minded Account Manager to manage and grow relationships with corporate clients, existing customers, and recurring guests.

About the Role

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing a portfolio of corporate accounts and existing customers while also identifying opportunities to generate new business.

You will serve as a key point of contact for assigned accounts, developing strong relationships, understanding client needs, and providing personalized accommodation solutions. The role combines account management, customer success, sales, retention, business development, upselling, and account growth.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, commercially driven, and comfortable managing multiple client relationships while identifying opportunities to increase bookings, revenue, and long-term account value.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned corporate accounts, existing customers, and recurring guests.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients.
  • Understand client needs, travel patterns, accommodation requirements, preferences, and business priorities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by providing personalized accommodation solutions.
  • Maintain regular communication with key accounts through email, phone calls, and virtual meetings.
  • Conduct proactive follow-ups to monitor satisfaction, strengthen relationships, and identify new opportunities.
  • Address client concerns and coordinate internally to ensure issues are resolved promptly and professionally.

2. Account Growth, Retention & Reactivation

  • Develop strategies to increase retention, repeat bookings, and overall account value.
  • Proactively follow up with existing and dormant clients to generate additional bookings and reactivate inactive accounts.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the Corporate Stays portfolio.
  • Introduce additional properties, destinations, and accommodation solutions based on client needs.
  • Monitor account activity, booking patterns, and revenue potential to identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with high-value and strategic accounts.
  • Support renewals and ongoing client relationships to maximize long-term revenue.

3. New Business Prospecting & Acquisition

  • Research and identify potential corporate clients, companies, industries, and business opportunities within the assigned territory.
  • Prospect and initiate relationships with potential corporate clients.
  • Build and maintain an active sales pipeline.
  • Conduct outreach through email, phone, LinkedIn, virtual meetings, and other appropriate channels.
  • Qualify new business opportunities and understand the prospect's accommodation requirements.
  • Prepare customized accommodation proposals and solutions for prospective clients.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales cycle.
  • Support the acquisition of new corporate accounts and contribute to new business targets.
  • Collaborate with the Business Development and Sales teams when additional support or specialized expertise is required.

4. Sales & Revenue Growth

  • Identify opportunities to increase booking volume, revenue, and account value.
  • Prepare customized accommodation options, proposals, and commercial solutions based on client requirements.
  • Follow up on inquiries, proposals, and open opportunities until they are resolved or converted into bookings.
  • Support complex or high-value opportunities and coordinate internally to develop appropriate solutions.
  • Monitor sales opportunities and take proactive action to move them through the pipeline.
  • Meet assigned sales, revenue, retention, and account growth targets.

5. CRM & Account Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client, prospect, and account information in HubSpot CRM.
  • Document client communications, preferences, opportunities, follow-ups, and relevant account information.
  • Track account activity, bookings, revenue opportunities, pipeline progression, and customer engagement.
  • Ensure all opportunities and follow-up activities are properly recorded and updated in the CRM.
  • Use account data and historical activity to identify opportunities for growth, retention, and reactivation.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Reservations, Revenue Management, Guest Experience, Operations, and Business Development teams.
  • Ensure client requirements and preferences are clearly communicated to internal teams.
  • Coordinate internally to ensure seamless service delivery and timely resolution of client requests.
  • Collaborate with Business Development to ensure a smooth transition from newly acquired prospects into ongoing account management.
  • Share relevant client feedback and market insights with the appropriate teams.
  • Support the resolution of escalated client concerns when required.

7. Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Meet or exceed assigned account management, retention, sales, revenue, and new-account acquisition targets.
  • Monitor individual account performance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Track bookings, revenue, account activity, pipeline opportunities, retention, and reactivation efforts.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to the team leader regarding account performance, sales activity, opportunities, and challenges.
  • Use performance data to identify trends and develop strategies to improve account growth and customer retention.

8. Market & Business Insights

  • Stay informed about market trends, competitor activity, corporate travel patterns, and developments within relevant industries.
  • Research companies and industries that may have accommodation needs.
  • Identify potential partnerships, corporate relationships, and new revenue opportunities.
  • Provide feedback and insights regarding client needs, market trends, competitor activity, and opportunities to improve Corporate Stays' products and services.
  • Share recurring client feedback that may help improve the overall customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Fluent English, both spoken and written.
  • 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Business Development, Hospitality, or a related field.
  • Experience managing corporate clients, existing accounts, or B2B relationships.
  • Experience in hospitality, corporate housing, serviced apartments, travel, or a related industry is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of customer retention, relationship management, sales, upselling, cross-selling, and account growth.
  • Experience with CRM platforms; HubSpot is highly preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent follow-up and organizational skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to identify and develop revenue opportunities.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, prospects, priorities, and client requests simultaneously.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven approach.
  • Comfortable communicating with clients through phone, email, and video calls.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate CRM records.
  • Experience working with international teams and clients is an advantage.

Success in This Role

Success in this position will be measured through a combination of:

  • Account retention and client satisfaction.
  • Growth in bookings and revenue from existing accounts.
  • Upselling and cross-selling performance.
  • Reactivation of dormant or inactive accounts.
  • New corporate account acquisition.
  • Sales pipeline development and conversion.
  • Client engagement and relationship quality.
  • Accurate and consistent CRM management.
  • Achievement of assigned sales, revenue, and account management targets.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. jobs.title: Tax Practitioner (BBS864)
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Tax Practitioner to handle the full tax compliance cycle for a simulated portfolio of small, owner-managed companies, their directors and shareholders, sole proprietors, and family trusts, from registrations and provisional tax through to annual returns, SARS correspondence, and disputes.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Tax Practitioner to handle the full tax compliance cycle for a simulated portfolio of small, owner-managed companies, their directors and shareholders, sole proprietors, and family trusts, from registrations and provisional tax through to annual returns, SARS correspondence, and disputes. Your work becomes the training data and workflow designs that a cutting-edge AI tax system learns from. This is a long-term, permanent role working directly with the founder and an AI partner at the frontier of AI development in tax.

This is not a traditional tax role. Yes, you will be running each simulated client's full tax year to a professional standard. But you will also be documenting the steps, decisions, and judgments behind your work, not just the outputs, and helping design and test the AI workflows that follow your methodology. If you have hands-on SARS eFiling experience across at least two full filing seasons, understand the South African tax compliance cycle end to end, and have a genuine interest in breaking tax work into clear, teachable steps for AI to follow, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • Own a simulated client portfolio and work alongside an AI partner from day one
  • Long-term, permanent role at the cutting edge of AI development in tax where your judgment directly shapes the AI that tax practitioners will use

What You'll Work On

Tax Returns

  • Prepare individual tax returns (ITR12) including capital gains, collecting IRP5s, IT3 certificates, medical aid and retirement annuity certificates, travel logbooks, and rental schedules, and check auto-assessments before accepting them
  • Complete company tax returns (ITR14) from the signed AFS and the AFS Accountant's tax computation including small business corporation and assessed loss positions
  • Estimate taxable income for company provisional tax (IRP6) for the first and second periods and plan top-up payments to avoid underestimation penalties
  • Estimate taxable income for individual provisional tax (IRP6) for owners and sole proprietors and advise on third top-up payments
  • Prepare dividends tax returns (DTR01) and payments when clients declare dividends and confirm exemption declarations
  • Identify donations above the annual exemption and prepare IT144 returns and payments
  • Prepare IT3(t) submissions and ITR12T trust returns and track distributions and vesting to beneficiaries

SARS Administration

  • Reconcile EMP201 payments to payroll for interim and annual periods and issue IRP5 and IT3(a) certificates (EMP501)
  • Handle one-off client requests including tax numbers, notices of registration, copies of assessments, statements, and confirmation letters
  • Maintain eFiling profiles, practitioner mandates, banking details, and registered particulars; reconcile statements of account; follow up refunds; and obtain Tax Compliance Status PINs
  • Draft objections and appeals, requests for suspension of payment and penalty remission requests, and track each to outcome
  • Respond to SARS verifications and audits with complete supporting documents, working with the AFS Accountant on relevant records, and submit requests for correction
  • Register clients for income tax, provisional tax, PAYE, SDL, UIF, and VAT including mandatory and voluntary VAT registration
  • Update registered representatives and public officers with SARS when directors change
  • Register clients as importers or exporters with SARS Customs and keep customs details current
  • Request instalment payment arrangements for tax debts and track client compliance
  • Deregister dormant clients from income tax, PAYE, and VAT with SARS and file CIPC deregistration once tax affairs are in order

Portfolio and Deadline Management

  • Keep a deadline calendar for every client covering filing season dates, provisional tax periods, EMP501 periods, and ITR14 due dates
  • Plan workload around filing season and the February provisional tax peak
  • Check that SARS third-party data, prior assessments, and payments match the client's information before submitting
  • Handle requests to simulated clients and bookkeepers to obtain missing or unclear documents
  • Flag turnover above the R2.3m VAT registration threshold when a client is not registered
  • Raise tax risks and planning points to your AI partner including loan accounts, fringe benefits, and missed deductions

Building AI for Tax

  • Prepare each simulated return and submission to a professional standard so it serves as high-quality training data
  • Record the steps, decisions, and judgments behind your work in a way that can be taught to an AI model
  • Design and refine the tax workflows the AI follows, step by step
  • Test the AI against your own work, identify where it goes wrong, and help fix it
  • Use AI models day to day to prepare returns, draft SARS correspondence, and check your own work, and apply sound judgment about when their output is correct

What You Bring

  • BCom in Accounting or Taxation, National Diploma in Accounting, or equivalent
  • 1 to 3 years in a tax practice or an accounting practice with tax work, including at least two full filing seasons and provisional tax cycles
  • Hands-on SARS eFiling experience including registrations, ITR12, IRP6, ITR14, and EMP501 submissions, and responding to verification letters
  • Experience drafting objections or SARS audit responses for review by a senior
  • Working knowledge of the Income Tax Act and the Tax Administration Act including capital gains, provisional tax, and the dispute rules
  • Able to manage your own portfolio of returns through filing season with limited supervision
  • Strong Excel skills including lookups, reconciliations, and tax workings
  • Detail-oriented and deadline-driven with a clear understanding that SARS dates and penalties do not move
  • Clear, polite written English for client requests, SARS letters, and objections
  • Genuine interest in AI and in breaking tax work into clear, teachable steps
  • Comfortable working with AI models and able to check and challenge what they produce

Nice to Have

  • Experience running objections and appeals independently including applying the dispute rules, building the argument, and anticipating how SARS will respond
  • Experience handling SARS audits especially VAT and PAYE including judging what to disclose and when to push back
  • Experience with trusts and IT3(t) submissions including distributions, vesting, and attribution rules
  • Experience spotting when donations tax and dividends tax apply such as loans to trusts or dividends in specie
  • Exposure to SARS Customs registrations and processes
  • A SAIT Tax Technician or Tax Professional designation, or working towards one
  • Experience with payroll systems such as Sage VIP, Sage Pastel Payroll, or SimplePay
  • Exposure to practice tax software and Xero, Sage, or Pastel client systems

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your SARS eFiling and tax compliance experience, and walking through a return or SARS dispute you have handled from start to finish

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a detail-oriented junior tax practitioner with hands-on SARS experience, a solid grasp of the South African tax compliance cycle, and a genuine interest in shaping how AI learns to do tax work, this role gives you the ownership, the AI partner, and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote — US working hours overlap Engagement: Full-time / Long-term project Compensation: $160K–$240K annually + meaningful equity Seniority: Senior / Staff About the ProjectWe are looking for a Senior/Staff Software Engineer to join a rapidly growing technology company building infrastructure for AI-powered voice agents.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote — US working hours overlap
Engagement: Full-time / Long-term project
Compensation: $160K–$240K annually + meaningful equity
Seniority: Senior / Staff

About the Project

We are looking for a Senior/Staff Software Engineer to join a rapidly growing technology company building infrastructure for AI-powered voice agents.

The product helps companies test and improve their AI voice agents at scale. The platform can automatically run thousands of simulated calls using different accents, tones, speaking styles, personalities, and scenarios, then analyze the conversations and identify bugs, failures, and unexpected behavior.

The company is experiencing rapid growth and is now scaling its infrastructure from approximately 30K concurrent voice calls toward 100K–200K+ concurrent calls.

A major upcoming initiative is the development of a purpose-built database for conversational AI, designed to efficiently store, process, query, and retrieve massive volumes of voice-agent interaction data.

We're looking for someone who has genuinely built data infrastructure at scale — ideally as a primary author, architect, or technical owner of a database, queue, storage system, streaming platform, or other large-scale data system.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build a purpose-built database for conversational AI data, including storage architecture, indexing, ingestion, query paths, and retrieval at scale.
  • Scale simulation infrastructure from approximately 30K toward 200K+ concurrent voice calls.
  • Architect systems for high availability, graceful degradation, and 99.99% uptime.
  • Own critical backend services built primarily with TypeScript/Node.js and Python.
  • Work with technologies across real-time voice and AI infrastructure, including LiveKit, Temporal, STT/TTS systems, and LLM tooling.
  • Build reliable pipelines for telephony events, recordings, transcripts, evaluations, and call outcomes.
  • Improve distributed tracing and production observability using technologies such as OpenTelemetry and SigNoz.
  • Diagnose and eliminate performance bottlenecks across high-throughput distributed systems.
  • Make architectural decisions around scalability, reliability, latency, storage, and infrastructure costs.
  • Ship quickly, measure production behavior, and continuously iterate. The engineering team currently deploys to production multiple times per day.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend or infrastructure expertise.
  • Proven experience building a database, queue, storage engine, streaming system, distributed data platform, or comparable large-scale infrastructure.
  • Ideally, you were a primary author, architect, or technical owner rather than simply a user or contributor.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems, including partitioning, replication, concurrency, consistency, failure recovery, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
  • Experience scaling infrastructure under significant real-world production load.
  • Ability to discuss previous systems quantitatively — for example, requests/events per second, concurrency, p95/p99 latency, data volumes, availability, cluster size, or cost improvements.
  • Strong backend development experience. TypeScript/Node.js and Python are used on the project, but engineers from other strong infrastructure backgrounds are welcome.
  • Strong understanding of production monitoring, observability, and distributed tracing.
  • High level of ownership and ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment.
  • AI-native mindset: actively using modern AI tools to accelerate engineering, debugging, research, and development.
  • Strong bias to action — comfortable building the smallest working solution, shipping it, learning from production, and iterating.

Nice to Have

  • Database internals / storage engine development
  • Distributed databases
  • Kafka, Pulsar, Redpanda, or similar messaging infrastructure
  • Streaming or high-throughput ingestion systems
  • Query engines and indexing
  • Observability infrastructure
  • OpenTelemetry / SigNoz
  • WebRTC / LiveKit
  • Telephony, SIP, or RTP
  • Voice or audio processing
  • STT/TTS infrastructure
  • LLM infrastructure
  • Experience at a database, data infrastructure, observability, or developer infrastructure company

Recruitment Process

1. Short Screening Interview
A brief AI interview (recommended for faster candidate submission) or conversation with a recruitment agency representative to discuss the candidate's background, relevant experience, and fit for the role.

2. Candidate Submission
The candidate's profile is submitted to the client. We'll notify the candidate once the hiring team confirms whether they would like to proceed.

3. Intro Call — 15 minutes
A brief conversation with a team member to assess culture fit, interest in systems/infrastructure work, ownership mindset, and alignment with a fast-paced engineering environment.

4. Coding Interview — 30 minutes
An open-book live coding session. Candidates are encouraged to use their preferred AI tools while building something in real time. The focus is on coding fluency, speed of prototyping, problem-solving, and an AI-native engineering workflow.

5. Systems Design Interview #1 — 60 minutes
Focused on distributed systems, database architecture, and scalability. The discussion may cover technologies and concepts related to PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and high-scale real-time infrastructure.

6. Systems Design Interview #2 — 60 minutes
A second technical design interview with another engineer, covering a different problem area such as observability, voice simulation infrastructure, data pipelines, or large-scale distributed systems.

7. Paid Work Trial — 2–3 days
A paid trial based on a real engineering problem. This gives both sides an opportunity to evaluate delivery speed, technical decision-making, communication, collaboration, and overall fit.

8. Offer & Hiring
Successful candidates receive an offer following the work trial.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

(remote in approved locations: Location: Louisville, KY (Preferred)Other Locations: Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX; Nashville, TN; New York, NY; Tampa, FL; Washington, DC)
We are seeking a highly analytical and technically curious Technical Cost Analyst, IT Cost Transparency & Optimization to join our IT Cost Transparency team. This role is responsible for analyzing infrastructure consumption, technology assets, financial data, and operational metrics to identify opportunities for cost optimization, rationalization, and improved technology investment decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with foundational knowledge of IT infrastructure, including compute, storage, cloud, network, and data center technologies. Working closely with infrastructure engineering, architecture, finance, procurement, vendor management, and service owners, the Technical Cost Analyst will transform complex technology and financial data into actionable insights, business cases, and recommendations that support cost efficiency and strategic technology decisions.

This position is well suited for professionals with 1-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, FinOps, technical analytics, technical asset management or related disciplines.

Key Responsibilities


Infrastructure Cost Analysis

  • Analyze infrastructure environments including storage, compute, network, cloud, backup, and platform services to identify cost reduction and optimization opportunities.
  • Evaluate technology consumption, utilization, capacity, and growth trends using operational and financial datasets.
  • Develop insights around asset utilization, underused resources, redundant technologies, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Support infrastructure demand forecasting and cost modeling activities.

Data Analysis & Cost Transparency

  • Consolidate and analyze data from multiple sources, including:
  • CMDB platforms
  • Infrastructure monitoring tools
  • Cloud and platform usage reports
  • Purchase orders
  • Vendor contracts
  • Invoice data
  • Asset inventories
  • Financial systems
  • Architecture and engineering documentation
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and trend analysis to ensure accuracy and consistency across sources.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and analytical models to support technology cost transparency initiatives.

Business Case Development

  • Develop financial and technical business cases supporting infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Build hypotheses regarding cost reduction, consumption efficiency, technology modernization, and rationalization opportunities.
  • Quantify potential savings, cost avoidance, investment requirements, and operational impacts.
  • Translate complex data findings into clear, concise, communications for diverse audiences 
  • Partner with infrastructure engineers, architects, service owners, procurement teams, and finance partners to understand technology environments and validate assumptions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve cost management processes, reporting capabilities, and data quality.
  • Contribute to automation and standardization of reporting, analytics, and business case development processes.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.
  • 1-5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • IT infrastructure, Technology Operations
  • FinOps
  • IT asset management
  • Technology financial management
  • IT analytics
  • Technology consulting
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to translate technical information into business-focused recommendations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with infrastructure technologies such as:
  • Storage platforms
  • Virtualization environments
  • Servers and compute platforms
  • Cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Network infrastructure
  • Backup and recovery technologies
  • Demonstrated familiarity with AI concepts and how they are applied in an organization, such as but not limited to: Programming (Python mainly), Machine Learning Basics, Data Handling & Preprocessing
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Snowflake, ServiceNow, or similar reporting and analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of IT financial management, chargeback/showback, TBM, FinOps, or cost allocation methodologies, nice to have, but not required.
  • Exposure to vendor management, contract analysis, software licensing, or procurement processes, nice to have, but not required.
  • Knowledge of CMDB structures and IT asset management practices.
  • Experience building financial models or business cases.
