jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Rezilient, we’re redefining primary care by making access to healthcare more convenient, timely, and seamless.
jobs.description:
At Rezilient, we’re redefining primary care by making access to healthcare more convenient, timely, and seamless. Our innovative CloudClinic model combines virtual provider visits with cutting-edge technology to create a personalized digital healthcare experience that puts patients at the center of their care. By streamlining care delivery and continuously expanding specialty services, we empower our care team to focus on patient well-being while providing the most comprehensive and accessible care possible.

We're seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and performance of the systems that power Rezilient's care delivery. In a healthcare environment, uptime is not a convenience, it's patient care in progress, so this role is critical to ensuring that patients and clinical teams can depend on our platform every time they need it. You'll design and operate the infrastructure, observability, and automation that keep our services fast, resilient, and secure, while partnering closely with Full-Stack, Front-End, Product, and Security teams.

You'll define reliability standards, drive down operational toil through automation, and build the tooling and practices that let a fast-moving engineering team ship confidently without compromising availability or the security of protected health information (PHI). Your work will directly shape how dependably patients receive care and how our providers deliver it, advancing our mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, provision, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent), managing environments across development, staging, and production with repeatable, auditable configuration.
  • Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines to enable safe, frequent deployments, including automated testing gates, blue/green and canary rollouts, and fast, reliable rollbacks.
  • Build and operate observability across the stack, including metrics, logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting, and define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets that align reliability work with product priorities.
  • Lead incident response: on-call rotation participation, triage, mitigation, and clear communication, followed by blameless postmortems that turn failures into systemic fixes.
  • Automate away operational toil through scripting and tooling, reducing manual intervention and improving mean time to detection and recovery.
  • Design for scalability and resilience, including capacity planning, load and failure testing, autoscaling, redundancy, and disaster recovery and backup strategies with defined RTO/RPO targets.
  • Manage containerized workloads and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), including networking, service discovery, and resource management.
  • Partner with Security and Engineering to harden infrastructure: secrets management, network segmentation, encryption, vulnerability scanning, patching, and audit logging consistent with HIPAA-aligned requirements for handling PHI.
  • Collaborate with development teams to embed reliability and operability into services from design through production, balancing "move fast" with "do no harm."

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 5+ years in Site Reliability, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles at startup or growth-stage organizations, ideally within healthcare, health tech, or another regulated, high-availability, data-sensitive industry.
  • Deep hands-on experience operating production systems on a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.
  • Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent) and configuration management.
  • Production experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes), including deployment, scaling, and troubleshooting.
  • Expertise building CI/CD pipelines and release automation, with a track record of enabling safe, frequent deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK/OpenSearch) and defining SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash) and fluency with command-line and cloud CLIs.
  • Experience leading incident response and on-call, including postmortem and root-cause analysis practices.
  • Solid understanding of infrastructure and network security, secrets management, and encryption, with familiarity handling sensitive or protected data (PHI/HIPAA experience strongly preferred).
  • Proficient with Git and version control workflows; familiarity with the Agile Development Framework and ideally the Atlassian toolset (Jira and Confluence).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; calm, methodical, and detail-oriented under pressure, and comfortable owning ambiguity in an early-stage environment.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

This role directly supports GolfNow’s growth by expanding client relationships, increasing technology and product adoption, improving tee time utilization, and strengthening market penetration. This is a remote position.

Budget Execution Analyst

Maritime Administration (MARAD) | Fully Remote

Summary
  • Job Title: Budget Execution Analyst
  • Security: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust / Moderate Risk determination required

  • Work Type: Full-time
  • Program Name: MARAD CFO Financial Management Support Services
  • Agency Name: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Maritime Administration (MARAD), Office of the Chief Financial Officer (MAR-251)
  • Contract Term: September 30, 2026 - September 29, 2031 (base year plus four option years)
  • Start Date: October 2026
  • Reports To: Budget Execution & Accounting Lead; program direction from the Senior Program Manager & CFO Strategic Advisor

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Budget Execution Analyst to support the Maritime Administration (MARAD) CFO Financial Management Support Services program. This is a full-time, fully remote role on an awarded task order, with an October 2026 start date.

Our client is a boutique consulting firm that employs consultants and professionals with unique skill sets to support the federal government with strategic execution, financial process enablement, IT systems, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software implementation.

What will you do

Track MARAD’s funds from apportionment through outlay across appropriated, reimbursable and revolving fund accounts. This role focuses on budget execution and funds control, with a monthly Status of Funds report as the recurring deliverable.

The task order sets standards of 100% timely delivery, 98% calculation accuracy and zero Anti-Deficiency Act threshold breaches, subject to Government review and execution audit. Work is independently reviewed before release, and risks to deadlines or funding limits are escalated to the Senior Program Manager with a recommended action.

Responsibilities
  • Monitor execution across appropriated, reimbursable and revolving fund accounts, linking apportionments and funding controls to commitments, obligations, expenditures, outlays and available balances by fund and period.
  • Track OMB SF-132 apportionments and reapportionments and SF-1151 nonexpenditure fund transfers, maintaining the current apportionment position for each account.
  • Prepare the monthly Status of Funds execution report, planning backward from submission through source cutoff, preparation, independent review and release.
  • Monitor obligation thresholds and immediately escalate potential over-obligation or Anti-Deficiency Act risk through the Senior Program Manager to designated Government officials, without making the determination yourself.
  • Assist in preparing congressional budget justification exhibits and the supporting execution data.
  • Evaluate multi-year funding trends and build execution forecasts from reconciled actuals and estimated remaining activity, using approved plans, award milestones and reimbursable information.
  • Compare actual to forecast each cycle, separating timing shifts from changed requirements or assumptions before recommending rescheduling or addressing funding gaps.
  • Prepare exception briefs identifying the affected funding, amount, timing, cause and recommended action.
  • Support the Budget Execution & Accounting Lead on reimbursable and revolving fund execution questions.
  • Supply validated execution source data to the Business Analytics Lead for management dashboards, with control totals agreed before use.

Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business or a related field.
  • Four or more years of federal financial management experience, including budget execution or funds control.
  • Working knowledge of apportionments, allotments, commitments, obligations, undelivered orders, unliquidated obligations and available balances.
  • Direct experience with SF-132 apportionment preparation or analysis and SF-133 budget execution reporting.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. Standard General Ledger, funds control concepts and Anti-Deficiency Act risk indicators.
  • Ability to work to a fixed monthly delivery calendar and an accuracy standard audited by the customer.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust / Moderate Risk determination.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in a civilian agency CFO office, particularly within the Department of Transportation.
  • Hands-on use of Oracle Federal Financials, particularly DOT’s Delphi.
  • Experience with SF-1151 nonexpenditure transfers and reimbursable or revolving fund execution.
  • Experience preparing congressional budget justification exhibits or OMB MAX A-11 submissions.
  • Experience building execution forecasts that leadership relies on for funding decisions.
  • CGFM, CPA or CDFM credential.

What Success Looks Like
  • In the first 90 days: a working funds-control view by fund and period, the current apportionment position confirmed for every account, and the first Status of Funds report delivered on calendar and accepted without revision.
  • By the end of the base year: zero Anti-Deficiency Act threshold breaches, 100% on-time monthly Status of Funds reporting, calculation accuracy at or above 98%, and forecast variances explained by cause.

Work Authorization and Pre Employment
  • Public Trust / Moderate Risk determination required; work may begin on interim suitability approval where the Government grants it.
  • Candidates who have served in the federal government will be asked to confirm that no post-government employment restriction applies to this work, and to share any separation ethics guidance they received. Our client will complete its own review before an offer is finalized.

jobs.description:
Pediatrics Admin & Front Office Support

Remote | Pediatrics | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $5-$6/hour
Target Start Date: September 14, 2026
Future Schedule: Expected to increase to approximately 40 hours/week as the practice opens and patient volume grows

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and adaptable Virtual Medical Assistant to support a growing pediatric practice during its pre-opening and early growth stages.

This is not a traditional, narrowly defined Medical VA position. During the startup phase, you will work closely with the physician as an administrative and personal assistant, helping coordinate meetings, calendars, vendors, projects, communications, and clinic setup activities.

As the practice begins seeing patients, your responsibilities will gradually transition toward front-office and medical administrative support, including scheduling, patient intake, insurance verification, and patient communication.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a growing environment where priorities can change, takes ownership without needing constant reminders, and can independently identify what needs to be done next.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive, Administrative & Calendar Support

  • Manage and organize the physician's calendars, ensuring meetings, deadlines, agendas, links, documents, and preparation materials are consolidated in one place.

  • Attend administrative and vendor meetings as needed, take clear notes, document action items, and help ensure important follow-ups are completed.

  • Serve as a proactive accountability partner by tracking deadlines, projects, tasks, and outstanding items without requiring constant reminders.

2. Front Office & Patient Communication

  • Manage incoming patient calls, emails, texts, voicemails, and initial inquiries professionally once the clinic begins accepting patients.

  • Assist prospective and existing families with scheduling, follow-ups, basic questions, and other front-office communication needs.

  • Provide a warm, professional first point of contact that reflects the patient-centered experience expected from a pediatric practice.

3. Patient Scheduling, Intake & Registration

  • Coordinate end-to-end patient scheduling, including new patient appointments, follow-ups, rescheduling, and appointment-related communication.

  • Support patient intake and check-in by ensuring required demographic, administrative, and insurance information is collected accurately.

  • Maintain organized patient information and appointment records within eClinicalWorks (eCW) while following established clinic workflows.

4. Insurance Verification & Administrative Support

  • Verify commercial insurance coverage and determine whether patient insurance plans are active, pending, or require additional follow-up.

  • Complete insurance eligibility and benefit verification before appointments and document findings accurately for the practice.

  • Assist with insurance-related administrative tasks and potentially prior authorizations as clinic processes expand.

5. Vendor, Research & Project Coordination

  • Research vendors, clinic equipment, software, and other operational needs and compare available options based on cost, features, and suitability.

  • Organize research findings, pricing comparisons, project updates, and recommendations using spreadsheets and other tracking tools.

  • Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders to keep clinic setup projects progressing according to established timelines.

6. Process Documentation & SOP Development

  • Document recurring workflows and administrative processes as the clinic develops its operating procedures.

  • Create clear step-by-step SOPs for tasks such as scheduling, patient communication, insurance verification, and other recurring activities.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to organize, standardize, and improve workflows as the practice grows.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is REQUIRED. Candidates without prior eCW experience should not be considered.

  • 1+ years previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Assistant, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong administrative, organizational, calendar-management, and task-management skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English with the confidence to communicate professionally with patients, families, vendors, and healthcare professionals.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to organize information, research, projects, and workflows independently.

  • Highly proactive and able to recognize what needs attention without waiting to be reminded.

  • Comfortable working in a startup-style environment where responsibilities and priorities may evolve.

  • Able to multitask effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable using required secure networks, clinic systems, and productivity tracking software.

Strongly Preferred

  • Previous experience working in pediatrics.

  • Experience performing commercial insurance verification.

  • Experience handling prior authorizations for commercial insurance or HMO plans.

  • Experience supporting a physician, clinic owner, executive, or small medical practice.

  • Basic Canva or graphic-editing skills for simple social media or clinic content.

Tools & Systems

Candidates may work with:

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW) EMR, REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • RingRX or similar HIPAA-compliant phone systems

  • Google Calendar or other multi-calendar systems

  • Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet tools

  • Canva

  • Secure private networks/VPNs

  • Productivity tracking software

What Success Looks Like

You will succeed in this role if you become someone the physician can trust to take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate what needs to happen next, and keep important tasks from falling through the cracks.

You should be able to work independently, organize competing priorities, communicate professionally with families, and help create systems that allow the physician to focus more heavily on patient care.

As the practice grows, success will also mean helping create a smooth patient experience from the first phone call through scheduling, intake, insurance verification, and ongoing follow-up.

jobs.description:
About the Role


The Opportunity


We are seeking a Vice President, Strategic Account Sales to build and lead Esko’s global Tier 1 Strategic Account organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, this leader will be responsible for a defined portfolio of existing customers and prospective customers that meet Esko’s strategic-account criteria based on factors such as revenue potential, global complexity, portfolio fit, strategic relevance, and long-term partnership opportunity.


This leader will own the overall commercial performance of the Tier 1 portfolio—including new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, recurring-revenue growth, profitability, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy. The Vice President will lead a team of Global Strategic Account Managers who serve as the single commercial owners of their assigned accounts, managing the full relationship from strategy and executive alignment through opportunity development and commercial execution.


The mandate is to transform how Esko engages its most important customers and prospects: moving from transactional, product-led selling to consultative, value-based partnerships. This includes establishing rigorous account and pursuit planning, building executive-level relationships, uncovering enterprise-wide opportunities, and developing strategic commercial models such as multiyear agreements and Enterprise License Agreements.


The Vice President will bring together Sales, Customer Success, Presales, Product, Services, Marketing, partners, and Esko’s executive leadership around one coordinated strategy for each account. Success will be measured by sustainable portfolio growth, strong retention and expansion, new strategic customer acquisition, improved commercial discipline, deeper executive relationships, and customers who view Esko as a trusted strategic partner.


What You'll Do


In this role, you will:


  • Build and lead Esko’s global Strategic Account Sales organization, establishing the operating model, performance expectations, and execution standards for the Tier 1 portfolio.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Global Strategic Account Managers, with each SAM serving as the single commercial owner of assigned strategic customers and prospects.
  • Own the overall commercial performance of the Tier 1 portfolio, including bookings, recurring-revenue growth, new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, profitability, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy.
  • Establish clear criteria and governance for identifying and managing strategic customers and high-potential prospects in partnership with Esko’s leadership team.
  • Develop and execute multiyear strategic account plans for existing customers and comprehensive pursuit plans for Tier 1 prospects.
  • Expand Esko’s presence within strategic customers by identifying new buying centers, business units, geographies, use cases, and enterprise-wide opportunities across Esko’s portfolio.
  • Shift customer engagement from transactional product selling to consultative, value-based selling through executive discovery, trusted-advisor workshops, business-value assessments, and outcome-based proposals.
  • Develop and execute strategic commercial models, including Enterprise License Agreements, multiyear agreements, and portfolio-based solutions that increase customer value and strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Build strong, multilevel relationships across customer organizations, including executive sponsors, business leaders, operational stakeholders, procurement, and technology teams.
  • Establish executive sponsorship, account governance, strategic customer workshops, and regular business reviews for Esko’s most important relationships.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and deal strategist for significant opportunities, ensuring disciplined qualification, competitive positioning, negotiation, pricing, discount governance, and deal closure.
  • Orchestrate Presales, Customer Success, Product, Services, Marketing, product specialists, partners, and Esko executives around a single account strategy with clear roles and rules of engagement.
  • Partner with Customer Success to protect retention, drive adoption and customer value, identify expansion opportunities, and address account risk proactively.
  • Implement consistent operating discipline across account planning, pipeline management, opportunity progression, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and business reviews.
  • Represent the voice of strategic customers internally, using market and customer insight to inform product, packaging, services, and go-to-market priorities while balancing individual requests with Esko’s broader strategic direction.
  • Build the capabilities, methodologies, playbooks, and coaching practices required to scale a world-class strategic-account organization globally.

What We're Looking For


Minimum Qualifications


These are the must-have requirements for the role:


  • Experience leading a global enterprise sales teams in a recurring revenue B2B software environment
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing sales teams that have delivered measurable ARR growth through acquisition, expansion, and customer retention
  • Demonstrated ability to design and execute multi-year account strategies across complex, multinational customer
  • Experience leading teams through complex sales cycles, including contract negotiation and deal closure at the executive level
  • Experience with CRM tools and commercial reporting, with demonstrated ability to drive accurate team forecasting and pipeline management
  • Collaborative leadership skills with demonstrated ability to coordinate and influence cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Finance, and Customer Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications


These are nice-to-have skills that will set candidates apart:


  • Experience selling or managing accounts within the packaging, print technology, pre-media, or digital workflow software industries
  • Background in building or transforming a Strategic Account Management function within a global software organization
  • Experience with MEDDPPIC
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, and an AI automated GTM tech stack
  • Experience with value selling
  • Additional language proficiency relevant to global Tier 1 account engagement

About Esko

It's all possible with a role at ​Esko ​. Esko, a ​Veralto ​ company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.​​


About Veralto

At Veralto, our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™ is more than words: it's a proven path towards positive change, improvement for our planet, and development for yourself. Whether we're ensuring the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting our waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, the work we do every day contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 13 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.​​

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Clinical Pharmacist with a PharmD degree and experience in HEDIS medication adherence initiatives. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in improving medication adherence rates among patients, ensuring compliance with HEDIS/Medicare quality measures, and driving overall health outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

HEDIS Quality Measures:

  • Lead efforts to improve HEDIS medication adherence and other pharmacy quality measures, including but not limited to adherence to antihypertensive, cholesterol-lowering, and diabetes medications.
  • Analyze medication adherence data, identify gaps in care, and implement targeted interventions to improve adherence rates.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, and other stakeholders to develop and implement strategies that promote adherence to prescribed therapies.

Patient Engagement:

  • Conduct medication therapy management (MTM) sessions to address barriers to adherence, provide patient education, and ensure understanding of medication regimens.
  • Work directly with patients to identify and resolve issues related to medication adherence, including cost, side effects, and complex dosing schedules.
  • Utilize motivational interviewing techniques to encourage patients to adhere to their prescribed medication regimens.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Monitor and track HEDIS performance metrics, generating reports to assess the effectiveness of interventions and programs.
  • Use electronic health records (EHR) and pharmacy data to identify patients at risk of non-adherence and develop action plans.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership on progress towards HEDIS goals and make recommendations for improvement.

Collaboration & Training:

  • Serve as a medication adherence subject matter expert (SME) within the organization.
  • Provide training and support to other pharmacists, care managers, and clinical staff on best practices in medication adherence.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams focused on quality improvement, population health management, and value-based care initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited school of pharmacy.
  • Active pharmacist license in one or more of the following states: TX, PA, AL, TN.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in HEDIS-related medication adherence work, quality improvement, or population health.
  • Strong knowledge of HEDIS measures, particularly those related to medication adherence.
  • Proficiency in using EHR systems and data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team-oriented environment.
  • Experience with motivational interviewing or other patient engagement techniques is a plus.

WOULD LOVE FOR YOU HAVE

  • Experience in a managed care setting, pharmacy benefits management (PBM), or a healthcare quality improvement role.
  • Certification in Medication Therapy Management (MTM), Certified Geriatric Pharmacist (CGP), or other relevant credentials.
  • Understanding of value-based care models and their impact on medication adherence.

The ideal candidate combines strong Salesforce platform knowledge with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value for clients, prospects, partners, and internal teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Salesforce stakeholders and Merkle growth teams to develop and execute joint go-to-market strategies, solution positioning, and growth initiatives.

  • Help position Merkle as a leading AI and Salesforce partner through marketplace engagement, executive relationship building, enablement initiatives, and joint marketing activities.

JOIN A MISSION DRIVEN PRACTICE THAT SERVES WITH PURPOSE

For more than 30 years, Light Counseling has served thousands of individuals, couples, and families across Virginia and beyond. We provide professional, confidential, distinctly Christian counseling grounded in clinical excellence and God's truth.

Our mission is simple: bring hope to the hopeless and healing to the hurting.

We are seeking Licensed Mental Health Clinicians across the United States who are passionate about providing exceptional telehealth services while integrating Christian faith with evidence-based clinical care. This fully remote opportunity allows you to serve clients across our growing national provider network while enjoying the flexibility and independence of a 1099 contractor role.

WHY JOIN LIGHT COUNSELING

  • Flexible remote schedule with autonomy over your caseload
  • Opportunity to serve clients across multiple states through our expanding national provider network
  • Mission-driven culture rooted in faith and service
  • Collaborative team of experienced clinical and administrative professionals
  • Ongoing opportunities for professional development, consultation, and clinical support
  • Meaningful work that allows you to make a lasting impact in the lives of individuals, couples, and families

CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE

Contractors with Light Counseling are expected to maintain the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality while adhering to all applicable federal and state privacy laws, including HIPAA. Clinicians are expected to exercise sound clinical judgment, maintain accurate documentation, and practice in accordance with all licensing board requirements, ethical standards, and company policies.

Clinical Care

  • Deliver evidence-based therapeutic interventions while integrating Christian faith when clinically appropriate and desired by the client
  • Monitor client progress and modify treatment plans as needed
  • Refer clients to appropriate community resources or specialty providers when necessary
  • Respond appropriately to crisis situations following clinical and organizational protocols

Documentation & Compliance

Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact - fast. We're looking for a solutions engineer to join our Payout Rails team, owning the technical connections that move money into banks, wallets, and aggregators worldwide.

What you will get to do :

  • Own technical onboarding for new payout partners: API review, environment setup, credential exchange, certification, and launch
  • Translate partner API specifications into internal configuration: corridor and rail setup, field mappings, account and alias validation, error code mappings
  • Solution the integration per corridor and produce the specs delivery runs on: sequence diagrams, field mappings, validation rules, test matrices
  • Stay on the connection after launch: keep SLAs where they need to be and drive every failure through to a fix, whether the cause sits with the partner or with us
  • Build evidence based escalations on rejection rates, error code accuracy, and SLA misses, and hold partners to their commitments
  • Keep the critical path visible across partner, platform, Compliance, and Commercial teams, and feed recurring friction into the platform roadmap instead of absorbing it as manual work

Who you are :

You own a connection end to end and follow it into production. You can explain a payment rail to an engineer and an API contract to a business lead in the same meeting. You would rather remove the cause of a recurring problem than keep handling each instance of it.

Technical Skills:

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, integration engineering, technical account management, or platform engineering, in payments, fintech, or banking
  • Strong practical command of REST and JSON APIs: OAuth 2.0, mTLS, JWT, API keys, webhooks, idempotency
  • Comfortable with Postman and reading raw request and response traces
  • Hands on SQL for investigation, able to query transaction data and turn it into an argument
  • Working knowledge of payment rails and message standards: ISO 20022, ISO 8583, instant versus deferred batch clearing, alias and account resolution, settlement versus clearing
  • Clear writing: specifications, diagrams, escalation notes, and status updates that partner teams and internal stakeholders can both read

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to AML and sanctions screening, name matching, and how compliance controls surface as technical rejections

MoneyGram is a global payments network built to move money across borders with speed, simplicity and trust. The company serves over 60 million customers a year across 200+ countries and territories, nearly half a million retail locations and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem reaching billions of devices. jobs.description:
Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide

Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

  • PCI DSS Compliance Management:
    • Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

  • Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.
  • Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
  • Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field (or

equivalent work experience).

  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in information security, PCI compliance, or a related field.
    • Previous experience as an ISA, QSA, or a similar role is highly desirable.
  • Certifications:
    • Certified PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) or Certified PCI Professional (PCIP) certifications preferred.

Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CEH are a plus.

  • Skills and Competencies:
    • Deep understanding of PCI DSS requirements and data security best practices.
    • Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, encryption, etc.).
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross- functionally.
    • Proficiency in using security assessment tools and techniques (e.g., vulnerability scanners, SIEM).

Other Requirements:

Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Occasional travel may be required for audits or compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation:
    • Identify and assess potential risks to cardholder data environments and provide recommendations for risk mitigation.
    • Implement and enforce necessary security controls to address gaps identified during assessments.
    • Ensure vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security reviews are conducted to identify weaknesses and ensure continuous compliance.
  • Training and Awareness:
    • Conduct internal PCI DSS training for staff to ensure a deep understanding of the importance of compliance and security measures.
    • Provide ongoing guidance and support to departments regarding security best practices related to PCI DSS.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
    • Work closely with projects, Enterprise Security, Technology, and other relevant departments to align PCI DSS compliance with overall security policies and practices.
    • Proactively identify and/or promptly escalate risks and issues affecting PCI compliance status.
    • Stay updated on changes in PCI DSS requirements and industry best practices to ensure our client from banking industry remains compliant.
    • Present PCI DSS compliance status reports to senior management and external stakeholders.
    • Act as a liaison where necessary between our client from banking industry and external vendors or service providers involved in processing or storing cardholder data.

Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.

We deliver this through three comprehensive solutions:

  • Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
  • Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
  • Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.

What we’re looking for:

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Pricing and Profitability to join the Strategic Finance team. This individual will shape and implement Arcadia's pricing strategy in partnership with our executive leadership, own the deal desk, and lead cost-to-serve analysis, building the models, systems, and insights that help us win the right customers on the right terms and expand margins as we scale. Leading a team of 1–2 analysts, you'll partner closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Operations to translate unit economics into clear commercial decisions. The ideal candidate is a rigorous quantitative thinker with deep SaaS-plus-services pricing experience, a builder's mindset, and a track record of using AI and automation to turn manual analysis into scalable, repeatable processes.

Arcadia is open to fully remote candidates and employees have access to co-working spaces.

What you'll do:

  • Drive the development of Arcadia's pricing strategy in partnership with the CFO, CPO, and CCO, bringing the analysis and recommendations that inform decisions on list pricing, packaging, discount guidelines, and renewal and expansion pricing across our SaaS, services, and payment-related offerings.
  • Lead cost-to-serve analysis across products, customer segments, and delivery models, identifying margin drivers and partnering with Operations and Customer Success on efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the implementation of pricing decisions, translating strategy into pricing structures, approval policies, and Salesforce CPQ configuration that Sales can execute consistently.
  • Lead the deal desk: redesign and maintain deal evaluation models used for approvals, set clear margin and approval guardrails, and serve as a trusted advisor to Sales on structuring complex enterprise deals.
  • Build and own customer lifetime value (LTV) and unit economics models, connecting acquisition cost, gross margin, retention, and expansion to guide investment decisions.
  • Own the customer segmentation model that informs strategic resource allocation and service delivery, ensuring our highest-value customers receive the right level of support and our cost structure matches customer value.
  • Implement and optimize systems, tools, and workflows (Salesforce CPQ, BI, reporting) that operationalize pricing and deal governance at scale.
  • Use AI and automation to streamline deal reviews, reporting, and analysis, reducing manual effort and increasing speed to insight.
  • Track and report on pricing realization, discounting trends, deal profitability, and margin performance to executive leadership.
  • Manage and develop a team of 1–2 analysts, fostering a culture of rigor, curiosity, and ownership.

What will help you succeed:

Must-haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, strategic finance, FP&A, or related roles, including 5+ years of progressive pricing experience at high-growth technology companies.
  • Excellent strategic thinking and quantitative skills, including the ability to manipulate and analyze large, complex data sets (advanced Excel/Sheets required; SQL or similar strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience defining pricing strategies, performing costing and cost-to-serve analyses, and implementing systems to operationalize them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools to automate processes and improve analytical workflows.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS plus services business models, including subscription metrics, services margins, and the unit economics that connect them.
  • Experience building deal evaluation, LTV, and customer segmentation models that directly influence executive decisions.
  • Proven ability to influence and partner with senior cross-functional stakeholders, especially Sales leadership, and to communicate complex analysis clearly and persuasively.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing analysts.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Exposure to bill payment technologies and cash management or payment-related revenue streams (e.g., float income, transaction fees).
  • Experience with CPQ and deal desk tooling and BI platforms.
  • Experience in energy, utilities, fintech, or enterprise B2B data platforms.
  • MBA or advanced degree in finance, economics, or a related quantitative field.

Benefits:

  • Flexible PTO - no accrued hours and no limit on the number of vacation days exempt employees can take each year
  • 11 annual holidays

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Edge AI Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2

Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an Edge AI Engineer to design, optimize, and deploy machine learning models that run efficiently on resource-constrained edge devices, including mobile platforms, embedded systems, and specialized accelerators. The role requires deep expertise in model compression, quantization, and hardware-aware optimization, along with strong systems engineering skills to ship reliable AI capabilities outside the data center. The ideal candidate has shipped edge AI in production environments where compute, memory, energy, and connectivity constraints fundamentally shape the engineering trade-offs.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement edge AI solutions optimized for diverse hardware including mobile SoCs, NPUs, and embedded accelerators.
  • Apply quantization, pruning, distillation, and architectural optimization to fit models within edge constraints.
  • Tune model performance for latency, energy efficiency, and memory footprint on target hardware.
  • Build cross-platform inference runtimes leveraging frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime, and Core ML.
  • Optimize models for specific accelerator backends including DSPs, NPUs, and mobile GPUs.
  • Implement on-device model update, versioning, and rollback workflows that allow safe staged rollouts to large device populations and rapid recovery if a model release behaves unexpectedly in the field.
  • Design hybrid edge-cloud architectures that gracefully degrade based on connectivity and device capability.
  • Build telemetry pipelines that respect privacy while enabling continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and product teams to align AI capabilities with device constraints.
  • Implement secure execution paths, model protection, and integrity verification on edge devices.
  • Develop benchmarking suites that characterize accuracy, latency, and energy trade-offs across devices.
  • Drive responsible AI considerations including on-device privacy and bias evaluation.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Stay current with edge AI hardware and software developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in ML engineering, with significant work on edge or mobile AI.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience with model compression, quantization, and pruning techniques.
  • Experience with at least one major edge inference framework.
  • Solid understanding of mobile and embedded hardware architectures.
  • Experience deploying ML models to production on mobile or embedded platforms.
  • Strong performance engineering and profiling skills.
  • Familiarity with on-device privacy and security considerations.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with custom NPU or DSP toolchains.
  • Familiarity with federated learning or on-device personalization.
  • Exposure to safety-critical or industrial edge deployments.
  • Open-source contributions to edge AI frameworks.
  • Experience optimizing LLMs for on-device inference.

Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

The Manager, Cyber Defense & SaaS Security is a hands-on, technical role split between owning the SaaS Security function end-to-end (75%) and serving as the Cyber Defense representative supporting the Security Operations Center (SOC) floor (25%). In the SaaS Security capacity, this role is the primary owner of SaaS-related tooling, risk, threats, gaps, and detections, partnering across Cyber Defense and other lanes of the business to secure HealthEquity's SaaS footprint end to end. This role provides Cyber Defense presence during core business hours, running the SOC floor and enabling timely coordination on real-time security and operational issues. This role requires strong hands-on technical depth in SaaS security balanced with the presence and judgment to be a trusted point of contact for real-time coordination on the floor.

What you'll be doing

SaaS Security — 75% of role

  • Own the SaaS Security function end to end, including tooling strategy, deployment, and administration (e.g., SaaS Security Posture Management / SSPM platforms, CASB, OAuth/app-to-app risk tooling).
  • Identify, assess, and track risks across HealthEquity's SaaS application footprint, including misconfigurations, excessive permissions, risky third-party integrations, and shadow IT.
  • Monitor for and analyze SaaS-specific threats, translating threat intelligence into SaaS-relevant detections and mitigations.
  • Identify and close security gaps across the SaaS environment, including coverage gaps in monitoring, logging, and access governance.
  • Build and tune detections for SaaS-based attack techniques (e.g., OAuth abuse, token theft, suspicious admin activity, anomalous data movement) in partnership with Threat Detection and Threat Hunting.
  • Partner with IT, Procurement, GRC, Engineering, and business application owners to embed security requirements into SaaS onboarding, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory and risk register of SaaS applications in use across the organization, including unsanctioned or unmanaged SaaS discovered through monitoring.
  • Report on SaaS security posture, risk trends, and program maturity to Cyber Defense leadership.
  • Represent SaaS Security in cross-functional security initiatives, audits, and vendor risk assessments as needed.
  • Direct the day-to-day work of the assigned Cyber Defense contractor, assigning priorities and reviewing output to ensure consistent SaaS Security coverage.

Cyber Defense Representative — 25% of role

  • Serve as the Cyber Defense representative during core business hours.
  • Support timely, coordination of real-time security and operational issues as they arise, connecting SOC analysts with the appropriate Cyber Defense resources or escalation paths.
  • Act as a visible, accessible point of contact for the SOC team and other stakeholders needing rapid Cyber Defense input or triage support.
  • Help maintain day-to-day SOC floor operational rhythm, flagging emerging issues or coordination gaps to the appropriate team leads.
  • Assist with coordination during active incidents occurring during work hours, in support of the broader Incident Command process.

What you will need to be successful

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 5–8 years of cybersecurity experience, with meaningful hands-on time in SaaS security, cloud security, or application security.
  • Direct experience administering or operating SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), CASB, or similar SaaS/cloud security tooling.
  • Experience working in or closely with a Security Operations Center (SOC) environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, financial services, or similar) is strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Deep working knowledge of SaaS security risk, including OAuth/app permission models, SaaS-to-SaaS integration risk, and common SaaS misconfiguration patterns.
  • Hands-on detection engineering skills applicable to SaaS and identity-centric attack techniques.
  • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework as it applies to cloud and SaaS environments.
  • Strong cross-functional partnering skills, with the ability to influence application owners, IT, and engineering teams without formal authority.
  • Comfortable operating as a point of contact for the SOC floor, with strong real-time judgment and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications preferred: GCTI, GCIH, AZ-500, or equivalent cloud/SaaS security certifications.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$120500.00 To $157000.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

Onboarding & Travel

Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

jobs.description:
This is the core FP&A execution role. KLDiscovery is looking for someone who can own the financial models, reporting packages, and close operations that the US Finance team currently builds manually. You will run them overnight, so the US team arrives to finished, reviewed deliverables every morning. Three areas: financial modeling (rolling forecast, EBITDA Bridge, scenarios), BI and reporting (BL packages, dashboards, BvA templates, Investor Package), and close operations (checklist, accruals, accounting liaison).

KLDiscovery is a $350M PE-backed company going through a Quality of Earnings process. The financial work you produce will be reviewed by the CFO, referenced in PE sponsor materials, and used in a transaction process. Financial modeling quality, output precision, and formatting discipline are non-negotiable. If your models have errors or your outputs need to be reformatted by the US team, this is not the right role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Rolling forecast: monthly actuals ingestion → model update in Pigment → reforecast remaining periods → ±5/10% sensitivity → assumptions memo for SVP review

  • EBITDA Bridge: monthly production from June 2026 — actual vs. budget, vs. prior year, waterfall format, variance commentary per KLD standards

  • Business line (BL) packages: monthly for all business lines — revenue, cost, headcount, variance vs. budget, formatted per KLD template

  • BvA templates: maintain in Pigment; ensure commentary standards are applied consistently across all lines

  • Investor Package: pull from Pigment, format per template, assemble first draft for FP&A Director review

jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Project Manager - Design

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States (Periodic travel for client meetings, design workshops, and project coordination required)

JOB SUMMARY

The Project Manager - Design is responsible for end-to-end delivery of assigned Building Automation System (BAS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design projects supporting mission-critical and hyperscale data center facilities as an MEP consultant.

This role owns project scope, schedule, financial performance, design coordination, risk management, and client communication from project kickoff through design development and construction administration. The Project Manager works closely with Smart Tech Contracting Control Systems engineers, client teams, architects, Engineers of Record, and consultant partners responsible for other portions of the MEP design. Primary clients for this role are architecture and engineering (AE) firms that deliver programs / projects direct to the owner, with Smart Tech Contracting engaged as their BAS/EPMS design subconsultant. Depending on the project, this role also interfaces with owners, general contractors, and controls contractors.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of accountability for assigned projects and operates with a high degree of independence while aligning with departmental standards, processes, and leadership direction. This role is expected to anticipate risk, drive decisions, and protect design quality, schedule, client satisfaction, and margin.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Design Project Execution & Delivery (45%)

  • Own planning, execution, and delivery of assigned BAS and EPMS design projects from kickoff through construction administration
  • Lead project initiation activities including scope review, contract requirements, project setup, deliverable schedules, staffing needs, and execution planning
  • Manage design milestones across applicable phases including concept design, SD, DD, IFP/IFC, bid support, and construction administration
  • Coordinate Smart Tech engineers and MEP consultant partners to ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Track and coordinate design documentation including basis of design, sequences of operation, points and alarm lists, system architecture / riser diagrams, specifications, schedules, and integration requirements
  • Coordinate design reviews, page turns, interdisciplinary reviews, and QA/QC activities
  • Manage RFIs, submittal reviews, design clarifications, and other construction-administration activities within project scope
  • Identify scope gaps, design conflicts, and coordination issues and drive them to resolution while ensuring deliverables meet client standards, applicable codes, contract requirements, and departmental quality expectations
  • Support development of BAS/EPMS-specific input to Owner Project Requirements (OPR) and early space-planning / schematic design efforts in coordination with the AE’s basis of design
  • Represent Smart Tech Contracting at site visits, including existing-condition surveys and BAS/EPMS-related punch-list walkthroughs
  • Coordinate BAS/EPMS scope interfaces with other MEP subconsultants, electrical and mechanical engineers, and controls subcontractors as Smart Tech’s design-side point of contact
  • Coordinate resource and material forecasting for assigned design scope
  • Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional / functional testing, and BAS/EPMS project closeout activities during construction administration

Financial & Change Management (20%)

  • Own project budgets, forecasts, profitability, and financial performance
  • Monitor labor utilization, consultant costs, project burn, and remaining effort against budget
  • Maintain accurate project forecasts and communicate financial risks to leadership
  • Identify changes in scope and prepare additional-service proposals and change-order documentation
  • Support client negotiations related to scope, schedule, fees, and contract adjustments while protecting design quality and client satisfaction
  • Develop and maintain schedules of value / cost schedules to support client progress billing
  • Evaluate controls-subcontractor and vendor proposals during procurement and construction administration and provide award recommendations where applicable

Schedule & Risk Management (15%)

  • Develop and maintain project schedules aligned with client and overall MEP design milestones
  • Track design deliverables, dependencies, decisions, reviews, and approvals
  • Identify schedule, staffing, scope, technical, and commercial risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans
  • Coordinate resource needs with engineering and department leadership and escalate significant risks, client concerns, or delivery constraints as appropriate

Client & Stakeholder Management (15%)

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact for assigned projects
  • Lead project meetings with clients, architects, MEP consultants, Engineers of Record, internal engineering teams, and other project stakeholders
  • Communicate project status, financial performance, schedule, risks, technical decisions, and action items clearly and professionally
  • Maintain strong working relationships with client teams and consultant partners to support successful delivery and repeat business
  • Promote Smart Tech Contracting’s BAS/EPMS design capabilities to AE firms, owners, and industry partners; support marketing materials and firm positioning within the design community
  • Identify and develop new project opportunities with existing AE and client relationships to support account growth
  • Support proposal development, project expansions, and additional-service opportunities and represent Smart Tech Contracting professionally as an MEP design consultant

Process Improvement & Administration (5%)

  • Maintain accurate project documentation, meeting minutes, action logs, schedules, forecasts, and status reports
  • Utilize Smartsheet and other project-management tools to provide transparency into project performance
  • Support departmental standards, templates, lessons learned, and best-practice libraries
  • Maintain project contract administration records; manage personal and project hours using company tools
  • Leverage AI and emerging technologies where appropriate to improve project planning, reporting, workflow efficiency, and consistency

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI-enabled tools and workflow automation across design documentation, forecasting, and quality processes for BAS/EPMS projects
  • Support adoption of Smart Tech Contracting’s SmartTech.ai platform and related tools to strengthen design readiness, QA/QC, and project controls
  • Collaborate with the Special Projects & Innovation (SPI) team to pilot and roll out emerging technologies that align with departmental standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity
  • Promote a culture of innovation and continuous improvement in the use of technology to optimize design delivery and scalability

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Working knowledge of MEP consulting and design-project delivery
  • Working knowledge of BAS/BMS and/or EPMS systems and their relationship to mechanical and electrical systems
  • Understanding of MEP design phases and construction-document development
  • Ability to coordinate technical design deliverables including sequences of operation, points / alarm lists, system diagrams, specifications, and integration requirements
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, standards, submittals, and equipment data
  • Knowledge of mission-critical facility and data-center design requirements strongly preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent design projects, competing deadlines, and project stakeholders
  • Proven ability to manage project budgets, forecasts, profitability, scope changes, and change orders
  • Strong project scheduling, risk-management, organizational, and decision-making skills
  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite and project-management / design-collaboration platforms such as Smartsheet, Bluebeam, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360, or similar
  • Familiarity with Revit / BIM design workflows preferred
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, MEP consultants, clients, and construction teams
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through strong communication, organization, self-motivation, proactiveness, and accountability
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet compressed design schedules
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve project workflows and operational efficiency
  • Knowledge of MEP, fire alarm (FA), and fire protection (FP) trades and their interface with BAS/EPMS systems
  • Knowledge of Method of Procedure (MOP) development and critical-facility work-notification processes
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working on a computer
  • Ability to move through offices, project sites, and facility environments as needed
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move items up to 25 pounds

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience may be considered
  • 5+ years of project management, design management, or engineering-project delivery experience within MEP consulting, building automation, controls, or technically complex facilities
  • Demonstrated experience owning projects through multiple design phases
  • MEP consulting / design experience strongly preferred
  • BAS/BMS and/or EPMS project experience strongly preferred
  • Mission-critical or data-center design experience strongly preferred

BENEFITS

Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option

Senior Commercial Lines Producer
