jobs.excerpt: Job Type: Full-timeReports to: Co-CEOLocation: Remote within the contiguous U.
jobs.description:
Job Type: Full-time

Reports to: Co-CEO

Location: Remote within the contiguous U.S. We have a preference for candidates based in or near the Los Angeles area, given the role’s engagement with RTT’s Entertainment community. The role will periodically require travel to Los Angeles for in-person programming and/or availability for evening events and programs aligned to Pacific Time.

About Resetting the Table

Resetting the Table (RTT) equips leaders and communities from every corner of American life to counter toxic polarization and build a shared society and democracy. Through rigorous training, courageous dialogue, and empathy-generating media content, we enable Americans to transform differences into an engine of strengthened relationship, trust, and problem-solving in our country and communities. RTT’s trainings and forums have directly reached more than 100,000 participants across the U.S., many of them industry-shaping TV writers and executives, faith leaders, higher education administrators, and other leaders positioned to make far-reaching culture change and indirectly impact millions more. Informed by combined expertise in the fields of mediation, conflict transformation, trauma therapy, and social research, our methodology for building “healthy conflict” in communities is nationally recognized and highly sought after.

RTT’s renowned Multivocal Storytelling framework equips Hollywood creatives and executives with tools to meet one of the industry’s most urgent challenges: telling stories that resonate across audiences in a polarized America, while directly engaging charged issues that shape viewers’ lives. In this volatile moment, this position offers an exciting opportunity to play a meaningful role in harnessing the power of storytelling and popular entertainment to rehumanize across divides while strengthening stories and broadening reach.

RTT’s work is meaningful, complex, and deeply rewarding — you will contribute to transforming societal conflict while working alongside exceptionally thoughtful and caring colleagues. At RTT, we see the motivation, growth, and well-being of our team members as a critical ingredient to our success. We are committed to fostering a workplace environment that models our work in the world: welcoming, bold, collaborative, supportive, and creating the conditions to bring out people’s best contributions.

The Opportunity

Resetting the Table (RTT) is seeking a Managing Director, Entertainment to lead the ongoing translation of our Entertainment program’s ambitious vision and strategy into coordinated action, overseeing the team and systems to drive high impact at a pivotal moment of growth. You will supervise three seasoned leaders rich with strategic insights, expertise, and relationships in the industry, leveraging their strengths and stewarding team cohesion and shared direction. This is a role for someone who is energized by building the conditions to support teams to excel and execute at their highest level — a highly organized orchestrator and skilled manager who turns big picture commitments into ongoing workflows and implementation. You will bring deep management experience and knowledge of the entertainment industry to a mission-driven organization with a bold vision for the role popular entertainment can play in countering our societal crisis of division and distrust.

What You’ll Do

This is a leadership role focused on overseeing a talented team, driving the structures and actionable plans that enable its success, and accelerating RTT’s impact in catalyzing humanizing stories in TV, film, and digital content that bridge divides. Your work will include:

Team Leadership & Management (50%)

  • Lead the Entertainment team to support its greatest strategic impact, working closely with senior leadership and synthesizing members’ distinct expertise and strategic perspectives toward shared goals
  • Partner with each team member to transform big-picture strategies into focused workplans through regular team meetings and one-on-ones with direct reports
  • Establish team rhythms and accountability practices that create visibility into progress, surface challenges, and keep workstreams moving forward
  • Serve as a thought partner and sounding board to the co-CEOs and senior leadership, synthesizing information across workstreams, surfacing opportunities and needs, and ensuring that day-to-day decisions stay aligned with the organization’s longer-term goals

Strategy Execution & Operationalization (30%)

  • Translate the Entertainment program’s strategies into roadmaps for execution, establishing ongoing priorities, decision-making processes, and timelines to bring the vision to life
  • Oversee and refine the systems that enable the team to manage complex work effectively, including breaking projects into tasks and deliverables, delegating ownership, tracking progress, and following through across program design and delivery, follow-on action items, and the team’s portfolio of relationships
  • Steward the production and delivery of RTT's entertainment-facing materials and communications, ensuring work is strategically aligned and reflects a high standard of excellence
  • Partner with RTT's development team to ensure capturing of the evidence, stories, and relationship data that demonstrate program impact and enhance funder reporting

Alumni Engagement Strategy (20%)

  • Hone a strategic approach to activating RTT’s alumni network, strengthening the systems, data, and engagement practices needed to deepen relationships, identify high-value opportunities, and deepen impact and connections across the industry
  • Oversee the creation of meaningful pathways for alumni to stay engaged with RTT, integrating alumni engagement into the Entertainment team’s priority work and creating opportunities for alumni to deepen their learning and collaboration with RTT
  • Continuously assess and evolve the alumni engagement strategy, identifying opportunities to increase participation and maximize the network’s contribution to RTT’s cultural impact and footprint in the entertainment industry

Who You Are

  • You're the person who makes things run. You look at a complex web of people, timelines, and deliverables and instinctively start building the structure that moves it all forward with a high bar for excellence.
  • You know the entertainment industry from the inside. You speak the language, understand the dynamics, and know how the industry moves. You can look at our team and alumni community and see the depth of experience and potential for strong impact it represents.
  • You bring out the best in the people around you. You lead by partnering—setting clear direction, checking in with purpose, and making sure your team has what they need to do their strongest work.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to build something exceptional. You care deeply about quality, not just completion. You notice what could be better, ask thoughtful questions, and push toward stronger strategy, clearer execution, and better outcomes. You bring both ambition and discernment to the work, knowing when to move quickly, when to go deeper, and when something is good enough to move forward.
  • You're as strong in a room as you are behind the scenes. You can represent an organization with credibility at industry events and in Hollywood's professional circles, and you're just as effective at supporting a team to execute at its highest potential and oversee the systems that keep the work running day to day.
  • You believe in RTT’s mission and Multivocal Storytelling framework. You care about overcoming societal polarization and uplifting dignity, authenticity, and complexity across lines of difference. You believe it is crucial for more Americans to communicate and collaborate constructively across differences in backgrounds and ideological views. You proactively pursue opportunities to learn from divergent perspectives.

What You Bring

  • A track record of managing teams and driving forward complex, multi-stakeholder work with excellence and discipline
  • Professional experience in or alongside the entertainment industry, with a working understanding of the landscape, the roles, and how projects move from development through production
  • Experience overseeing and developing systems and processes that help teams prioritize, create action plans, track progress, and make decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize information from across functions and translate it into clear goals and deliverables
  • Excellent people manager and organizational skills with the demonstrated ability to oversee multiple workstreams and support a team in delivering at its strongest
  • Experience working closely with senior executives or organizational leaders in a high-trust capacity

Role Logistics:

  • Evening availability: This role requires periodic availability and participation in evening Entertainment program events, often aligned to Pacific Time.
  • Travel: If not based in the Los Angeles area, this role requires periodic travel to LA, as well as occasional travel to other locations.

How to Apply

We know there are great candidates who may not check every box, and you may bring valuable skills and experiences we haven’t considered. If this role excites you and aligns with your values and aspirations, we strongly encourage you to apply and tell us about yourself.

We will review applications on a rolling basis. The application consists of three parts:

  • Resume
  • Cover Letter, addressing:
    • (1) why you're drawn to RTT's mission and Entertainment program, and (2) why you're the right person for this role at this moment in your career
  • Short answer responses (a robust paragraph):
    • What does great people management look like to you? Give us a specific example of a time you put it into practice.
    • Describe a time you worked closely with a senior leader or executive to turn a vision or strategic priority into action. What did that partnership look like, and what made it effective?

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for the Managing Director, Entertainment is $125,000–$155,000, commensurate with experience. This is a full-time position with benefits. Typical office hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., with some obligations taking place in the evenings and on weekends and periodic travel.

Benefits package includes:

  • Health benefits, life insurance, and short- and long-term disability
  • Generous package of vacation, sick, and personal days, along with paid time off for federal and religious holidays each year
  • Paid parental leave
  • Reimbursement for home office expenses of up to $1,000
  • 403(b) plan with 3% employer contribution
  • A highly collaborative, caring team

At Resetting the Table, we celebrate differences of background, identity, and viewpoint for the benefit of our employees, work, and community. RTT is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender, age, religion, ideology, national origin, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws. All aspects of employment are decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and organizational need.

Salary: $125,000-$155,000

SUMMARY

The PMO Manager will play a critical role in establishing and maintaining the Project Management Office (PMO) framework, ensuring consistent processes, governance, and execution across Contract Logistics projects. This role combines hands-on project leadership with direct management of PMO resources.

The PMO Manager will partner closely with Sales, Operations, Solutions, and cross-functional teams (Legal, EHS, Finance, HR, IT) to define project requirements, structure workflows, and lead large-scale initiatives to successful completion while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and evolve the PMO framework, including standardized PMO process flows, governance guidelines, and project management documentation to ensure consistency across initiatives.
  • Lead and Define project intake criteria and prioritization, evaluate new project requests and determining scop, resource needs, and required cross‑functional engagement.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations and Solutions teams to assess project feasibility, define requirements, and align on timelines and delivery approach.
  • Coordinate workstreams across departments such as Legal, EHS, Finance, HR, IT, and Operations to ensure project alignment with business objectives.
  • Initiate and facilitate project meetings, oversee and prepare agendas, ensure action items are properly documented, assign task ownership to appropriate stakeholders, and ensure clear expectations and follow-up objectives.
  • Ensure cross-functional coordination across Sales, Operations and Solutions teams to support a cohesive customer experience and smooth transitions from sales to implementation.
  • Manage end-to-end projects, including planning, tracking milestones, risk identification, issue resolution and stakeholder communication.
  • Monitor project performance and portfolio health, tracking timelines, budgets, and deliverables, while proactively escalating risks or issues appropriately to maintain project momentum.
  • Maintain and enhance PMO tools, templates, dashboards, and methodologies, supporting continuous improvement of project management practices.
  • Provide insights, status reporting, and recommendations to the Chief Operating Office, Contract Logistics and project stakeholders to support informed decision‑making.

PMO Team Leadership

  • Provide direct management and leadership to PMO team members, including Project Managers and/or project support resources.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, coaching, and development of team members to strengthen overall project delivery capability.
  • Set clear performance expectations, provide ongoing feedback, and conduct performance evaluations.
  • Allocate resources across projects, ensuring appropriate coverage and alignment with business priorities.
  • Serve as an escalation point for project challenges, providing guidance and support to ensure successful outcomes.

QUALIFICATONS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree required in Business administration, management, leadership, or related fields. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Knowledgeable of project methodology, Agile and Lean Concepts, and Distribution/Logistics/Supply Chain industries. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Database, Access, Project). Continuous improvement mindset with a drive for learning and finding new and innovative solutions to complex issues. your profile

jobs.excerpt: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data.
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.

You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace: how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.

What You’ll Do

Own the customer relationship

  • Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best
  • Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after
  • Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on
  • Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention
  • Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly
  • Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

  • Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them
  • Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up
  • Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed
  • Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

  • Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state
  • Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly
  • Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

  • Watch capacity and growth trends and flag what is needed well before it becomes urgent
  • Keep deployments on supported, current versions and coordinate upgrades with as little disruption as possible
  • Track advisories and known issues, and tell each customer what, if anything, it means for them

Make the practice better

  • Improve the playbooks you work from, so the next customer and the next Service Owner both benefit
  • Feed product gaps, architecture problems and customer education needs back to Product, Account and Customer Success teams
  • Give the account team the technical credibility they need at renewal, and speak up where a customer would genuinely benefit from more Solace. Growth here comes from running the service well and being straight about what you see, not from a pitch
  • Use and contribute to the team's operational tooling (Example, Python-based CLIs for monitoring management) to streamline day-to-day service delivery tasks

Location and travel

  • This role can be based anywhere in Canada, the United States or Mexico, and the work is mostly remote
  • Travel is light but not zero. Expect a handful of customer visits a year for onboarding, service reviews, and the situations where being in the room is worth more than being on the call

About You

  • You take ownership. You treat the customer's environment as yours to look after, and you follow up on things without being chased
  • You want to know why. Restarting the broker is not a root cause, and you are not satisfied until you can explain what actually happened
  • You can write and you can present. A report a director will read, and a troubleshooting call with their engineers, are both well within range
  • You work well without scaffolding. Several customer relationships at once, no two days the same, and nobody planning your week for you

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

  • 5+ years in professional services, technical consulting, managed services or enterprise infrastructure operations, in a customer facing role
  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, messaging middleware or distributed systems (Solace, Kafka, IBM MQ,TIBCO, RabbitMQ or similar)
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts across the application, middleware, network and cloud layers, plus the discipline to write down what you found
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling
  • Scripting and automation ability, Python preferred
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized deployments and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences
  • Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running several customer relationships at the same time

Preferred

  • Direct Solace Platform experience in any form factor: Solace Cloud, software broker or appliance
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, JMS, REST and SMF
  • Background in managed services, SRE or a NOC, somewhere you were close to the customer rather than behind a queue
  • ITIL or a similar service management framework
  • Data center and hardware appliance experience
  • Hands-on experience with Datadog or an equivalent enterprise observability platform (dashboards, alerting, monitors, notebooks), Datadog specifically is a strong advantage
  • Spanish or French, which comes in handy across our Americas customer base

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

  • You know your customers' environments, teams and priorities in detail
  • They treat you as their contact at Solace, and reach out to you first
  • Your reporting goes out reliably and says something worth reading

In 6 Months

  • Problems are getting found and addressed before your customers notice them
  • You run onboarding for new customers and land it on schedule
  • Support, Customer Success and Sales treat you as the authority on your accounts

In 12 Months

  • Service quality across your portfolio is consistent, and does not depend on heroics
  • Capacity and upgrade planning happens well ahead of need rather than in reaction to it
  • Your customers renew and expand because they can point at what the service did for them

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

  • Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
  • Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
  • Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
  • Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
  • Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
  • Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
  • Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
  • Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Description

Push is an all-in-one platform that helps businesses grow and scale their companies by simplifying HR, payroll, time tracking, and scheduling. Our purpose is to help our customers free up their time by making people management ridiculously easy, so they can focus on their passion.

Our customer base includes some of the biggest brands, such as Earls Restaurant, Cactus Club, Crumbl Cookies and more.

We’re a group of dog-loving and game-playing people who place a high priority on competence and efficiency, but an even higher stock in personable and positive individuals that mesh with our culture and are willing to grow with us. As part of our rapidly growing team you will play an important and unique role in working towards our mission to create the best people management system for our customers so they can spend more time doing what they love.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Software Engineer in Testing to join our growing Engineering team! If you have a sharp eye for detail and a passion for ensuring quality through hands-on manual and automated testing, this role could be a perfect fit. You will play a key role in embedding quality into every stage of the development lifecycle.

You’ll influence automation initiatives, refine QA processes, and mentor others on best practices. Your primary responsibility will be identifying bugs, verifying fixes, and ensuring a high-quality product experience for our customers. Kindly note this position is for an existing role which we are actively hiring for.

Location:

Recently the world has changed so we are changing with it. We’re embracing new ways of working and are constantly adapting our practices to ensure that wherever you are working from, you feel a part of the team and have everything you need to work comfortably. We are a remote-first company, Pushies can choose to work remotely or from our Downtown Vancouver office.

  • Champion quality assurance and lead the adoption of best practices across the product and engineering teams

  • Drive technical decisions for our software testing processes and tools
  • Build, maintain, and help drive the direction of the test automation framework

  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear and actionable reporting

Check out our About Us video:

Additional Information

At Push, we place value on different types of experiences. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve listed but you think you’re a good fit, we would still love to hear from you.

We celebrate diversity and promote equal opportunity. We appreciate what makes each of our team members different and encourage you to apply, no matter who you are or how you identify.

Push Operations welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.

Please note that we use AI to screen and assess applicants for this position. Human oversight is maintained throughout the hiring process.

Salary: $72,000 - $75,000 CAD per annum

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or QA, with proven expertise in manual and automated testing and strong analytical skills
  • Experience designing and implementing QA strategies in agile development environments
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Cypress, Selenium, or similar frameworks
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field
  • Demonstrated success in elevating QA standards and improving product quality across releases
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and testing lifecycles
  • Proficiency in exploratory, regression, and smoke testing techniques
  • Experience with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Familiarity with Jira or other project management and defect tracking tools
  • Familiarity with source control management tools such as Git
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating tests into automated build processes
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or another high-level programming language
  • Leadership experience in software development or software testing
  • Proficiency with modern AI-driven tools such as Claude Code

﻿Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with performance, security, or accessibility testing
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments
  • Knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Experience testing mobile applications

About TTG

Thatcher Technology Group (TTG) provides direct selling solutions to companies around the world. TTG is seeking a driven and detail-oriented Intermediate Senior Developer to join its Professional Services Team, leading client engagements across TTG’s software platforms:

  • Prowess – TTG’s established .NET Framework direct selling application.

The Opportunity

In this role, the Senior Developer will serve as a senior individual contributor, primarily designing and delivering modern features for Ascend using Vue 3, TypeScript, C#/.NET Core, Microsoft SQL Server, Docker, and Kubernetes, while also supporting and enhancing Prowess where needed. The developer’s work will directly affect the systems TTG’s clients rely on to run critical day-to-day business processes.

The role combines hands-on development with solution design, complex problem-solving, peer support, and ownership of complex delivery and production issues. The Senior Developer will work closely with project management, business analysis, QA, and other developers to deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Location: Canada (remote)

The salary range for this role is $120,000–$135,000 CAD per year. Final compensation will be determined based on experience and skills.

What You'll Own

Design and deliver end-to-end solutions

  • Own the design and delivery of complex features across user interfaces, APIs, services, integrations, and data.
  • Build features using Vue 3, TypeScript, Pinia, Kendo UI for Vue, and Axios.
  • Design and build C#/.NET Core services using microservice architecture, along with REST APIs and asynchronous integrations.
  • Design and optimize Microsoft SQL Server data access, including complex queries, indexing, and performance tuning.

Build reliable, production-ready software

  • Improve system reliability, scalability, security, performance, and observability while addressing meaningful technical debt.
  • Package services using Docker and support deployments in Kubernetes environments.
  • Diagnose high-priority production issues, identify root causes, and help implement durable fixes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation that supports reliable delivery and production operations.
  • Adhere to security and data-handling best practices consistent with SOC 2 and PCI-DSS obligations.

Provide senior technical leadership

  • Contribute actively to technical design discussions and code reviews.
  • Support less-experienced developers through code review, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.
  • Work closely with project managers, business analysts, QA, and other developers throughout delivery.
  • Clearly communicate technical recommendations, tradeoffs, dependencies, estimates, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities may evolve as the Professional Services team grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including significant ownership of production full-stack applications.
  • 5+ years of C#/.NET Core development experience.
  • 5+ years of experience building production applications with Vue.js, ideally Vue 3 and the Composition API.
  • 3+ years of production TypeScript experience.
  • Strong experience with microservice architecture, REST API design, asynchronous processing, messaging, and event-driven integrations.
  • Strong Microsoft SQL Server skills, including data modelling, query optimization, indexing, and production performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud environments such as AWS.
  • Experience building or supporting eCommerce functionality such as carts, checkout, orders, catalogues, discounts, or returns.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently own complex technical work.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with multilingual applications, including internationalization and localization.
  • Experience in the direct selling industry.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

  • Solve problems that actually matter. You’ll work on complex, mission-critical platforms that support eCommerce, orders, consultant operations, integrations, and other business processes our clients depend on every day.
  • Have real technical influence. Senior Developers at TTG are expected to bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and help shape practical solutions—not simply execute someone else’s technical design.
  • Stay hands-on while expanding your impact. Take ownership of complex technical work, influence engineering practices, support other developers, and contribute to architecture and solution design without having to move away from coding to grow your career.
  • Work across two different technology landscapes. You’ll gain exposure to both Prowess, our established enterprise platform, and Ascend, our modern microservice-based platform built with technologies including Vue 3, TypeScript, .NET Core, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • See your work through to production. Developers stay connected to the outcome of what they build, working across design, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with the people closest to the problem. Our teams collaborate directly across engineering, Professional Services, QA, and client stakeholders, giving you context behind the requirements and visibility into how your solutions perform in the real world.
  • Bring your experience, and keep growing it. TTG has more than 25 years of direct selling technology experience while continuing to modernize our platforms, practices, and approach to solving complex client problems.

  • Ajudar a construir uma estrutura de BI que reduza dependência de soluções pontuais e aumente a reutilização, governança e confiabilidade das informações.

🔎 Procuramos alguém que tenha
  • Experiência sólida em Business Intelligence, Analytics ou Analytics Engineering.
  • SQL avançado.
  • Boa base de modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência construindo ou utilizando camadas analíticas, data marts ou estruturas similares.
  • Capacidade de transformar regras de negócio em modelos de dados reutilizáveis.
  • Familiaridade com Git e desenvolvimento orientado a código.
  • Boa capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica.
  • Facilidade para transitar entre discussões técnicas e problemas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia, estruturar problemas e colocar soluções em prática.
  • Curiosidade e disposição para aprender novas arquiteturas, ferramentas e tecnologias.
Não esperamos que você já tenha construído sozinho diferentes arquiteturas de BI ou domine profundamente todas as tecnologias do mercado. Buscamos fundamentos fortes, maturidade técnica e capacidade de construir e evoluir junto com a empresa.

✨ Diferenciais que brilham os olhos

  • Experiência com Analytics Engineering.
  • Conhecimento de dbt ou abordagens similares de transformação e modelagem como código.

⚠️ O perfil que não buscamos
Essa não é uma posição focada principalmente em produção de dashboards, visualização ou atendimento de demandas pontuais.

Também não buscamos alguém com atuação exclusivamente em Data Engineering, concentrada em infraestrutura, ingestão e pipelines, distante da camada analítica e das regras de negócio.
Da mesma forma, não é uma posição puramente conceitual de arquitetura.
Buscamos o equilíbrio entre capacidade técnica hands-on, entendimento do negócio e visão de como construir uma estrutura de BI mais escalável.

✨ O que esperamos nos primeiros meses

✨ O que oferecemos

Mais do que uma posição para operar uma estrutura pronta, essa é uma oportunidade para ajudar a construir como Business Intelligence funciona na empresa.
Você terá espaço para participar de decisões relevantes de arquitetura, processos, ferramentas e governança, ao mesmo tempo em que continuará atuando de forma prática na implementação dessas soluções.
Nosso objetivo é construir uma capacidade de BI cada vez mais confiável, escalável e preparada para suportar Analytics, self-service e novas formas de interação com dados.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

RegEd is the market-leading provider ofRegTechenterprise solutions with relationships with hundreds of enterprise clients, including 80% of the top 25 financial services firms.

Life at RegEd:

We are an innovative, fast-paced company that embraces diversity. Our remote or hybrid environment blends an entrepreneurial culture with the right balance of structure and process. We empower and trust our employees. MostRegEder’swork remotely, and some roles work a hybrid schedule from our Headquarters in Morrisville, North Carolina. Learn more about#LifeAtRegEdonourLinkedIn page!

Diversity Drives Innovation:

RegEd believes that diverse perspectives make us stronger, smarter, and more innovative. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to succeed. We actively seek individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to cultivating an environment of inclusivity and belonging. RegEd also recognizes the exceptional skills, discipline and dedication of those who serve - and those who stand beside them. Whether you’re a veteran, active-duty service member transitioning to civilian life, or a military spouse, your unique experience brings incredible value to our team. Military members, veterans, and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

Don’tmeet every requirement? If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with all the qualifications, we encourage you toapply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, and you may be the perfect candidate for thisor other roles.

Five Reasons to Work with Us:

  1. Work with a leader in financial services industry
  2. Supportive & flexibleremoteorhybridenvironment
  3. Diverse & friendly culture
  4. Fast paced growing company
  5. A company that cares with community service efforts

What You Will Be Doing:

The Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for providing operational andapplication database services to the organization. Primary responsibilitiesinclude owning, tracking, and resolving database-related incidents and requests;monitoring and maintaining database health through backups, maintenance jobs,and index management; and supporting performance and security requirements.

This role involves daily monitoring to identify and address service-relatedissues, responding to database alerts and escalations, and collaborating withmanagement and other teams on solutions to recurring problems. The DBA rolerequires a service-oriented mentality and a high sense of ownership. The DBAis expected to continually look for areas of improvement in projects, products,and processes to ensure efficiency, consistency, and accuracy. Self-directionand the ability to manage and allocate your time across multiple simultaneousprojects are keysforsuccess.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, create, and maintain database objects including indexes, views, stored procedures, tables, and other schema elements inon-premiseand cloud environments.
  • Monitor and maintain database health by reviewing and responding to backup status, maintenance jobs, index health, and daily operational alerts.
  • Perform database user and security management: create logins and users, manage roles and access privileges, and support compliance requirements.
  • Plan, implement, and maintain backup, restore, and recovery procedures; verify backup success and support restore testing.
  • Participate in investigation and resolution of database incidents including blocking, deadlocks, and performance degradation.
  • Optimize existing queries and procedures; develop efficient T-SQL using execution plans, system views, and indexing best practices.
  • Refresh development and test environment databases on a regular basis to support QA and development teams.
  • Assist in building and maintaining database monitoring infrastructure for alerting, performance data collection, and operational visibility.
  • Support implementation of database changes and code deployments; work with the Architecture team on coding standards for stored procedures, triggers, and schema design.
  • Perform feasibility studies and effort estimates for new or revised database systems to address business needs.
  • Install, upgrade, and maintain database instances required for development, testing, and production usage.
  • General technical troubleshooting and consultation with Quality Assurance, Application Development, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Work with multiple departments including Architecture, Quality Assurance, Application Development, and Infrastructure to implement and maintain database code and configurations.

You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have:

  • 3+ years of database administration, development, or equivalent experience
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server 2016 or higher
  • Strong T-SQL skills including complex queries, stored procedures, transaction management, error handling, and dynamic SQL
  • Understanding of execution plans and query optimization techniques
  • Working knowledge of database backup, recovery, and HADR concepts
  • Familiarity with cloud database services in Azure such as Azure SQL MI, Azure SQL DB, or Azure SQL on VMs
  • Experience with database security administration such as user management, role assignment, and access controls
  • Ability to build and maintain SQL scripts, indexes, and complex queries for data analysis and operational use
  • Strong understanding of database structures, theories, principles, and practices for OLTP environments
  • Proven analytical ability and attention to detail in a production environment
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with development teams in a dynamic environment
  • Commitment to quality and accuracy

Nice To Have:

  • Experience with PowerShell for scripting and operational automation
  • Familiarity with database monitoring and dashboard tools such as SSMS, Grafana, or similar platforms
  • Experience with SSIS or other ETL tooling
  • Experience with SSRS or other managed reporting platforms
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control processes
  • Familiarity with other database platforms such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, FINRA, or other regulated industry compliance requirement
  • B.E. or B.S. Degree in one of the following subject areas: Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Technology or related field; related work experience can be substituted for education requirement

The Process:

We can hire in the following states:Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Utah.

Any communications related toopenRegEd positions will come from a RegEd.com email address. We do not hire through textmessage, social media, or email alone. Our interviews are conducted either in person or via video calls. We will not ask you for sensitiveinformationnor will we ask you to pay anything during the hiring process.

  • Apply! (3-25 minutes)
  • Resume review (up to 2 weeks)
  • Brief video interview with RegEd Recruiting Team Member (30 minutes)
  • Video interview with Team Members (60 minutes)
  • Video interview with Hiring Manager (30-60 minutes)
  • Video interview with Team Leader (30-60 minutes)
  • Offer
  • Background check and drug test (2-5 days)
  • Onboarding, yay!

Welcome to RegEd!

The Perks:

  • Fantastic and comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans
  • Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability plans
  • Volunteering Time Off and Flexible Schedules
  • 401(k) plan
  • Incredible career growth opportunities
  • Performance bonuses

If you are interested in joining a market leader and innovator poised for exponential new business growth in the coming years, please apply. It’s a great time to join the RegEd Team!

Pay Transparency:

The compensation range for this position is $85,000-$120,000.

RegEd takes a market-based approach to pay. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired close to or at the maximum of the salary range. Your actual pay at RegEd is based on your unique background, pertinent experience, worklocationand qualifications. Base pay also depends on the relative experience, knowledge and skills to our internal peers in the role. In addition to competitive base pay and bonus/commission program participation,RegEd’s total compensation package also includes our comprehensive benefits package in addition to vacation, sick, volunteer time off and paid parental leave.

Accommodation:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, perform essential jobfunctionsand to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you needan accommodationin order tointerview, please let us know during any of your interactions with the RegEd Recruiting Team. This information will betreated as confidentialand only used to determine appropriate accommodation for the interview process.

At RegEd, we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. RegEd is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

AtDynamo AI, we help enterprises deploy AI systems that are reliable, secure, observable, and production-ready.

As organizations accelerate adoption of Generative AI, they face growing challenges around reliability, governance, latency, safety, compliance, and operational control. Dynamo AI provides the infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and real-time guardrails that allow enterprises to confidently operationalize AI at scale.

We work with enterprises and regulated industries to bridge the gap between AI experimentation and production deployment — enabling organizations to deploy AI systems safely, efficiently, and responsibly.

TheForward Deployment Strategist (FDS) is a high-impact, technical-commercial hybrid responsible for the successful operationalization of Dynamo within our most strategic accounts. You will act as the bridge between Dynamo’s engineering capabilities and our customers’ business imperatives. You are ensuring that Dynamo is not just "installed," but deeply integrated into the customer’s value chain.

About the Role

We are looking for Forward Deployed Strategists to help enterprise customers successfully deploy and operationalize AI systems in real-world environments.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, technical deployment, and commercial execution. You will work directly with enterprise customers to identify high-impact AI opportunities, shape deployment strategies, and drive successful implementation of Dynamo AI’s platform across customer environments.

Forward Deployed Strategists act as the connective layer between customers, sales, product, and engineering teams. You will help organizations move from experimentation toward durable production adoption — ensuring deployments deliver measurable business outcomes while meeting enterprise requirements around governance, reliability, security, and performance.

This is a highly cross-functional role for individuals who enjoy solving ambiguous operational problems, working closely with customers, and translating complex AI capabilities into practical enterprise value.

In This Role You’ll

Partner Closely with Customers

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise stakeholders across business, engineering, operations, risk, compliance, and security teams
  • Understand customer workflows, operational pain points, and AI deployment priorities
  • Identify and shape high-impact AI use cases aligned to measurable business outcomes
  • Partner with customers to redesign business and operational processes around AI adoption, helping organizations streamline governance, evaluation, and approval workflows to accelerate the path from experimentation to production deployment

Drive Strategic AI Deployments

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to operationalize Dynamo’s products within enterprise environments
  • Translate customer requirements into deployment strategies and implementation plans
  • Help customers design scalable workflows around AI governance, evaluation, observability, and real-time guardrails
  • Navigate ambiguity and unblock cross-functional execution across internal and customer teams
  • Balance speed, technical feasibility, governance, and business impact during deployments

Bridge Business and Technical Teams

  • Develop a strong understanding of enterprise AI systems, LLM deployment patterns, evaluation methodologies, and guardrail architectures

Support Commercial and GTM Efforts

  • Partner with sales teams during strategic customer engagements, workshops, and pre-sales discussions
  • Help customers understand the operational and organizational requirements for successful AI adoption
  • Support enterprise expansion opportunities by identifying additional deployment pathways and use cases
  • Drive measurable customer outcomes that contribute to long-term account growth and adoption

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

  • Enjoy operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution
  • Are highly customer-oriented and comfortable working directly with senior enterprise stakeholders
  • Can build credibility with both executives and engineers
  • Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with high ownership
  • Are excited about translating frontier AI capabilities into real-world operational impact
  • Prefer solving messy operational problems over narrowly scoped responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Simpson Strong-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.

Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

YOU

As a Software Product Manager, you will be responsible for guiding the strategy, discovery, development, delivery, and ongoing improvement of software used in the design and manufacture of structural building components.

You will work directly with customers, internal stakeholders, Product Development, User Experience, and other cross-functional partners to identify important customer problems and deliver solutions that provide measurable customer and business value. You will develop a deep understanding of component design and manufacturing workflows and become the product expert and primary advocate for your products.


This role requires a combination of customer focus, technical curiosity, industry knowledge, business judgment, and the ability to translate complex workflows into clear product priorities and requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Lifecycle Management, 30%

  • Develop and communicate the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable objectives.
  • Align product priorities with customer needs, market opportunities, technical considerations, and organizational goals.
  • Manage the software product throughout its lifecycle, including new capabilities, ongoing enhancements, adoption, modernization, and retirement of obsolete functionality.
  • Evaluate product performance using customer feedback, usage information, support trends, market research, and other qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Make informed tradeoff decisions involving customer value, technical feasibility, business viability, timing, risk, and available capacity.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Training, and Support on product positioning, launches, adoption, and external messaging.

Product Delivery and Backlog Ownership, 30%

  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
  • Create, maintain, and prioritize a healthy product backlog based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, dependencies, and strategic alignment.
  • Collaborate closely with Software Development, User Experience, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and other partners throughout discovery and delivery.
  • Provide timely clarification and make product decisions that allow development teams to maintain progress.
  • Participate in planning, refinement, demonstrations, release reviews, and other product-development activities.
  • Validate completed functionality against customer needs and defined acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate release readiness, release communications, documentation, training, and post-release evaluation.

Product Discovery and Customer Understanding, 25%

  • Work directly with customers and internal subject-matter experts to understand component design, layout, engineering, and manufacturing workflows.
  • Identify customer pain points, unmet needs, workarounds, and opportunities for product improvement.
  • Partner with User Experience and Software Development to test assumptions, prototype potential solutions, and validate concepts before significant development begins.
  • Use customer interviews, workflow observation, market research, competitive analysis, product data, and technical input to determine which problems should be addressed.
  • Develop a strong understanding of how component design decisions affect engineering output, material use, production processes, and customer efficiency.

Product Leadership and Communication, 15%

  • Become the primary product expert and trusted point of contact for your software products.
  • Clearly communicate product direction, priorities, decisions, tradeoffs, progress, and upcoming capabilities to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Build alignment among customers, Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, and leadership.
  • Lead through influence, facilitate productive discussions, and help teams resolve conflicting priorities.
  • Represent the product in customer meetings, demonstrations, internal training, and industry events.
  • Maintain awareness of relevant industry practices, software trends, customer workflows, and competitive offerings.
  • undefined

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, construction technology, computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • 3 or more years of software-related component manufacturing experience.
  • 1 or more years of product management experience preferred.
  • Experience in software product management, product ownership, business analysis, software development, UX, technical support, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with cross-functional software-development teams throughout product discovery and delivery.
  • Experience with CAD, BIM, structural design, engineering, architectural, construction, or manufacturing software.
  • Knowledge of structural building components, including roof trusses, floor trusses, wall panels, engineered wood products, component layout, or manufacturing workflows, is strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of Agile product-development practices, backlog management, user stories, acceptance criteria, and software release processes.
  • Ability to learn complex technical products and develop practical knowledge of customer workflows.
  • Ability to convert customer needs and technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to use customer feedback and product data to support prioritization and decision-making.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on the highest-value outcomes.
  • Strong customer focus and the ability to build trust with internal and external stakeholders.

TRAVEL REQUIRED

This position requires domestic and international travel up to 10% of the time.

WORK STATUS & LOCATION

This full-time, exempt position is fully remote.

RELOCATION

Relocation is not available for this position.

PAY

$84,400 - $135,000 / year

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

This is a hands-on treasury role sitting at the centre of how Yellow Card moves money. You will be responsible for making sure liquidity is where it needs to be, in the right currency, across our banks, liquidity providers, and offshore accounts, so that payouts, settlements, and trades are never held up for lack of funds. Day to day, that means moving capital between accounts, executing wires and stablecoin trades, and reacting fast when a payment is blocked because an account has run dry. You will report to the Head of Liquidity & Custody and work alongside the team's Senior Liquidity and Pricing Specialist, who owns rate-setting and forecasting; this role owns execution, getting the money where it needs to be, accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

Liquidity & Cash Management:

  • Execute offshore and local fund movements between Yellow Card's banks and liquidity providers to keep accounts funded for USD, EUR, GBP and other local-currency payouts.
  • Monitor account balances daily across banks and liquidity providers, and top up accounts proactively rather than waiting for a payment to be blocked.
  • Initiate wires, ACH, and SWIFT transfers across our banking partners within approval limits.
  • Trade with liquidity providers to convert stablecoin to fiat (and fiat to stablecoin) to rebalance exposure and fund payouts, locking rates directly with liquidity provider trading desks where needed.
  • Assist with liquidity movements, planning and projections, and the management of capital cycles and repayments.

Banking & Liquidity Partner Relationships:

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Yellow Card's liquidity providers and banking partners across our African markets, the US, the UK and EU.
  • Coordinate wallet whitelisting and clean-up with liquidity providers whenever banking or wallet infrastructure changes.
  • Monitor counterparty exposure and settlement risk on liquidity partners, and escalate access, settlement, or counterparty issues promptly.

Settlement, Reconciliation & Reporting:

  • Reconcile liquidity provider and bank statements against internal records to ensure accuracy.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks and balance discrepancies, including trades executed directly with liquidity providers outside of standard portal statements.
  • Collect and maintain monthly liquidity provider statements to support month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate, complete records of all fund movements and payment transactions.
  • Support treasury risk reporting by generating treasury dashboards covering liquidity.

Ad Hoc & Cross-Functional Support:

  • Process and review customer refunds.
  • Support funding approvals for opex and payroll liquidity needs.
  • Partner with Finance, Compliance, and Product/Engineering on liquidity-impacting issues, incidents, or new market and product launches.
  • Document processes as you run them and cross-train with other members of the Liquidity team, so day-to-day execution never depends on one person alone.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 3–5+ years of hands-on treasury or liquidity operations experience at a crypto exchange, stablecoin/fintech company, or financial institution and are able to step directly into daily execution with minimal ramp-up.
  • Bachelor's in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics or related discipline; advanced degree (CA(SA), CIMA/CGMA, CFA) preferred.
  • Multi-market liquidity: Demonstrated experience moving fiat and crypto/stablecoin liquidity across multiple banks, liquidity providers, and markets, ideally including African corridors and multi-currency (USD, EUR, and GBP) environments.
  • Payments & trading: Direct, hands-on experience initiating wire/ACH/SWIFT payments and executing spot FX or stablecoin conversions with liquidity provider trading desks.
  • Crypto Fluency: Familiarity with crypto custody/settlement platforms and stablecoins (USDC, USDT).
  • Technical Skills: Strong reconciliation skills and attention to detail.
  • Able to work hours that align mainly with the US business day, to provide coverage during the after-hours window.
  • Traits: Able to work calmly and quickly under time pressure to resolve urgent liquidity shortfalls; a self-starter with high integrity, comfortable operating with real financial authority and a degree of autonomy.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to treasury management systems or reconciliation automation tools, and general familiarity with the regulatory environment crypto-asset service providers operate in.

What We Offer

  • Impactful and Purposeful Work: You will be helping to drive financial inclusion across Africa.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 25+ countries across the world.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.

Ready to Join Us?

SVP of Marketing

Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer | Base Salary Range: SVP $200,000-$240,000

LOCATION: Remote (US-based). Quarterly travel to Lehi, UT HQ and customer/conference locations expected.

About Claravine

Claravine is The Data Standards Company®. We help the world's largest brands and agencies deliver on the promise of modern marketing by standardizing taxonomies, naming conventions, and metadata across all digital experiences — at the source of data creation. That is why a quarter of the Fortune 100 trust The Data Standards Cloud™ to define, apply, and connect standards across their entire marketing ecosystem.

Our customers are enterprise marketing and analytics teams at global brands spending $50M+ per year on advertising. They depend on clean, consistent data to make decisions worth billions of dollars. When that data is wrong, their analytics are wrong, their AI models are wrong, and their investments are wasted. We fix that — at the source, before the chaos starts.

We are backed by growth equity investors and have built a track record with category-leading brands. Now we are looking for a marketing leader who can take the story we have earned with customers and make it impossible for the market to ignore.

The Opportunity

This is not a typical SVP of Marketing position. This is a category-building role, not a demand-gen-only seat. You'll build and lead the marketing function that defines a category, which means you'll be as much a thought leader and executive presence as an operator.

You will report directly to our CRO, sit at the executive table, be accountable for pipeline, revenue and market position, and do it with a lean, high-performing, AI-powered team and the credibility that comes from serving some of the most sophisticated marketing organizations in the world.

What You Will Own

Category Leadership & Strategic Narrative

  • Own Claravine's positioning as The Data Standards Company® and keep sharpening and expanding the category narrative
  • Be Claravine's voice on keynote stages, in industry publications, analyst briefings, executive panels and podcasts
  • Build and optimize competitive positioning that provides Sales and CS the language to win
  • Manage Gartner, Forrester, IDC and other analyst relationships so Claravine is included and positioned well in market research

Demand Generation & Pipeline

  • Own marketing's contribution to pipeline, with clear attribution, targets and accountability
  • Design and execute an enterprise ABM program targeting the Global 2000 accounts spending $50M+ on advertising
  • Drive demand through content, events, digital, partner co-marketing and direct outreach, focused on what converts at enterprise ACV
  • Elevate existing full-funnel reporting and attribution the board, CRO and CEO trust

Product Marketing

  • Lead messaging, positioning, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and launch strategy
  • Turn data standards and taxonomy management into business-value stories for CMO, VP Marketing and marketing analytics buyers
  • Develop pricing and packaging recommendations with product and finance
  • Build and maintain a new business sales and expansion enablement library that measurably improves win rates and ACV

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Run a content strategy that builds awareness, trust and inbound demand at every stage of the enterprise buyer journey
  • Commission and create authoritative research, benchmarks, and frameworks that make Claravine the definitive source on marketing data standards
  • Build customer advocacy: case studies, references, advisory boards and executive roundtables

Team & Operations

  • Build, lead and develop a team of 5-10 across product marketing, demand gen, content, xEO and contractors
  • Own the marketing budget and P&L, accountable for the ROI on every dollar spent
  • Use AI-powered workflows and tools to maximize the output of a lean team, then expand it
  • Set the reporting cadence and dashboards that keep marketing visible and trusted by the executive team

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 12+ years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing, with 4+ years in VP, SVP, or CMO roles leading the entire Marketing function
  • Proven success building category narrative and thought leadership at a company selling to enterprise marketing leaders (CMO, VP Marketing, marketing analytics, marketing technology)
  • Ownership of pipeline and revenue targets, with specific, quantified results you can point to
  • Experience running or closely supporting 6-12 month enterprise sales cycles with minimum six-figure ASPs
  • A record of leading lean teams of 5–15. You multiply output rather than ask for headcount
  • Hands-on use of AI that has changed how a marketing org operates, not just experiments
  • Excellent writing, verbal communication and presenting. Your bylines are compelling, your presentations are clear and your presence with executive buyers is authoritative

Preferred

  • Deep understanding of marketing data, analytics and measurement. You don't just talk about data quality; you've felt the pain of bad data
  • Strong relationships in the enterprise marketing technology ecosystem: with analysts, trade press, marketing technology vendors, and industry organizations

What Sets This Apart

  • You will be defining a category, not competing in a commodity market. The narrative opportunity is significant
  • You will have genuine executive access and influence - not a seat at a table two levels below where decisions are made
  • Your buyer is one of the most respected roles in business: the enterprise CMO. You will build relationships with and be credible to the best marketing minds in the world
  • Claravine’s product actually works. Customers renew. The case studies are real. You will not be building marketing fiction on top of a weak product.

At Claravine, base salary is one part of our competitive total compensation, equity and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is SVP $200,000-$240,000.

Salary: $200,000-$240,000

Arclin is seeking an Environmental Engineer – Air Quality Compliance to join our Corporate Environmental team. Reporting to the Global Director of Environmental, this role will serve as a technical resource and subject matter expert supporting Arclin manufacturing facilities across North America and internationally.

The Environmental Engineer – Air Quality Compliance will provide technical leadership and guidance to facilities on air quality compliance, permitting, emissions management, and regulatory requirements. This role will partner closely with site EHS, operations, engineering, sustainability and leadership teams to identify environmental risks, develop practical solutions, and strengthen Arclin’s global environmental programs.

This position has no direct reports and requires the ability to lead through technical expertise, collaboration, and influence.

Environmental Engineer – Air Quality Compliance Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as a corporate subject matter expert for air quality compliance, providing technical guidance to manufacturing facilities and leadership.
  • Partner with facilities to develop, implement, and maintain effective air quality compliance strategies and programs.
  • Interpret and communicate applicable national, regional, provincial/state, and local air quality regulations and requirements across Arclin’s global operations.
  • Provide technical support for air permitting activities, including new permits, permit renewals, modifications, amendments, and regulatory applicability determinations.
  • Provide technical guidance on regulatory applicability, source classification, emissions limits, monitoring requirements, testing, and compliance demonstration strategies.
  • Review and support air emissions calculations, emissions inventories, reporting, recordkeeping, and compliance certifications.
  • Support facilities with the evaluation and implementation of air pollution control technologies and operational controls, in partnership with engineering and operations.
  • Conduct environmental compliance assessments and audits, with an emphasis on identifying air quality compliance risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support facilities in the investigation and resolution of environmental compliance issues, including regulatory inquiries, notices of violation, exceedances, and other potential noncompliance.
  • Lead or support investigation of environmental incidents or compliance events, including root cause analysis and development of corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Develop and improve corporate environmental standards, procedures, tools, guidance, and training related to air quality compliance.
  • Establish and maintain systems to improve consistency and visibility of air compliance requirements across Arclin’s global operations.
  • Provide technical oversight and support for environmental projects associated with new equipment, process changes, facility expansions, and capital projects.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, and site EHS teams to evaluate environmental impacts and compliance requirements associated with process and equipment changes.
  • Monitor emerging environmental regulations and industry developments and communicate potential business impacts and required actions to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify, develop, and track environmental performance metrics and leading indicators related to air quality compliance.
  • Support Arclin’s Journey to Zero through continuous improvement, risk reduction, and effective environmental management systems.
  • Provide technical support and mentorship to site EHS professionals on air quality compliance matters.
  • Participate in cross-functional and global environmental initiatives as needed.

Environmental Engineer – Air Quality Compliance Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience in environmental engineering, air quality compliance, and/or environmental permitting within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of air quality regulations, permitting requirements, emissions calculations, and compliance management.
  • Experience supporting complex air permitting and regulatory compliance programs, including review of air dispersion modeling and associated regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with air emissions inventories, emissions calculations, compliance reporting, and regulatory recordkeeping.
  • Experience with air pollution control equipment and technologies.
  • Experience working across multiple facilities, jurisdictions, or regulatory frameworks preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing skills.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships with plant leadership, EHS professionals, production supervisors, operators, maintenance personnel, and engineering teams.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence and drive action without direct authority.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
  • Experience with PSM/RMP-regulated facilities preferred. Experience supporting Title V facilities and permitting activities involving NESHAP, NSPS, emissions inventories, and regulatory applicability analyses.
  • Experience with ISO14001 preferred.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 50%, including domestic and international travel, as business needs require.
  • Must be available to provide technical support for environmental incidents or urgent compliance matters outside normal business hours, as required.
  • Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment. This may include standing for extended periods and occasionally bending, crouching, stooping, rotating, climbing stairs, and lifting up to 50 lbs., or any combination of the aforementioned activities.

Role Summary

The Scrum Master is responsible for enabling Agile practices within the team, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
