  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

The Finance Transformation team is a group of professionals across the WMG organization brought together to re-imagine our processes and systems to establish more standardized and efficient ways of working that will drive WMG’s growth and business aspirations.


Your role:

The OTC Manager holds a global remit and is responsible for defining the future state Order to Cash (OTC) processes and measures that are aligned with organizational strategies, country-specific knowledge, and operational requirements. This process lead will strive to assemble opportunities, reviewing existing and best-practice workflows, tools, and data. The role moves through design, architecture, implementation, release, and steady state with an ongoing focus on continuous improvement and the integration of OTC finance processes into the overall WMG landscape. Specific accountability from revenue to the sales order and billing documents (plus ebilling where required) for digital, physical, D2C, 3rd party licensing and merchandise revenue streams.


Here you’ll get to:

  • Support the transformation team by leading cross-functional and virtual teams in the review, design, development, and implementation of global processes and procedures, including customer master data, credit management, order management/billing, accounts receivable (AR), collections, cash application, and revenue recognition.
  • Lead process design meetings with internal Subject Matter Resources (SMRs) and third-party vendors through design, implementation, and release.
  • Lead technical and operational teams to conduct testing, defect resolution, and ongoing configuration of SAP SD/FI-AR modules and associated sub-systems.
  • Be responsible for OTC testing across credit limit setting, billing, cash application, dispute management, credit/debit memo processing, customer statement generation, and collaborate with sales, distribution, and licensing platforms.
  • Work closely with the SAP Master Data Management team to ensure customer master data configuration and governance are consistent with global processes.
  • Work closely with WMG Tax to solve complex scenarios involving worldwide tax.
  • Act as representative for intercompany billing between service centers and transformation.
  • Leverage OTC and industry process and systems knowledge/experience to implement standardization of global, regional, and/or local processes, challenging the status quo while taking input from SMRs and program partners to understand required localizations.
  • Lead the design, documentation, and ongoing socialization of end-to-end OTC processes.
  • Obtain consensus for Finance Transformation from key WMG partners across the globe by credibly communicating deep operating process and systems knowledge and an appreciation of the impact at a local level.
  • Attend and/or present in update meetings as required for key decision, issue, and risk points.
  • Work with collaborators to ensure Product / Policy / Process / Procedure / System decisions account for territory variances, commercial needs, and local legal/regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with IT to identify integration points between commercial/sales operations systems, billing platforms, and core finance systems.
  • Partner with people and change management resources to develop job aids, communications, and training approaches to embed new ways of working and systems training for the OTC area.
  • Act as a spokesperson across the WMG organization for the benefits delivered by the Finance Transformation in the OTC space.
  • Represent the OTC Business Process at individual Fit/Gap sessions in markets to ensure all business requirements are considered (and documented via User Requirements Specification). Ensure that any business needs driving a requirement for customization are strongly challenged and options for process redesign are considered. Where customizations are needed, ensure justification is documented and changes progress via the governance model.
  • Update relevant OTC documentation based on changes to the global template (including SOPs, User Guides, and training materials).
  • Participate in the preparation of OTC training materials.
  • Be responsible for the resolution and review of OTC issues, risks, and business impacts for the owned process.
  • Proactively and on an ongoing basis identify internal and external OTC guidelines (e.g., automation in cash application, AI-driven credit scoring, streamlined collections) that will enable improvement of the standard end-to-end process.

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Business, Finance, Accounting, Business Information Systems, Management Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience focusing on OTC processes (Credit, Collections, Cash Application, Billing, AR) or related finance transformation experience.
  • Strong Order to Cash process and systems knowledge, preferably within a music, media, digital licensing, or entertainment industry context.
  • Facilitative style, with prior experience leading workshops and engaging collaborators through a series of approaches that require a targeted level of consensus.
  • Relevant operational OTC experience supervising credit management, order fulfillment/billing workflows, cash management, dispute resolution, AR ledger management, and internal controls.
  • Technically savvy with a robust organizational change skillset.
  • Experience with a previous SAP implementation (specifically SAP SD, FI-AR, or FSCM) is crucial.
  • Exemplary collaborator engagement and management skills internationally and within complex, multi-faceted organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to perform complex dispute, credit risk, and receivables analysis.
  • Ability to develop, articulate, and build support around a long-term OTC vision and implement incremental turning points in support of that vision.
  • Team player who can participate and collaborate with varied business units (sales, licensing, supply chain, legal, finance) to effectively implement transformation initiatives.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Transformational leadership experience.
  • Media, entertainment, digital distribution, or music industry experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with SAP FSCM (Credit Management, Dispute Management, Collections Management) and modern automated cash application tools.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Corporate Development & Strategy sits within Strategic Finance and is the analytical arm of Cashea's C-level and senior leadership. We frame the hard questions, build the evidence behind the company's most important decisions, and stay to make sure they deliver.

As a strategist and operator, you will take on the company's highest-priority and most ambiguous projects: scope the problem, build the case with the numbers, and work alongside the teams to turn it into action. One quarter you may be shaping a new product and its financials, the next assessing an investment or diagnosing how part of the business runs. It is a small, close team where impact matters more than titles, and the work goes wherever the business needs it most.

You will be close to where the biggest decisions are made, from the first question to the follow-through.

  • Building the models and business cases behind each recommendation: unit economics, scenarios, valuation and capital needs

  • Tracking new businesses after the decision (targets, guardrails and KPIs), and designing the frameworks and processes that do not exist yet

  • Researching markets and competitive dynamics, and evaluating investment and partnership opportunities

  • Structuring ambiguous questions and turning the analysis into clear recommendations and materials for leadership forums at different levels, up to the board

  • Partnering with internal teams and external partners to bring analytical rigor to business decisions and move from recommendation to execution

Qualifications

  • Stakeholder management and senior leadership exposure: you have worked directly with senior leaders, influence without formal authority, put the outcome ahead of the credit, and hold your ground when presenting difficult findings

  • Experience with M&A and valuation: comps, DCF, due diligence coordination

  • Understanding of the Venezuelan market


Why You’ll Love Working at Cashea

At Cashea we have a work culture based on trust and purpose. If you need a hint on why were a good fit, this are our core values:

  • We don’t run on autopilot. Everything we do and share—inside and out—is intentional. We love to craft ideas fully aware of the impact they can have on our users.

  • Today, more than 42 million purchases and stories have moved through our platform, supported by a network of over 7,000 partners and counting. Every number represents a choice, an experience, and an opportunity to improve the financial lives of millions.

  • Your creativity and curiosity is the most important asset.

  • Your voice is noticed. We listen and make space for ideas, feedback. Everyone belongs and what's meaningful to you, is meaningful to us.

  • We value transparency. Clarity keeps us grounded and connected.

  • Last but not least, we focus on real impact. Everything we do is meant to make a difference.

Job Title: Contracts Manager

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Role Summary

jobs.excerpt: About TYLsemi, Inc.  The OpportunityThe AI infrastructure market is exploding.
jobs.description:
About TYLsemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP — the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks — that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

  • Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI — they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
  • Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

  • If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.
  • No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

  • US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
  • India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.

What We Value

  • Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.
  • Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here.
  • Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
  • Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Here's why you should:

  • The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building.
  • The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo.
  • The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
  • The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.

READY TO JOIN?

Role Overview

We're hiring a senior firmware engineer to architect, develop, and bring up embedded firmware for Ethernet SerDes, retimers, and diagnostics. The role covers SerDes, calibration, manufacturing, and test firmware. You'll work closely with ASIC, module, manufacturing, test, and reliability teams. You'll define ARM and RISC-V control architectures, write digital requirements for custom control ASICs, build a solid firmware development and CI flow, and mentor engineers across programs.

What you'll do

  • Architecture & Development: Architect, develop, debug, and release production firmware for next-generation optical engines and module platforms (SFP/QSFP/OSFP)
  • ASIC & System Specification: Define digital requirements for custom control ASICs, including MCU selection, memory maps, boot sequence, peripherals, telemetry, diagnostics, MACsec engines, and PTP hardware timestamping
  • System Integration: Partner with ASIC, RTL, and verification teams on architecture, board bring-up, and system-level debug
  • Protocols & Interfaces: Build and maintain firmware for Ethernet, PCIe, and SerDes (link training, interop, compliance), PTP/IEEE 1588, MACsec, and host interfaces
  • Bring-Up & Diagnostics: Lead first firmware bring-up on new modules and ASICs, and drive root-cause analysis across lab, qualification, and field returns
  • Manufacturing & Calibration: Deliver firmware for manufacturing test, screening, calibration engines, and lookup tables that support high-yield production
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Own the firmware workflow, including build/release pipelines, automated tests, regression coverage, and CI

What We're Looking For

  • BS/MS/PhD in EE, CE, CS, or equivalent, with 8+ years in embedded firmware
  • Expert C and C-based SDK development; exposure to modern C++ or Rust
  • Experience defining MCU requirements (ARM, RISC-V) and working with I2C, I3C, SPI, MDIO, and GPIO
  • Strong Python for test automation, data processing, and firmware QC
  • Hands-on with GCC/Make, Git/GitHub, Doxygen, CI/CD, and hardware-in-the-loop automation
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding, refactoring, and test generation in an embedded workflow
  • A track record of leading cross-functional bring-up and mentoring engineers

Good to Have

  • MACsec (802.1AE) key management or data-plane acceleration, and PTP hardware timestamping or clock recovery, in optical hardware
  • Root of Trust, Secure Boot, and secure firmware update (FOTA/UFOTA)
  • SerDes management, link-training tuning, and real-time diagnostic frameworks
  • Product qualification, stress testing, reliability investigations, and board-level FA

jobs.excerpt: About TylSemi, Inc.  The OpportunityThe AI infrastructure market is exploding.
jobs.description:
About TylSemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TylSemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP — the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks — that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

  • Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI — they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

  • If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.
  • No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

  • US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
  • India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.

What We Value

  • Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.
  • Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here.
  • Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
  • Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.

Here's why you should:

  • The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building.
  • The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo.
  • The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
  • The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.

Or stay comfortable. No judgment.

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.

READY TO JOIN?

We are looking for a Principal PCIe Sub-system Front-end RTL lead for next generation chiplet based SoCs for High-performance Compute and AI silicon .

What You’ll Do

  • Own the PCIe subsystem microarchitecture from the PHY interface through the MAC and Transaction Layer, defining the internal block boundaries, data paths, and control interfaces.
  • Lead the integration of third-party PCIe controller and PHY hard IP, including wrapper RTL that adds mode selection, telemetry hooks, and bridging logic to the chiplet's internal fabric.
  • Define and implement the bifurcation and lane-configuration logic, ensuring all supported lane-width configurations operate correctly across the full range of operating modes.
  • Specify and drive implementation of the Transaction Layer pipeline: TLP reception, integrity checking, header classification, routing decisions, and handoff to downstream subsystems.
  • Own the Virtual Channel and flow-control architecture, ensuring fair arbitration and back-pressure handling across all traffic classes.
  • Define the integration interface to the PCIe subsystem such asTLP-to-flit adaptation, flow-control mapping, and error handling at the boundary.
  • Collaborate with the management firmware team to define the PCIe register map, mode-select interface, and run-time telemetry structures exposed to the on-chip management processor.
  • Work with the Physical Design Lead to meet timing closure requirements for the PCIe subsystem, including MAC-PHY interface timing, reset sequencing, and floorplan constraints.
  • Hold the PCIe performance budget for each operating mode: bandwidth efficiency, latency through the Transaction Layer, and error recovery overhead.
  • Define the PCIe power management architecture — link state transitions, ASPM policy, and integration with the chiplet-level power coordination scheme.
  • Lead PCIe silicon bring-up planning: define bringup sequence, debug instrumentation requirements, loopback modes, and the hand-off criteria for production readiness.
  • Mentor and guide RTL design engineers responsible for PCIe subsystem implementation, providing architectural guidance and RTL review.
  • Partner with the DV team to define the PCIe UVM verification plan, coverage model, and protocol-checker requirements.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for PCIe-related customer integration questions, supporting anchor customer engagements on interface bring-up and interoperability.
  • Author and maintain the PCIe subsystem micro-architecture specification, keeping it current through RTL implementation and sign-off.

WhatWe’reLooking For

  • 10+ years of digital IC design experience, with at least 4 years focused on PCIe subsystem design or integration at the block-lead or module-owner level.
  • Deep expertise in PCIe architecture: Transaction Layer, Data Link Layer, Physical Layer, TLP structure, flow control, Virtual Channels, and error handling.
  • Hands-on experience integrating PCIe hard IP (controller and/or SerDes PHY) into production SoC or chiplet designs, including wrapper RTL, reset sequencing, and PnR constraints.
  • Background in SR-IOV, multi-function device configuration, or host software driver interaction at the hardware level.
  • Strong SystemVerilog RTL skills: able to write, review, and own production RTL for complex pipelined state machines, FIFOs, arbiters, and control logic.
  • CXL 1.1/2.0 or 3.0 protocol knowledge, particularly CXL.io and CXL.mem transaction handling built on the PCIe fabric.
  • Solid understanding of PCIe PHY-MAC interface protocols and timing requirements,
  • Experience with PCIe compliance testing and PCI-SIG certification process — understanding of test requirements, common failure modes, and debug methodology.
  • Familiarity with PCIe power management, L0s/L1 state machines, state transitions etc.
  • Competency in multi-clock-domain design: async FIFO, CDC synchronizers, and clock crossing at the PCIe-to-internal-fabric boundary.
  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

Good To Have

  • Experience with UCIe or another die-to-die protocol at the PCIe TLP adaptation layer — mapping TLPs to a flit-based D2D transport.
  • Prior experience with protocol bridging or gearbox designs that span multiple PCIe generations.
  • Familiarity with PCIe IP integration, including customization and support engagement.
  • Experience at an advanced-node (7 nm or below) tape-out, particularly with the timing closure and floorplan considerations for designs.

Compensation

The compensation range shown below represents total target cash compensation and includes both base salary and target bonus. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, job level, and work location.

In addition to cash compensation, this position is eligible for equity in the form of stock options, giving you the opportunity to share in the Company’s long-term growth and success.

jobs.title: Financial Controller (Director)
jobs.excerpt: Namecheap is in the business of opening doors to online success.
jobs.description:
Namecheap is in the business of opening doors to online success. We make it easy for anyone to build a winning web presence — with simple domain registration, affordable hosting, trusted security and privacy products, and an award-winning customer service team available 24/7. As proud advocates for online privacy and net neutrality, we put clients first — which is why we're one of the web's largest registrars, with millions of happy customers and over 32 million domains under management (and counting).

About the role

Now, as we enter an ambitious new stage of growth, we're looking for a Financial Controller to own the integrity of our financial reporting and transform how it's produced. This is a hands-on build-and-lead role: modernizing our systems, bringing the accounting function to full US GAAP rigor, and building a leaner, more automated finance organization, reporting directly to the CFO.

Why this role

Most Controller roles are about keeping the financial engine running. This one is about rebuilding and fine-tuning that engine so we're ready to scale commercially.

You will rebuild our accounting function from first principles, with the resources of a profitable, PE-backed company behind you. For a finance leader who would rather design the system than inherit it, that combination is rare:

  • A genuine greenfield build: Rebuild the accounting function from the chart of accounts up — systems, close, controls, and reporting — and bring it to full US GAAP rigor as we scale.

  • Own the technology: Move us off legacy tooling onto a modern, AI-native ERP, and design an operating model built around automation from day one.

  • AI-native by design. Build a lean, senior team modeled on the most automated finance orgs in tech — where expert people focus on judgment and impact, and AI handles manual work.

  • Real ownership, and a career-defining role: Own the accounting function end to end, lead an established team, and partner with the CFO as they focus on strategic finance and treasury—building the experience that prepares you for your next leadership role.

  • Startup-like canvas, scale-up rewards: The build-from-scratch experience of an early-stage company, with compensation set well above typical early-stage benchmarks, plus potential equity in a business entering its next growth phase.

What you’ll own

Accounting & Close

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering accurate, timely consolidated financials.

  • Own the general ledger, technical accounting, and financial reporting — including revenue recognition across domains, renewals, hosting subscriptions, and marketplace/auction transactions; deferred revenue; and multi-currency and intercompany accounting.

  • Oversee accounting across diverse payment rails (cards, PayPal, crypto, bank transfer) and reconcile high-volume, low-value transaction flows.

  • Design and run an internal controls framework across multiple entities, currencies, and jurisdictions — right-sized to our stage.

  • Prepare board- and sponsor-ready reporting, partner with FP&A on variance analysis, and manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.

Rebuild & Transformation

  • Re-architect the accounting foundations from first principles and bring the function to full US GAAP rigor.

  • Partner with the CFO to select a modern, AI-native ERP, then lead the end-to-end implementation — design, data migration, testing, and go-live — moving us off legacy tooling.

  • Re-engineer close, reporting, and controls to be scalable, automated, and audit-ready as the business grows.

  • Lead change management across finance and adjacent functions (revenue operations, billing, product) and manage the transformation to measurable outcomes.

An AI-First Operating Model

  • Build accounting operations around automation from the ground up — close automation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted reporting and analysis.

  • Design a lean, high-seniority team where experts focus on judgment and impact while AI handles the manual work, moving beyond a traditional monthly-close cadence.

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging finance-AI tooling, consistent with the AI-embedded philosophy already built into our own products.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop an established accounting team, reshaping structure and ownership as the operating model evolves.

  • Set the standard for a build-first culture — clear processes, strong documentation, and continuous improvement over legacy manual habits.

What you’ll bring

  • Big Four foundations: You trained at a top-tier global accounting firm, ideally with multi-entity consolidations and multi-currency environments and US GAAP exposure.

  • CPA, or an equivalent international qualification (e.g., ACCA, CA).

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including time as a Controller or Assistant Controller.

  • Deep technical accounting expertise: ASC 606 (multi-element, marketplace, and subscription revenue), ASC 350 (goodwill, intangibles, and capitalized software), ASC 830 (multi-currency operations), and ASC 805 (business combinations) — with the judgment to handle what's not in the textbook (e.g., crypto payment accounting under ASU 2023-08).

  • Hands-on ERP implementation experience: You’ve led or heavily contributed to a major ERP rollout, not just operated within one.

  • Experience in high-volume, low-ACV transaction flows (e-commerce, subscription, SaaS, or marketplace) is a strong plus.

  • A first-principles builder: You’d rather design systems than maintain them, and you’re energized by ambiguity and a blank canvas.

  • A proven transformation and change leader with specific processes you’ve rebuilt, systems you’ve implemented, and teams you’ve upskilled.

  • A genuine AI-native mindset: Real experience automating finance workflows, and a clear point of view on where AI creates leverage in close, reporting, and controls.

  • Comfort with the control and audit rigor of a larger or public company — and the judgment to right-size it for our stage.

What success looks like in year one

  • A new or significantly re-architected ERP live and stable, with the accounting team fully transitioned onto it

  • A documented finance transformation roadmap with clear milestones beyond year one

  • Close is faster and materially less manual, with automation embedded across reconciliation and reporting.

  • A strengthened internal controls framework appropriate to our scale and transaction complexity

  • The accounting foundations are rebuilt to full US GAAP rigor, from the chart of accounts up.

  • The team is reshaped into a leaner, more senior structure with clear ownership.

  • You’ve built a trusted partnership with the CFO, executive leadership, and CVC.

Highlights

100% remote Financial Controller modernizing systems, strengthening US GAAP rigor, and reporting to the CFO. Working hours: overlap between US Eastern Time and EU business hours.

JOB TITLE: Business Development Manager

DEPARTMENT: Sales

REPORT TO: Head of Business Development & Marketing

EMPLOYMENT STATUS: Full-time (exempt)

LOCATION: Remote (must reside in the U.S.)

CITIZENSHIP: U.S. Citizenship Required

CLEARANCE & LEVEL: Must be able to obtain and maintain DOD TS/SCI

ANNUAL SALARY (based on experience): $128,000 - $145,000

POSITION DESCRIPTION

The Business Development Manager supports the strategic growth of Eutelsat Network Solutions (EutelsatNS) within the U.S. Government, Department of Defense, Intelligence Community (IC), and Allied markets with a focus on aviation business development. Working closely with the Head of Business Development (BD) & Marketing, this role will identify opportunities, build and manage the pipeline, capture efforts, track customer engagement, and coordinate with stakeholders across the organization. We’re seeking a self-starter who can hit the ground running with experience in SATCOM, aviation, and government market knowledge.

This is a remote position. The candidate selected for this role must reside in the United States.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

Pipeline Development & Opportunity Support

  • Maintain and refine the federal opportunity pipeline, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with EutelsatNS strategic priorities.
  • Track customer engagements, capture milestones, and relevant program updates across DoD, IC, and Allied organizations.
  • Gather, consolidate, and analyze customer requirements to support the Head of BD and Marketing strategic growth initiatives.
  • Assist in preparing opportunity summaries, qualification assessments, and internal decision documents.

Business Development Operations & Administrative Support

  • Manage CRM entries (NetSuite) and ensure consistent data hygiene across leads, opportunities, and customer interactions.
  • Coordinate BD activities including meeting scheduling, briefing preparation, contact management, and follow-up tasks.
  • Support the development of BD documentation such as customer briefs, white paper inputs, talking points, and draft proposal materials.
  • Provide administrative support for capture planning activities, including research, document control, and deadline tracking.

Customer & Partner Engagement Support

  • Assist the Head of BD and Marketing in preparing for customer meetings, industry events, and cross-functional internal discussions.
  • Track interactions across Programs of Record, SDA, DIU, AFRL, DARPA, and other mission stakeholders to ensure continuity and action capture.
  • Support Head of BD & Marketing Congressional engagement activities by coordinating research, scheduling, and materials related to National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) priorities and assist in developing strategic outreach plans that align EutelsatNS objectives with emerging legislative opportunities.
  • Help coordinate EutelsatNS engagement with teaming partners, integrators, and distribution partners.

Market Research & Strategic Support

  • Conduct research on mission needs, capability gaps, acquisition trends, and technology developments relevant to EutelsatNS GEO/LEO and alternative PNT solutions.
  • Monitor DoD budget activities, program updates, RFI/RFP releases, and public announcements to inform EutelsatNS strategic decisions.
  • Support corporate strategy activities by contributing data, insights, and analysis related to defense and space sector trends.

Marketing & Communications Support

  • Help maintain consistent branding and messaging across BD and Sales collateral, customer communications, and EutelsatNS external visibility.
  • Assist with core marketing activities, including coordinating content, preparing materials for events and customer engagements, supporting social media and outreach efforts, and ensuring consistent messaging across all BD and marketing initiatives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned by management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • There are no supervisory responsibilities for this role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, communications, cyber, space systems, business, or a related field.
  • 8–12 years of industry experience in communications, SATCOM, cyber, network operations, or space operations. Knowledge in aviation and GEO is a plus.
  • Experience supporting operational units, program offices, or technical teams within DoD or the Intelligence Community.
  • Military background and/or government experience is desired.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Understanding of military communications systems, satellite communications, or network architectures (i.e., GEO, LEO, PNT, cyber, RF).
  • Familiarity with DoD organizational structures, acquisition pathways, and mission requirements.
  • Basic proficiency with CRM tools such as NetSuite.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to develop polished briefs, summarize information, and communicate effectively with senior leaders.

Professional Attributes & Ideal Capabilities

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive mindset with strong initiative and the drive to identify, pursue, and support high value opportunities across U.S. Government, DoD, and Intelligence Community customers.
  • Comfortable stepping outside traditional roles, working independently, and taking ownership of tasks to advance business development objectives in a dynamic, small and fast-paced environment.
  • Confident and tactful engaging directly with senior military leaders, government executives, and industry stakeholders; able to represent EutelsatNS professionally and with strong situational awareness.
  • Persistent and disciplined in following up on leads, customer engagements, and capture actions, maintaining exceptional attention to detail and organized task management.
  • Strong technical aptitude with willingness to develop a deep understanding of EutelsatNS’ full product portfolio across GEO/LEO, multi-orbit connectivity, alternative PNT, and advanced SATCOM technologies.
  • Highly collaborative, able to work effectively across BD, engineering, sales, marketing, finance, legal, and executive leadership to ensure unified messaging and coordinated execution.
  • Self-starter, capable of learning new technical concepts, adapting to emerging requirements, and operating with minimal supervision.
  • Professional, mature, and integrity-driven, able to represent EutelsatNS credibly within sensitive national security and mission environments.

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Must be a self-motivated, dynamic, and creative team player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work and handle multiple projects simultaneously and be resourceful under pressure.

TRAVEL

  • 25 – 50% of national and international travel is required for customer engagements, conferences, training, and internal meetings. Travel is predominately national.

BENEFITS (for full-time employees only)

Description

AtRankings.io, we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services. We are looking for a Law Firm Digital Strategist to connect client objectives to clear priorities,measurable roadmaps, and coordinated work across channels. This role reports to the Chief Strategy Officer and contributes to improving our approach to client strategy.

The Account Manager owns the client relationship and ongoing communication. The Law Firm Digital Strategist owns strategic direction, the roadmap, and the analysis that informs recommendations. Channel teams own execution. This is an individual-contributor role focused on planning, analysis, and direction, without hands-on campaign management or production responsibilities. The Strategist leads strategic discussions within client meetings in partnership with the Account Manager, explains recommendations and results, and participates in occasional in-person meetings.

Responsibilities

Client Objective Translation and Roadmap Ownership

  • Assess each client’s market, competitive position, desired case mix, geographic priorities, and budget to identify opportunities and constraints.

  • Partner with the Account Manager and client to establish realistic growth objectives, accounting for intake performance, firm capacity, and the time required to produce results.

  • Translate objectives into measurable roadmaps covering at least three months, with priorities, milestones, KPIs, and a clear rationale for the recommended approach.

  • Maintain an active roadmap for every assigned client, preparing the next segment before the current one ends. Develop longer-term plans when client goals or complexity require them.

Cross-Channel Strategy and Prioritization

  • Evaluate opportunities across GEO, SEO, Local SEO, paid media, video, organic social, content, link building, CRO, creative, web, and analytics.

  • Establish priorities based on expected impact, dependencies, available resources, and approved client scope and budget. Identify when additional investment or approval is needed.

  • Partner with channel experts to ensure execution plans support the roadmap while allowing specialists to determine the best technical approach.

  • Identify blockers and sequencing issues, challenge work that does not support client objectives, and recommend a better use of resources.

Performance Analysis and Accountability

  • Interpret client performance using qualified lead volume, lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates,signed cases where available, and relevant channel metrics.

  • Diagnose underperformance, distinguish marketing issues from tracking gaps or intake challenges, and develop corrective recommendations with the appropriate teams.

  • Identify when to expand successful initiatives, shift budget or effort, pursue new growth opportunities, or change the approach.

  • Escalate material risks, execution blockers, data issues, and resource constraints promptly, and follow through on agreed actions.

Internal Collaboration and Client-Facing Support

  • Partner closely with Account Managers to align strategic recommendations with client priorities, expectations, and commitments.

  • Lead strategic discussions with clients, explaining performance findings, recommendations, trade offs, and expected outcomes.

  • Keep Account Managers, channel teams, and leadership aligned on priorities and decisions, resolving strategic disagreements constructively.

Roadmap Management and Strategic Documentation

  • Complete monthly strategy checkpoints to evaluate progress, performance trends, blockers, and necessary adjustments.

  • Document objectives, strategic diagnosis, priorities, timelines, KPIs, risks, and next decisions, maintaining clear records of changes and assumptions.

  • Adapt planning depth to each client’s needs, balancing ongoing improvements for successful accounts with deeper analysis for complex or underperforming accounts.

  • Contribute to improving planning processes, templates, and strategy standards as the function evolves.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of digital marketing experience, including responsibility for developing client strategies, evaluating performance, and recommending priorities across multiple channels.

  • Strong understanding across multiple disciplines: SEO and Local SEO, with the ability to evaluate how GEO, paid search, paid social, CRO, content, and video contribute to a shared objective. Deep expertise in every channel is not required.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect multiple channels into a practical plan, explain investment tradeoffs, and adjust priorities based on results.

  • Ability to assess a client’s market, competitive position, business goals, budget, and constraints before recommending an approach.

  • Strong analytical skills, including experience interpreting data from GA4, Google Search Console,

  • advertising platforms, call tracking, CRM systems, SEO tools, or comparable reporting environments.

  • Experience presenting strategies and performance recommendations directly to clients, including

  • navigating difficult conversations.

  • Ability to influence priorities and resolve disagreements constructively with Account Managers, channel specialists, and department leaders.

  • Strong written communication and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize strategic attention across a substantial client portfolio.

  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client strategies is preferred. Legal marketing experience is a plus but is not required.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Client outcomes: Progress toward agreed objectives, including qualified leads, acquisition efficiency, and signed cases where reliable data is available. Outcomes are evaluated in the context of approved budgets,execution, intake performance, and client decisions.

  • Strategic effectiveness:Clear diagnosis, justified priorities, realistic sequencing, and a measurable connection between recommended work and client objectives.

  • Planning and follow-through:Active roadmaps for all assigned clients, completed monthly checkpoints, timely identification of risks, and consistent follow-through on corrective actions.

  • Channel progress:Relevant indicators selected for each client’s objectives, such as organic lead growth, local visibility, paid-media efficiency, conversion rate, impression share, and AI visibility.

Benefits

  • Annual Salary of $100k

  • Fully Remote

  • Unlimited PTO

  • $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program

  • Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Resume Review: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. One Way Interview: Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

  3. Live Zoom Interview:Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Manager for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.

Service Strategy & Operational Leadership

jobs.description:
NESsT is seeking an independent consultant or design studio to develop the visual concept, editorial layout, and final production files for a premium, photography-driven coffee table book featuring human-centered stories, enterprise profiles, and impact data. NESsTwill provide the approved English manuscript, publication structure, pre-selected photography, impact data, and brand assets. The selected designer will transform these materials into a cohesive publication for print and digital distribution.

Assignment type: Independent consultant or design studio
Location: Remote. Applicants based in Latin America and Central & Eastern Europe are particularly encouraged to apply.
Contract period: November 2–December 11, 2026

Submission deadline: October 18, 2026

Objective

The designer or studio will develop the visual concept, editorial layout, and final production files for an approximately 80–120-page publication. The design should be photography-driven, human-centered, contemporary, and appropriate for donor, investor, partner, and institutional audiences.

Scope of Work

  • Develop a cohesive visual and editorial design system, including representative layouts.
  • Design the complete 80–120-page publication, including covers, front and back matter, chapter openings, longform stories, profiles, photo-led spreads, and impact pages.
  • Integrate NESsT-supplied photography, captions, credits, impact data, and brand assets.
  • Create a limited number of simple publication-ready charts, maps, timelines, statistics, and callouts using approved NESsT data.
  • Flow and copyfit the approved English manuscript and incorporate revisions through formal review checkpoints.
  • Prepare final print-ready and digital files.

This assignment excludes substantive writing, copyediting, translation, photography commissioning, extensive image research or retouching, printing, physical proofs, shipping, and interactive digital formats.

Key Deliverables

  • Approved visual and editorial design system and representative layouts.
  • By December 1: a release-ready digital package containing the introduction, ten longform stories, associated impact pages, and supporting front matter.
  • By December 11: the complete publication layout, one print-ready PDF, one optimized digital PDF, and organized editable source files.

Required Qualifications

  • At least five years of professional publication or editorial design experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign and relevant Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Strong experience with complete, long-form, multi-section print publications.
  • Demonstrated ability to use typography, photography, pacing, and page composition to create a cohesive editorial narrative.
  • Experience with photography-intensive publications, information design, commercial printing, color management, prepress, and production-file preparation.
  • Strong attention to detail, file management, quality control, deadline management, and ability to work with a distributed international team.

Applicants must demonstrate substantial experience designing complete, long-form print publications. Experience limited to brochures, one-pagers, websites, presentation decks, social media assets, or short reports will not be sufficient on its own.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with nonprofit, foundation, social entrepreneurship, international development, ESG, or impact-investing organizations.
  • Experience designing donor-facing impact communications and stewardship materials.
  • Experience with coffee table books, museum publications, foundation reports, premium annual reports, or comparable publications.
  • Ability to translate complex social, environmental, and economic impact narratives into compelling visual experiences.

Proposal Requirements

Applicants should submit a complete proposal that includes: a brief statement of interest and approach; three to five completed editorial publications, including at least two publications exceeding 60 pages and at least one photography-driven publication for a premium audience; portfolio details for each example; team composition, if applying as a studio; a fixed-fee budget with assumptions, exclusions, taxes, reimbursable costs, and third-party expenses; and confirmation of availability to meet the December 1 and December 11 deadlines.

Anticipated Schedule

Applicants must be available to complete the assignment between November 2 and December 11, 2026. Key milestones include kickoff on November 2, design system review on November 10, priority package release on December 1, final proof review on December 8, and final files by December 11.

Application Process

Please submit the complete proposal, portfolio, fixed-fee budget, and availability confirmation through the Bamboo application page by October 18, 2026. Applicants should also review the full Terms of Reference for complete assignment details, proposal requirements, schedule, budget requirements, deliverables, and submission instructions.

jobs.description:
Req ID:393297

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Oracle Fusion & EBS Supply Chain Functional Consultant - Remote to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA-ON), Canada (CA).

Oracle Fusion & EBS Supply Chain Functional Consultant

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 12–15+ years in Oracle SCM
Oracle Fusion Experience: 5+ years
Oracle EBS R12 Experience: Required

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion & EBS Supply Chain Functional Consultant to lead the design, configuration, implementation, and optimization of Oracle Supply Chain solutions across Oracle Fusion Cloud and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS R12) environments.

The ideal candidate combines deep functional expertise in Order Management, Procurement, Purchasing, Inventory, and related Supply Chain processes with a strong understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.

This role is ideal for a senior Oracle SCM professional who has successfully delivered multiple full-lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations and can bridge legacy EBS processes and configurations to modern Fusion Cloud solutions.

Responisbilities:

Oracle SCM Solution Design & Configuration

  • Lead the functional design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Oracle Fusion Cloud and EBS Supply Chain solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, integrated solutions supporting Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
  • Facilitate requirements workshops with business and technical stakeholders and document current-state and future-state processes.
  • Provide functional leadership throughout implementation, testing, migration, deployment, and post-go-live support.

Oracle Fusion Order Management

  • Configure and support Oracle Fusion Order Management, including:
    • Order orchestration and fulfillment processes
    • Pricing Administration
    • Order holds
    • Credit checking
    • Drop ship
    • Back-to-back fulfillment
    • Configure-to-order (CTO) processes
  • Design solutions that integrate Order Management with Inventory, Shipping, Receivables, Cost Management, and other enterprise applications.

Oracle Fusion Procurement

  • Configure and implement Oracle Fusion Procurement capabilities, including:
    • Self-Service Procurement
    • Purchasing
    • Supplier Portal
    • Supplier Qualification
    • Sourcing
    • Procurement Contracts
  • Design and optimize P2P processes, approval flows, supplier interactions, purchasing, and procurement controls.
  • Configure approval workflows using BPM and Oracle Approval Management.

Inventory, Receiving & Shipping

  • Support related functional configurations across Inventory Management, Receiving, and Shipping.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, and Cost Management.
  • Analyze cross-module dependencies and ensure end-to-end business processes function effectively across SCM and Finance.

Functional Documentation & Solution Design

  • Lead the creation and maintenance of functional documentation, including:
    • BR100s
    • Configuration workbooks
    • Functional Design Documents (FDDs)
    • Functional specifications
    • Process flows
    • Test scripts
  • Define functional requirements for reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, and customizations (RICEW).
  • Partner with technical teams to ensure functional requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions.

Data Migration & Conversion

  • Define and document data migration requirements for:
    • Items
    • Suppliers
    • Customers
    • Open Purchase Orders
    • Open Sales Orders
    • Price Lists
  • Support data mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Validate conversion results using FBDI, ADFdi, and related Oracle data-loading tools.
  • Identify and resolve data quality and conversion issues throughout the migration lifecycle.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop comprehensive functional test scenarios and scripts.
  • Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Coordinate defect identification, triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution.
  • Validate end-to-end O2C and P2P business processes across integrated Oracle modules.
  • Support regression testing associated with Oracle Fusion quarterly updates and other system changes.

EBS-to-Fusion Transformation

  • Analyze existing Oracle EBS R12 processes, configurations, and business requirements and map them to Oracle Fusion Cloud capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve legacy processes during migration.
  • Support EBS-to-Fusion transformation initiatives, including fit-gap analysis, configuration mapping, data conversion, testing, and cutover.
  • Provide functional guidance on differences between EBS and Fusion business processes and functionality.

Training, Go-Live & Hypercare

  • Develop training materials and deliver end-user and business process training.
  • Support cutover and go-live activities.
  • Provide hands-on functional support during go-live and post-production hypercare.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and work with technical teams to drive timely resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • 12–15+ years of Oracle SCM experience, including at least 5 years of Oracle Fusion Cloud experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle EBS R12.
  • Proven experience delivering at least four full-lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementations.
  • Hands-on Fusion Cloud configuration experience in:
    • Order Management
    • Purchasing
    • Self-Service Procurement
    • Sourcing
  • Strong EBS R12 functional knowledge of:
    • Order Management
    • Purchasing
    • iProcurement
    • Inventory
    • Advanced Pricing
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
  • Strong understanding of SCM integration with AP, AR, GL, and Cost Management.
  • At least 5 years of experience with Oracle data and reporting tools, including FBDI, ADFdi, OTBI, and BI Publisher.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, functional design, configuration, testing, data migration, and production support.
  • Excellent client-facing communication, workshop facilitation, analytical, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Fusion Order Management Cloud and/or Procurement Cloud Implementation Professional certification.
  • Experience with:
    • Oracle Product Hub
    • Global Order Promising (GOP)
    • Supplier Model
    • Supply Chain Planning
  • Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and integration technologies, including REST and SOAP web services.
  • Experience working with enterprise integrations between Oracle SCM, Finance, legacy applications, and third-party systems.
  • Industry experience in manufacturing, distribution, retail, or other supply-chain-intensive environments.
  • Experience supporting global, multi-entity, and multi-country Oracle implementations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.

What Will Make You Successful

You will be successful in this role if you are a hands-on Oracle SCM functional leader who can work comfortably with business stakeholders, functional teams, and technical developers.

You should be able to translate complex business requirements into practical Oracle solutions, challenge legacy processes where appropriate, and guide clients through the transition from Oracle EBS to Oracle Fusion Cloud.

Strong candidates will bring a combination of deep Oracle SCM product knowledge, implementation experience, business process expertise, and excellent client-facing communication skills.

Core Expertise

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM | Oracle EBS R12 | Order Management | Procurement | Purchasing | Self-Service Procurement | Sourcing | Inventory | O2C | P2P | Advanced Pricing | FBDI | ADFdi | OTBI | BI Publisher | Data Migration | SIT/UAT | EBS-to-Fusion Transformation | Functional Design | RICEW | OIC

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, NeMo Core Platform
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build NeMo Helix, NVIDIA’s product for developing, evaluating, deploying, and operating AI systems at scale.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build NeMo Helix, NVIDIA’s product for developing, evaluating, deploying, and operating AI systems at scale. This role is for a senior engineer/architect for our Core team which owns and ships an open source plugin-based AI platform for running and optimizing Agents targeting multiple compute backends (local/docker, Kubernetes, Slurm, etc.).

As AI systems become more autonomous and more deeply integrated into real workflows, teams need robust APIs and orchestration systems for running, monitoring, and optimizing Agents at scale. Increasingly, the users of these systems are themselves autonomous or semi-autonomous Agents. The NeMo Helix group is building a sophisticated agent execution framework to enable agents to automatically run hundreds of experiments in parallel to find the most efficient agent architectures for our customers. This is important product engineering research for making agents more sustainable. AI systems are not yet nearly as efficient as they can be, and systems like NeMo Helix will allow large scale AI consumers to automatically tune their agents to use fewer tokens and rely on more efficient models with better throughput.

What you'll be doing:

  • Working in a product research environment where we place big bets on where the future is heading, adapting in real time as we build alongside an industry that is constantly evolving with us. This means fast iteration, high ownership, pragmatic decisions, and performance-minded implementation under production constraints
  • Designing an Agentic Execution system that are flexible enough to work in many environments (local, k8s, Slurm, on prem / air-gapped)
  • Provide senior technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and ownership of ambiguous cross-component problems
  • Building and maintain our Core Platform APIs for running jobs, storing data, entities, secrets, and RBAC and Auth
  • Extending our flexible Plugin Architecture that makes it easy for many teams and external customers to install new capabilities into our system
  • Building in the open in our OSS repo, keeping up the high standards that the open source community demands
  • Shipping code at the speed of light with an unlimited token budget using best in class agentic coding tools
  • Improving reliability, observability, debuggability, and performance across NeMo Helix, SDKs, plugins, jobs, and developer workflows
  • Building strong test coverage across unit, integration, E2E, Docker, and Kubernetes workflows

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building production systems
  • Comfort working in a very fast and ambiguous environment
  • Exceptional communication, both verbal and written. This includes the ability to produce and review high quality architectural RFCs, and to discuss them clearly with the right level of technical detail for the right people (Engineer, Product, Marketing, etc.)
  • Strong system design skills, with a pragmatic flexibility and phenomenal instincts to invent robust systems quickly without over-complicating. Strong understanding of reliability, scalability, security, and performance tradeoffs in production infrastructure
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud-native services, containers, Kubernetes, and job orchestration
  • Excellent Python engineering skills, including API design, typing, testing, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable software design
  • Experience designing SDKs, libraries, plugins, CLIs, or other developer-facing interfaces
  • Ability to work independently, define technical scope, break down ambiguous problems, and drive work across team boundaries

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building, deploying, and iterating on production agentic AI systems at scale in Kubernetes
  • Experience with sophisticated plugin architectures
  • Strong ability to connect technical evaluation work to business outcomes, product quality, user experience, reliability, or operational efficiency
  • Experience with enterprise AI systems where measurement, regression testing, observability, governance, and continuous improvement are required for production deployment
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 170,000 CAD - 220,000 CAD for Level 4, and 225,000 CAD - 275,000 CAD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 12, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

At ICF our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting organization that delivers integrated, strategic solutions to federal clients. The AI Engineer develops and operationalizes AI, machine learning, NLP, predictive analytics, and generative AI capabilities that accelerate data-driven decision making across the enterprise. This role builds reusable AI/ML solutions, model deployment frameworks, prompt orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, and MLOps pipelines leveraging Databricks ML, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Python, and cloud-scale data platforms. Working across engineering, governance, security, and business teams, the AI Engineer enables the adoption of AI at scale through model monitoring, performance evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, cost optimization, and responsible AI practices that ensure solutions are trusted, governed, and production-ready.


Job Location: Remote, however, strong preference for candidates who live in the Washington DC Metro Area. There will be occasional onsite meetings on the client site in Washington, DC.

  • Works with Trustworthy AI, Security, Data Governance, and Customer Experience personnel to ensure generative-AI capabilities are safe, useful, and governed.
  • Apply NLP, LLM/GenAI patterns, prompt orchestration, retrieval/evaluation patterns, guardrails, content filters, human-in-the-loop workflows, and Azure AI to support role delivery.
  • Collaborate with relevant product, engineering, security, governance, quality, and customer-facing stakeholders as required by the role.

jobs.description:
Build smarter procurement with AI at Precoro

Precoro is an AI-powered B2B SaaS platform that helps companies automate procurement, reduce manual work, and make better purchasing decisions. We work with 1,000+ customers across 80+ countries, helping businesses make their procurement processes more efficient and transparent.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own and evolve our Supplier Management product area — from supplier discovery and evaluation to contract management and automated purchasing.

Imagine helping businesses move from manually comparing suppliers, checking their reliability, and managing contracts to a smarter workflow where AI helps them find the right suppliers and automate routine decisions.

That’s the kind of experience we want to build.

What makes this role exciting?

  • AI-powered product development. Explore how AI can help businesses identify the best suppliers, make smarter purchasing decisions, and automate routine workflows.

  • End-to-end ownership. Take ideas from discovery and customer research to delivery, launch, and measuring real-world impact.

  • A complex B2B SaaS product. Solve meaningful business problems involving supplier data, purchasing workflows, integrations, and automation.

  • Real customer impact. Your decisions will shape how companies manage supplier relationships and make purchasing decisions.

  • Room to experiment. Challenge existing approaches, validate hypotheses, and turn promising ideas into features customers actually use.

What you’ll do

Own the Supplier Management product area end-to-end

  • Define the product direction, roadmap, and priorities for your area.

  • Discover customer needs through interviews, feedback, market research, and data analysis.

  • Turn business problems into clear product requirements and actionable solutions.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, Customer Success, and other teams to deliver valuable features.

  • Measure feature adoption and business impact after launch, learn from the results, and iterate.

Build smarter supplier workflows

Your product area includes several exciting directions:

  • AI-driven supplier recommendations: help customers identify the most suitable suppliers for their purchasing needs.

  • Supplier catalog and reliability: make it easier to discover, evaluate, compare, and select suppliers.

  • Contract management: improve how businesses manage supplier contracts and related workflows.

  • Supplier integrations and PunchOut marketplaces: connect Precoro with external supplier catalogs and purchasing systems.

  • Purchase order automation: reduce manual work and make interactions with suppliers more seamless.

You won’t simply manage a backlog. You’ll understand the problem, challenge assumptions, decide what matters most, and help the team deliver solutions that create measurable value.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience in a product company; 5+ years would be a strong advantage.

  • Experience working with B2B SaaS products and an understanding of how B2B purchasing decisions, workflows, and customer needs differ from B2C.

  • A track record of launching substantial features end-to-end — from discovery, research, and planning to delivery, adoption analysis, and post-launch improvements.

  • Strong product thinking: you can identify the underlying business problem rather than simply implement a requested feature.

  • Confidence in prioritizing competing needs, making independent decisions, and navigating ambiguity.

  • A data-informed approach to product decisions, including defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance.

  • English at B1+ level, preferably B2, with the ability to communicate with customers and external supplier representatives.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or improving AI-powered product features.

  • Familiarity with procurement, supplier management, marketplaces, or contract management.

  • Experience with third-party integrations or complex B2B workflows.

  • Experience using AI tools in your everyday product work.

You don’t need to be an AI expert to apply. We’re looking for a strong Product Manager who is curious about AI, eager to learn, and able to turn emerging technology into practical customer value.

Why Precoro?

  • Trust and ownership: no micromanagement — we value initiative and independent decision-making.

  • Learning and development: reimbursement for professional courses, lectures, and other learning opportunities.

  • Flexible working hours: we focus on results, not the number of hours spent at your desk.

  • Time off: 26 days off annually — 15 vacation days plus 11 public holidays.

  • Health and well-being: medical insurance and unlimited sick leave without requiring a medical certificate.

  • A supportive team: work with people who value open communication, thoughtful decisions, and continuous improvement.

Our hiring process

  1. Recruiter interview

  2. Interview with the hiring manager

  3. Test task

  4. Test task presentation with the team

jobs.excerpt: About the Role:We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.

This role is focused on agentic systems: software that reasons over a task, calls tools, works through multiple steps, and hands the result to a person to review and approve.

Our users work under strict accuracy, traceability, and validation requirements. The engineering challenge is making non-deterministic systems reliable, observable, and controllable enough to be trusted, tested, and shipped.

You’ll work on both the platform and runtime our agents execute on and the production agents built on top of it.

What You’ll Work On:

Agent Platform & Runtime (Core Focus)

  • Design and build the runtime our agents execute on: planning and execution loops, tool calling, state management, durable execution, and failure recovery
  • Build the layer through which agents reach platform data and external systems safely
  • Design coordination, delegation, and handoff across agents and workflows where needed
  • Make agent behavior versionable, testable, measurable, and regression-safe across releases
  • Build reusable primitives so new agents are configured rather than rebuilt from scratch

Building Agents (Core Focus)

  • Take a domain workflow from expert conversation to a working agent: goals, actions, execution flow, failure handling, and success criteria
  • Ground agent decisions and outputs in authoritative enterprise data rather than relying on model knowledge alone
  • Implement human-in-the-loop by design, including approval gates, override capture, uncertainty handling, and clear evidence for agent decisions. Agents recommend and draft; people decide
  • Close the loop: turn user corrections and overrides into signals that measurably improve the agent

Evaluation & Reliability

  • Build evaluation harnesses for multi-step behavior, not single-response accuracy: task completion, tool-call correctness, groundedness, trajectory quality, and regression across model, prompt, and tool changes
  • Define production metrics for agent quality, reliability, latency, cost, and human intervention rates
  • Implement guardrails, fallbacks, timeouts, cost ceilings, and end-to-end observability and tracing across agent runs
  • Design safeguards against prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, data leakage, and other agent-specific security risks
  • Manage prompt evolution, model drift, and non-determinism while maintaining consistent, measurable system behavior across releases

Integration & Data

  • Integrate agents with platform APIs and third-party enterprise systems already running in our customers’ environments
  • Build retrieval and context pipelines that turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable, permission-aware agent context
  • Design controlled execution paths for automated actions, with a complete, traceable audit trail

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Build and operate backend services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, etc.)
  • Own significant parts of the system architecture and contribute to key technical decisions
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python
  • Backend: Node.js, Python, AWS Lambda, Step Functions
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP and related agent/tool protocols, embeddings and vector search
  • Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform
  • Testing: Jest, Playwright, pytest

What We’re Looking For

Must Have

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including production systems
  • Strong understanding of LLM behavior, limitations, and failure modes, especially how errors compound across a multi-step run
  • Experience with LLM APIs, tool and function calling, and designing planning and execution loops
  • Experience evaluating and debugging non-deterministic systems
  • Solid backend and cloud experience (AWS or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python

You Should Be Comfortable With

  • Debugging across distributed and non-deterministic systems
  • Making explicit tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost
  • Working in ambiguous problem spaces where the right architecture isn't obvious yet
  • Owning production systems end-to-end
  • Choosing conventional software over AI when AI isn't the right solution

Nice to Have

  • C#, Microsoft .NET Framework
  • Tool and interop protocols such as MCP
  • Experience building production LLM systems, including tool-using or multi-step agentic workflows beyond simple prompting and chat interfaces
  • Evaluation pipelines and metrics built specifically for agentic systems
  • Experience in regulated or domain-heavy systems (validation, audit trails, controlled change)
  • Retrieval and grounding techniques for supplying agent context
  • Workflow and durable-execution platforms (Temporal, Step Functions, n8n, etc.)
  • Containerization and orchestration (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)

STARLIMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
