jobs.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Position Summary

The Senior QA Automation Engineer leads the quality strategy for the Evolent Platform web user experience. This role designs and maintains end-to-end, component, accessibility, contract, and test automation for a React and Next.js application and owns the quality signals that determine release readiness.

This individual works independently with minimal supervision, applies creativity to testing challenges, sets and upholds the automation patterns others follow, and mentors quality engineers across the team. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate testing and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on test strategy and solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy and Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive test strategies for the user experience, covering functional, regression, accessibility, performance, and AI-output quality.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and product planning to ensure quality is built into all phases of the software lifecycle.
  • Define and uphold test automation patterns and standards in partnership with testing automation architects and front-end leads.
  • Mentor quality engineers, promoting best practices in testing, automation, and quality assurance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in testing processes, tools, and methodologies, and evaluate emerging testing technologies for applicability.

Test Automation and CI/CD

  • Lead the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Playwright end-to-end suites and Vitest component tests for React and Next.js features.
  • Build contract tests for the AG-UI event stream, verifying event sequencing, shared state, tool-call events, and human-in-the-loop approval interrupts.
  • Build API tests for backend-for-frontend endpoints and .NET and Python (FastAPI) services.
  • Test streaming behavior and resilience, including slow, interrupted, and failed agent calls, retries, and timeouts.
  • Plan and execute basic load and performance tests for streaming endpoints and data-heavy screens.
  • Integrate and execute automated suites in GitHub Actions, maintaining a consistently high pass rate and reliable results.

Accessibility Testing

  • Lead accessibility testing against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508, combining automated axe-core checks with manual screen reader testing using JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver.
  • Partner with engineering and design to triage accessibility defects and support independent accessibility conformance reviews.

Defect Management and Quality Reporting

  • Isolate, analyze, document, and prioritize defects before escalating to developers, and collaborate with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders for timely resolution.
  • Analyze test and evaluation results, generate quality metrics, and report on quality state and release readiness to stakeholders.
  • Present work in Agile ceremonies and lead technical knowledge-sharing sessions.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, test script development, test data generation, documentation, troubleshooting, and defect analysis.
  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated tests, scripts, and analysis for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve testing productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, testing playbooks, and AI-assisted testing patterns to benefit the broader engineering organization.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information (including PHI in test data) is used with unapproved AI services or tooling; use synthetic data for testing.
  • Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including 3+ years of hands-on test automation for modern web applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript or JavaScript for end-to-end automation.
  • Experience with component testing using Vitest or Jest and React Testing Library.
  • Experience testing React-based web applications, including asynchronous and streaming behavior.
  • Hands-on accessibility testing experience with axe-core and manual screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508.
  • Experience with API testing and contract testing, including schema-based validation of APIs or event streams.
  • Experience with load or performance testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter).
  • Experience creating and maintaining automation jobs in CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions with YAML) and version control with Git.
  • Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM).
  • In-depth knowledge of testing methodologies, including functional, regression, accessibility, and performance testing.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor others.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating AI or LLM output using test datasets, scoring rubrics, or evaluation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with AG-UI, CopilotKit, the Vercel AI SDK, or other streaming (SSE) agent interfaces.
  • Experience with Python for test tooling or agent evaluation.
  • Experience using AI-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot or Playwright MCP.
  • Experience with FHIR R4 test data; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus.
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry for diagnosing test failures.
  • Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments handling PHI.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

jobs.description:
Looking to work with cutting-edge engineering software? What if you could work with all of them?

WHAT YOU WILL DO

At Synera, we build an agentic automation platform for engineers that helps them create better products faster. Our software connects engineering tools, data, and people, enabling teams to automate complex workflows and focus on what really matters: solving hard engineering problems. We already have 80+ software integrations, ranging from the biggest players to the latest startups, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for an Integration Developer who truly understands engineering and who uses AI as a natural part of how they work, not an afterthought.

This role sits at the intersection of software development, partner collaboration, and engineering system implementation: you'll own the development of add-ins and integrations within our agentic platform, be the first dedicated technical member of our new Marketplace team, and work closely with Andrew, our VP of Software Partnerships, who leads the marketplace roadmap and relations with over 25+ different software partners. You'll work with a wide range of technologies – CAD tools, simulation solvers, PLM systems, and AI – and you'll have the autonomy to make technical decisions and own integration projects with 3rd parties from end to end.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: You join the weekly all-hands to align on company updates, followed by the developer meeting to share progress, questions, and technical insights.

  • Tuesday: After the morning stand-up, you dive into a partner call to help their developers plan their integration with Synera and ensure they build a solid foundation.

  • Wednesday (biweekly): You do backlog refinement and team retrospective to clarify tasks, estimate effort, and improve workflow. In the afternoon, you will work on AI skills to help you speed up the development of integrations by you and our partners.

  • Thursday (biweekly): Sprint review day - you demo the past two weeks' progress on the latest add-in to the internal team and get feedback on some improvements to make. Afterwards, sprint planning defines the next sprint's scope and clarifies any remaining questions.

  • Friday: Andrew invites you to join a customer call, for you to understand more deeply the customer’s PLM environment to help improve one of our existing integrations. In the afternoon, you use your unlimited Claude budget to experiment with anew AI workflow.

The rest of the week’s time is protected focus time: writing code, reviewing Bitbucket pull requests and pushing real value to production.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You deliver customer-facing value regularly through integration projects.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You have a growing ownership of complex integrations, especially in the PLM space, you mentor peers, and contribute to architecture and product decisions.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned annual salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 67,000 - 85,000 EUR

  • Advanced Level: 80,500 - 109,000 EUR

We determine the level we hire for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you’ll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • With the high level of ownership, you make a real impact on our Synera software.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have a deep understanding of developing add-ins, plugins or integrations for complex software systems.

  • You’ve got the AI-native mindset and curiosity to constantly learn and develop your skills in this area.

  • You bring hands-on experience with PLM, SPDM, or MES platforms.

  • You bring strong proficiency in C# and C++, with solid algorithmic and logical thinking skills.

  • You're comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy – communicating directly with partners, making technical decisions, and owning projects from start to finish.

  • You are a strong communicator in English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Marketplace team.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Fullstack EngineerYour Opportunity:We're building a category-defining company at the intersection of real estate, technology, business services, and the consumer.
jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack Engineer

Your Opportunity:

We're building a category-defining company at the intersection of real estate, technology, business services, and the consumer. As a profitable, hypergrowth startup on the path to an IPO, our standards are high, our team is scrappy, and our commitment is to execute the best work of our lives.

This is YOUR CHANCE to shape the backbone of a company that's scaling rapidly and innovating boldly. As our Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll partner with the CTO, founders, and executives to build and scale our mortgage technology platform, shipping features end to end across a mix of microservices and monolith architectures, with a focus on backend systems and third-party integrations. If you thrive in complexity, entrepreneurial problem-solving, and believe in scaling through tech and AI, this is your PLACE.

Who Develops You: CTO

What You're Great At:

You are a seasoned engineer with 7+ years building and running production web applications, and you take a problem from a vague description to a shipped, monitored solution. You go deep on Ruby on Rails, including API-only services, ActiveRecord, PostgreSQL, background jobs, and RSpec. You're also comfortable shipping polished UI with React and TypeScript, and you've worked with GraphQL (ideally Apollo) on both server and client.

You've built distributed, event-driven systems and know how to debug failures that span services, using retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency. You've also tamed third-party integrations (REST, SOAP, webhooks) and partner APIs that are slow, inconsistent, or poorly documented. You treat sensitive personal and financial data with care and have strong instincts for security and multi-tenant data isolation.

You use AI and agentic coding tools at an advanced level every day, can describe how you structure context for agents and verify what they produce, and you build tooling that makes other engineers more effective. You communicate clearly: you can write a strong design doc, explain a production incident to a customer success manager, and disagree productively with a product manager. You own production through on-call, incident response, observability, and blameless postmortems.

Bonus points if you have experience in mortgage tech or a similar regulated, integration-heavy domain (fintech, lending, insurance, payments, healthcare), familiarity with LOS platforms (Encompass, MortgageBot, Byte) or MISMO standards, Node.js/TypeScript services, Elasticsearch, Redis, Docker, AWS, CI/CD, saga or workflow orchestration patterns, or a history of mentoring engineers and leading cross-team projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain features across Rails API services, TypeScript/Node services, a GraphQL gateway, and React frontends
  • Own integrations with external platforms (LOS systems, mortgage insurance providers, document and e-sign vendors), including data mapping, sync and reconciliation, retries, and idempotency
  • Design and evolve asynchronous, multi-step workflows using message queues (RabbitMQ, SNS/SQS), Sidekiq background jobs, and saga-style orchestration
  • Keep our multi-tenant platform correct and secure, respecting partner boundaries in every query and event
  • Lead technical design for significant features by writing design docs and architecture decision records, weighing trade-offs, and building alignment before you build
  • Identify and pay down technical debt, improving service boundaries, module design, test coverage, and developer experience
  • Hold a high bar in code review and help set engineering standards across the team
  • Join the on-call rotation, lead incident response, and follow through on root-cause fixes that prevent recurrence
  • Use observability tools and CI/CD to keep the platform healthy, and improve them where they fall short
  • Work directly with Customer Support & Success on lender-reported escalations, reproducing issues, investigating sync problems with external LOSs, and explaining findings clearly to non-engineers
  • Partner with Product Managers to refine requirements, uncover edge cases early, and propose simpler alternatives
  • Work with UI/UX Designers to turn designs into polished, accessible interfaces, and push back constructively when technical constraints affect the experience
  • Mentor other engineers through pairing, code review, and design feedback, including on effective AI-assisted workflows
  • Lead on AI-assisted engineering by using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) daily to plan, implement, test, debug, and review, and by delegating well-scoped work to agents and reviewing their output rigorously
  • Build and maintain shared AI tooling for the team, including agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), reusable skills and prompts, MCP servers connecting agents to internal systems, and automated workflows
  • Set and follow guardrails for AI use: verify agent output, never expose secrets or customer data, and know when a task needs a human-written solution

Why Maxwell:

We believe people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and surrounded by others who are equally driven. That's why this role includes a "work from the place you work best" approach – at home, in an office, or on the move. Our competitive benefits include PTO as needed, comprehensive insurance coverage, a 401(k) match, stock option grants, and a stock purchase plan. Every team member is an owner, building the place they are proud to call "my company."

This role will support the development of AI-enabled tools that draft survey reports, let researchers and policymakers analyze data in natural language, translate questionnaires into low-resource languages, and support interviewers and data quality in the field. No tool is adopted unless it matches or beats the expert-led process it replaces. You will build the prompting, agent, and pipeline layer across the program. You will also build the evaluation harnesses that show whether each tool actually works, judged against ground truth produced by some of the most experienced survey methodologists in the world.


This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional travel.


It is contingent upon award of program funding.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build LLM pipelines and agents for survey workflows, including:
    • an AI-assisted data-to-report pipeline
    • natural-language analysis of survey data
    • multilingual questionnaire translation
    • field support tools for interviewers and supervisors
  • Build evaluation harnesses as first-class deliverables. Work with the Technical Lead and survey experts to define acceptance criteria before the work is judged. Build test sets from expert-produced ground truth and run the non-inferiority comparisons that decide whether a tool moves forward.
  • Route work across models based on reasoning complexity, volume, cost, latency, and data-residency requirements.
  • Manage inference cost by tracking token usage, context limits, prompt caching, and batch processing, and account for these operating costs in model-selection decisions.
  • Connect models to data services and to the applications built by full stack developers.
  • Use agentic coding tools to produce software from clear specifications, then review, test, and own the resulting code.
  • Monitor production systems, conduct disciplined error analysis, and report positive and negative results.
  • Document methods and results for public release, including negative results. Help transfer tools to partner-country institutions so they can run them on their own.

Minimum Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent years experience)
  • Minimum 4 years of professional software development experience, including building LLM-powered systems that real users relied on in production
  • U.S. citizenship is required by federal government contract

Additional Required Skills and Experience

  • Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Go) for back-end and AI application development
  • Hands-on experience building with frontier-model APIs (from any provider, or through any cloud platform), including tool use and retrieval-augmented generation
  • Demonstrated experience designing LLM evaluations, including test-set construction, automated and human grading, regression testing, and ship/no-ship decisions.

  • Experience building and deploying on a major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with multilingual or low-resource-language NLP, translation, or speech
  • Experience deploying open-weight models
  • Experience with sensitive or regulated data, such as health data or human-subjects research
  • Familiarity with model governance, monitoring, and responsible AI practice
  • Experience in global health, international development, or low- and middle-income country settings
  • Public work such as open-source contributions, published evaluations, or technical writing about systems you built undefined

Professional Skills

We are looking for a QA & Test Automation Developer to help us evolve how software quality is built, automated, and scaled across MindBridge.

Strong testing fundamentals are essential to this role. We are looking for someone who understands common testing heuristics, can identify meaningful product risks, and knows how to test and verify software beyond the obvious happy paths. You will use agentic tools to apply those skills faster and at greater scale without compromising testing depth or judgment.

You will design and maintain automated test suite, improve our quality engineering frameworks and delivery pipelines, and expand the use of AI agents within our QA processes. This includes creating, configuring and using agentic tools to accelerate test creation, analysis, failure triage, coverage assessment, and other recurring quality workflows.

As our product and software development practices become increasingly AI-native, you will also contribute to how we validate AI-powered features. Having direct experience testing AI agents, LLM-based features, or other non-deterministic systems is a strong asset.

What You Will Do

Quality engineering & automated testing

Apply strong testing fundamentals and heuristics to identify product risks, edge cases, failure modes, and gaps in expected behaviour Investigate failures and unexpected behaviour and act of them. Configure and use agentic tools with various degree of autonomy, to accelerate test creation, maintenance, analysis, failure triage, and other recurring QA activities. Advocate for testability and quality throughout the development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of our test frameworks, internal tooling, and automated quality gates. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and ensure appropriate validation and human oversight remain part of the testing process.

Testing AI-powered systems

Contribute to test strategies for AI-powered, LLM-based, and agentic product capabilities. Help define how non-deterministic behaviour should be evaluated, including expected behaviour, quality thresholds, regression approaches, and failure analysis. Validate areas such as model responses, tool usage, grounding, consistency, error handling, latency, and end-to-end agent behaviour where applicable.

Collaboration & continuous improvement

Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and other technical teams to make quality an integral part of software development. Share testing patterns, tools, and lessons learned, and continuously look for ways to improve testing effectiveness and delivery speed.

Required Qualifications

Strong software testing fundamentals, such as critical thinking, exploratory testing, test design, risk-based testing, common testing heuristics, and the ability to reason about customer and product impact. Hands-on experience designing and developing automated tests for modern software applications. Strong programming skills in at least one language commonly used for test automation or engineering, such as TypeScript/JavaScript or Python. Experience with modern test automation frameworks Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and incorporating automated testing into software delivery workflows. Ability to troubleshoot complex software and automated test failures across application, test, data, and infrastructure layers. Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development capabilities to automate or improve engineering and QA workflows. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across QA, Engineering, Product, and other technical teams. A continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in finding better ways to make software quality faster, more scalable, and more reliable.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based features, copilots, or autonomous or agentic systems. Experience building automation using agentic technologies that perform multi-step tasks or interact with engineering systems and tools. Familiarity with concepts such as prompt evaluation, tool calling, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and LLM observability. Job Description:

Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote | Canada

About the Role:


JD Power is looking for a data engineer with excellent quantitative and analytical skills to help make our data AI-ready. Our ideal candidates are determined to use their skills to combine multiple data sources together, and to add clear business meaning on top of them, so that both people and AI applications can answer complex client questions around vehicle transactions, incentives, valuations, market readiness, and customer purchase decisions. You’ll work hands on with data on Snowflake to build semantic views, governed metrics, and context layers that power AI assistants and agents, and to improve and maintain existing capabilities.

We make data products that solve problems for the auto industry. Every data engineer will work on projects that go into production and directly impact new and existing products. In this role, your work decides whether our AI products give accurate, traceable answers instead of guesses.

Grow as a data engineer as part of a medium sized team, where data engineering and AI engineering meet. You will build data pipelines, semantic views, and context layers on Snowflake, deploy them in the cloud, and build monitoring & QA suites, including tests for AI answer quality.

The team is an experienced set of creative thinkers who are uncovering new and emerging consumer dynamics in an industry starting to go through rapid disruption. We are moving our key data to Snowflake and making it AI-ready, so our AI assistants and agents can give clients accurate, trusted answers.

We want data engineer candidates who can monitor, improve, and create data processes independently and with an eye toward continuous improvement. We need the capability to leverage the right data sets efficiently from an impressive set of data assets that is unrivaled in this space. We also want someone who is curious about AI, and who knows that AI is only as good as the data and business context behind it.

In this role, you will:

  • Daily immersion in automotive industry data
  • Build and maintain the business context that makes data AI-ready: business terms, glossaries, metric definitions, rules, and hierarchies for a data domain (e.g., incentives, pricing, sales, dealers), reviewed and approved by business owners
  • Design, build, validate, and publish governed Snowflake semantic views and a versioned metric registry, so every application and AI agent uses one approved definition of each metric
  • Help build canonical “master” data sets where multiple sources of truth exist today (e.g., master vehicle/VIN, master dealer, master incentives)
  • Prepare unstructured content (PDF documents, glossaries, FAQs, data dictionaries) for retrieval with Snowflake Cortex Search, with metadata and source traceability
  • Partner with AI engineers to connect semantic views, metrics, and search services to Cortex Analyst and Cortex Agents
  • Design, troubleshoot, and execute repeatable data pipelines on Snowflake (and on our current Google Cloud/BigQuery platform during the transition), in which you’re finding bottlenecks and ways to become incrementally more efficient. You own the reliability of these pipelines and the quality of the data they produce
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and understand data processing requirements, with consistent proactive demonstration of business acumen and market dynamics
  • Contribute meaningfully to new product development, on top of production, by executing independently to plans (and by influencing the plans themselves) for new features on existing products, and for net-new products or approaches
  • Lead end-to-end data engineering projects, and mentor and guide junior data engineers
  • Interdisciplinary work: you’ll interact with multiple teams across the firm to implement solutions and improve processes. This includes Customer Success, Product Management, Product Development, Technology/Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, Data Visualization, etc.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must have: strong, hands-on proficiency in both Python and SQL. You use both every day to build, test, and debug production data pipelines
  • Must have: proven production experience in designing, building, and running ETL/ELT pipelines that bring together data from multiple sources, with ownership of their robustness and output data quality (e.g., idempotent jobs, monitoring and alerting, automated data quality checks)
  • Software engineering background or experience is a plus: Git and code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and modular, reusable code
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake is strongly preferred (e.g., Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, role-based access control), and semantic views or Cortex experience is a big plus. Experience with other cloud platforms such as Google Cloud (BigQuery), AWS, or Palantir is also valued
  • Experience building semantic layers or governed metrics (e.g., Snowflake semantic views, dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, AtScale, Cube), with a strong base in dimensional modeling (facts, dimensions, grain)
  • Working knowledge of how AI applications use data: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, context and prompt design, tool calling, AI agents, and MCP. Hands-on experience building an LLM application is a plus
  • Familiarity with ontologies, knowledge graphs, data catalogs, metadata management, and data governance (e.g., access control, PII handling, lineage)
  • Familiar with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), with hands-on experience using them in daily development work. You know their limits, and you review and test the code they produce before it goes to production
  • Experience resolving data issues in creative and effective ways. Business acumen and gut instincts to know when to say, “This doesn’t seem reasonable.”
  • Independent professional who can take a vision and implement with limited instruction
  • Bachelor’s degree (required), with a background in statistics, machine learning, computer science, finance, engineering, or mathematics preferred
  • An effective cross functional communicator in both written and verbal skills
  • Ability and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment, with a resilient work ethic
  • At least 5 yrs of professional experience with a Bachelor’s degree or 3 yrs with a Graduate degree as a full-time professional (non-academic) experience in data engineering and quantitative analytics, contributing to business impact through data-driven solutions
